Write down any feedback and send it directly to the creator. Your message will not be posted to the Marketplace and the creator will not be able to respond.

translation: Update nao de nuuste versie óm diech gekoch pack in Minecraft Marketplace te downloade.

context: Meaning: Everything Overworld in alphabetical order

source_string: Add-Ons are a content type available in the Minecraft Marketplace that lets you add custom blocks, items, mobs, recipes, and other game content to your world.
translation: Add-Ons zeen 'n contenttype besjikbaar in de Minecraft Marketplace wovoer doe eige blokke, items, mobs, receptes en angere sjpelcontent nao diech waereld kans toevoege.

source_string: Add-Ons allow you to modify your existing worlds and Realms through the Edit World screen and the Create New World screen.
translation: Add-Ons late diech diech besjtaonde waerelde en Realms aanpasse via 't Waereld bewerke-sjerm en 't Nuuj waereld make-sjerm.

source_string: Stacking, or adding multiple Add-Ons, can increase loading times, and could result in unexpected results.
translation: Stapele, of mie es ein Add-On toevoege, kan de laodtied verhoage en onverwachte resultate opleveren.

source_string: We recommend that you save a copy of your world or Realm before adding or removing Add-Ons.
translation: We aanraoje detste 'n kopie vaan diech waereld of Realm opsjlags veurdet doe Add-Ons toevoegs of verwiedert.

source_string: For more information about how you can make the most out of Add-Ons, you can visit our FAQ page.
translation: Veur mie info euver wie doe 't mieste oet Add-Ons kans haole, kans te onze FAQ-pagina bezeuke.

source_string: Adventure Mode is a gamemode for world builders. In Adventure Mode, players must use special tools to place or break blocks.
translation: Adventuremodus is 'ne sjpelmodus veur waereldbouwers. In Adventuremodus moote sjpelers speciael gereedsjap gebroeke óm blokke te plaotse of te breke.

source_string: To get these special tools, you must use §e/give§f with §ecanplace§f or §ecandestroy§f parameters while in creative mode.
translation: Óm dees speciael gereedsjap te kriege, moots te §e/give§f gebroeke mèt §ecanplace§f of §ecandestroy§f parametere terwiel doe in creative-modus bis.

source_string: Experience Levels can be used to repair, enchant, or rename items with the Anvil.
translation: Ervaringsniveaus könne gebroek wure óm items te herstelle, betouvere, of te herneume mèt 't Aambeeld.

source_string: All items can be renamed, although only items with durability can be repaired or enchanted with Books on the Anvil.
translation: Alle items könne herneumd wure, mer allein items mèt duurzaomheid könne herstelt of betouverd wure mèt Books op 't Aambeeld.

source_string: An item can be repaired by placing it in one of the input slots on the left, along with either some raw materials of the item, like Iron Ingots for an Iron Sword, or combined with another item of the same type.
translation: 'n Item kan herstelt wure door 't in ein vaan de links insjtekksleuve te plaotse, samen mèt rauw materiaal vaan 't item, wie iezerknöppe veur 'n iezere sjweerd, of gecombineerd mèt 'n angere item vaan 't zelfde type.

source_string: Combining items is more efficient when done with an Anvil.
translation: Items kombinere is efficiënter mèt 'n Aambeeld.

source_string: There is a chance that the Anvil will be damaged with each use and after enough usage it will be destroyed.
translation: D'r is 'n kans det 't Aambeeld beschadig wuurt bié eder gebroek en nao genóg gebroek wuurt 't vernaeteg.

source_string: By wearing Armor, you can protect yourself from incoming damage. Your Armor level is represented by :armor: on the HUD, the higher the level, the less damage you will take.
translation: Door pantser te draoge, kans te diech besjermen tegen inkómmend schade. Diech pantserniveau wuurt weergegeve door :armor: op de HUD, hoeger niveau, minder schade.

source_string: Armor can be crafted from Leather, Iron, Gold, or Diamond. Chainmail Armor can be obtained through villager trading and loot from zombies and skeletons.
translation: Pantser kan gecraft wure vaan leer, iezer, gaol, of diamant. Kettingpantser kan gekrege wure door hendel mèt durpelinge en loot vaan zombies en skeletten.

source_string: Equip Armor by opening your inventory and moving pieces of Armor to the appropriate slot next to your player skin.
translation: Rüst pantser door diech inventaris te ëpene en pantsersjukke nao de juuste sleuf naeve diech sjpelerskin te versjuve.

source_string: Iron, Chainmail, and Golden Armor can be smelted into Iron or Gold Nuggets in a Furnace.
translation: Iezer, kettingpantser en gaole pantser könne gesmoltje wure nao iezer- of gaolklumpjes in 'ne oven.

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Press and hold :_input_key.sneak: to block with the Shield.
translation: 't Sjilds bloke inkómmend schade. 't Sjild kan gedraoge wure in de anger han-sleuf en de hotbar. Druk en haod :_input_key.sneak: ingedrök óm te bloke mèt 't Sjild.

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Press :_input_key.sneak: or press :_gamepad_stick_right: to toggle block with the Shield.
translation: 't Sjilds bloke inkómmend schade. 't Sjild kan gedraoge wure in de anger han-sleuf en de hotbar. Druk :_input_key.sneak: of druk :_gamepad_stick_right: óm te bloke mèt 't Sjild te toggele.

source_string: The Shield blocks all kinds of incoming damage - even a Creeper explosion! It can be equipped in the offhand slot or the hotbar.
translation: 't Sjild blokt alle vörm vaan inkómmend schade - zelfs 'n Creeper-explosie! 't Kan gedraoge wure in de anger han-sleuf of de hotbar.

source_string: When using the "D-Pad & tap to interact" control scheme, tap :touch_sneak: to toggle blocking with the shield.
translation: Bij gebroek vaan 't 'D-Pad & tikke óm te interagere'-besjturingsschema, tik :touch_sneak: óm te toggele mèt 't sjild te bloke.

source_string: When using a "Joystick" control scheme, tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak: to toggle blocking with the shield.
translation: Bij gebroek vaan 'n 'Joystick'-besjturingsschema, tik :tip_virtual_button_sneak: óm te toggele mèt 't sjild te bloke.

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Press :_input_key.sneak: or click :rift_X: to toggle block with the Shield.
translation: 't Sjilds bloke inkómmend schade. 't Sjild kan gedraoge wure in de anger han-sleuf en de hotbar. Druk :_input_key.sneak: of klik :rift_X: óm te bloke mèt 't Sjild te toggele.

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Press :_input_key.sneak: or click :windowsmr_right_stick: to toggle block with the Shield.
translation: 't Sjilds bloke inkómmend schade. 't Sjild kan gedraoge wure in de anger han-sleuf en de hotbar. Druk :_input_key.sneak: of klik :windowsmr_right_stick: óm te bloke mèt 't Sjild te toggele.

source_string: The Shield can even block a Creeper explosion!
You can also wear a Carved Pumpkin on your head. This won't give you any :armor: but will make it so Endermen won't get mad when you look at them.
translation: Doe kans ouch 'n oetgehauwe pompoon op diech kop draoge. Dit geuf diech gein :armor: mer maak det Endermen neet mie boes wure es doe naor hun kieks.

source_string: An Armor Stand holds your armor while you aren't using it.
translation: 'n Pantserrek haod diech pantser vas terwiel doe 't neet gebroek.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on an Armor Stand while holding a piece of armor to place it on the Armor Stand.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op 'n Pantserrek terwiel doe 'n sjuk pantser vashaods óm 't op 't Pantserrek te plaotse.

source_string: Tap an Armor Stand while holding a piece of armor to place it on the Armor Stand.
translation: Tik 'n Pantserrek terwiel doe 'n sjuk pantser vashaods óm 't op 't Pantserrek te plaotse.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on an Armor Stand with an open hand to remove something from the Armor Stand.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op 'n Pantserrek mèt 'n ëipe han óm get vaan 't Pantserrek te verwiedere.

source_string: Tap an Armor Stand with an open hand to remove something from the Armor Stand.
translation: Tik 'n Pantserrek mèt 'n ëipe han óm get vaan 't Pantserrek te verwiedere.

source_string: An Armor Stand can change its pose, sneak and press :_input_key.use: on an Armor Stand to change the pose.
translation: 'n Pantserrek kan zieng poze veranderen, sluip en druk :_input_key.use: op 'n Pantserrek óm de poze te veranderen.

source_string: An Armor Stand can change its pose, sneak and tap an Armor Stand to change the pose.
translation: 'n Pantserrek kan zieng poze veranderen, sluip en tik 'n Pantserrek óm de poze te veranderen.

source_string: Armor Stands will react to a Redstone signal, try giving it different signal strengths and see what happens.
translation: Pantserrekke reageere op 'n Redstonesignaal, probeer versjillendje signaalsterktes en zuug waat gebeurt.

source_string: Banners are a cool way to decorate your house or castle with custom patterns and colors.
translation: Vaandele zeen 'ne coole manier óm diech huus of kesjteel te versiere mèt eige patrone en klöre.

source_string: After crafting a Banner, you can put it on a Crafting Table or Loom and add different dyes to create your own unique, cool design!
translation: Nao 't craften vaan 'n Vaandel, kans te 't op 'n Werkbank of Weefstoel zette en versjillendje kleurstöffe toevoege óm diech eige unieke, coole ontwerp te make!

source_string: There are many different patterns that you can create with your dye such as:
translation: D'r zeen väöl versjillendje patrone deste kans make mèt diech kleurstof zoeas:

source_string: - Making a triangle will give you a chevron pattern.
- Making a cross gives you a cross pattern.
- Use an Oxeye Daisy to craft a flower pattern.
translation: - Gebroek 'n margriet óm 'n bluumpatroon te craften.

source_string: Experiment with different combinations to get even more patterns!
translation: Experimenteer mèt versjillendje kombinaties óm noch mie patrone te kriege!

source_string: A Banner can also have multiple layers, allowing you to have more than one pattern on your Banner. If you don't like the last pattern you put on a Banner, you can wash the last layer off in a Cauldron.
translation: 'n Vaandel kan ouch mie laoge höbbe, zoedet doe mie es ein patroon op diech Vaandel kans höbbe. Es doe 't lëts patroon deste op 'n Vaandel gezat höbs neet leuk vinjs, kans te de lëtste laog aafwasse in 'n Ketel.

source_string: If you want to copy a Banner, put it on the Crafting Table with a blank Banner.
translation: Es doe 'n Vaandel wils kopiëre, zèt 't op de Werkbank mèt 'n laeg Vaandel.

source_string: Active Beacons project a bright beam of light into the sky.
translation: Aktief Bakes wörpe 'ne helderdje straol licht de loeft in.

source_string: They are crafted with Glass, Obsidian, and Nether Stars (which is obtained by defeating the Wither).
translation: Zie zeen gecraft mèt glaas, obsidiaan en Nethersterre (die kriegs door de Wither te verslaon).

source_string: Beacons need to be on top of a Pyramid of Iron, Gold, Emerald, Diamond, or Netherite blocks with an unobstructed view of the sky.
translation: Bakes moote op 'ne piramide vaan iezer-, gaol-, smaragd-, diamant- of Netheritblokke staon mèt 'n vriej zicht op de loeft.

source_string: The material that the Beacon is placed on has no effect on the power of the Beacon.
translation: 't Materiaal wovoer de Bake op geplaats is, hèt gein invlood op de kraf vaan de Bake.

source_string: In the Beacon menu you can select one primary power for your Beacon. The more tiers your pyramid has the more powers you can have.
translation: In 't Bake-menu kans te ein primaire kraf veur diech Bake selektere. Hoe mie laoge diech piramide hèt, hoe mie krachte doe kans höbbe.

source_string: To set the powers of your Beacon you must use a Netherite Ingot, Emerald, Diamond, Gold Ingot, or Iron Ingot in the payment slot.
translation: Óm de krachte vaan diech Bake in te stelle, moots te 'ne Netherit-baar, smaragd, diamant, gaol-baar, of iezer-baar in de betaalsleuf gebroeke.

source_string: Once set, the powers will emanate from the Beacon indefinitely. Powers are granted to all nearby players.
translation: Ins ingesjteld, blieve de krachte veur altied vaan de Bake oetstraole. Krachte wure toegekend aan alle sjpelers in de omgeving.

source_string: To change the color of the beam, place a stained glass block in its path.
translation: Óm de kluer vaan de straol te veranderen, plaots 'ne gekleurde glaasblok in zieng pad.

source_string: Sleeping in a Bed passes the night and sets your spawn point.
translation: Sjlaope in 'n Bèd laet de naach veurbiegaon en zèt diech spawnpunt.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Bed to go to sleep. This can only be done at night.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op 'n Bèd óm te sjlaope. Dit kan allein 's naachs gebeure.

source_string: Tap a Bed to go to sleep. This can only be done at night.
translation: Tik 'n Bèd óm te sjlaope. Dit kan allein 's naachs gebeure.

source_string: If you are playing Multiplayer, everyone in the world must be in a Bed at the same time to pass the night.
translation: Es doe multiplayer sjpels, moot ederein in de waereld gelieks in 'n Bèd zeen óm de naach te laote veurbiegaon.

source_string: If your Bed is broken you will return to where you first spawned into the world.
translation: Es diech Bèd kapot is, geis te terug nao wo doe de ieste kier in de waereld spawnde.

source_string: Be careful when using a Bed in the Nether, it's usually too hot to sleep.
translation: Wees veurzichtig mèt 'n Bèd in de Nether te gebroeke, 't is doa mieëst te heit óm te sjlaope.

source_string: A soft bed lets you sleep through the night. You'll need wool to craft one, as well as a safe spot to place it.
translation: 'n Zach bèd laet diech door de naach sjlaope. Doe höbs wol noedig óm ein te craften, en ouch 'n veilige plaats óm 't te zette.

source_string: Sleeping in a bed will also set your §espawn point§f, meaning that if you die, you'll reappear right back home!
translation: Sjlaope in 'n bèd zèt ouch diech §espawnpunt§f, wat wil zègge det es doe sjterfs, doe direk weer thoes erschiens!

source_string: You can only fall asleep when it's cozy, like when it's nighttime or during a thunderstorm.
translation: Doe kans allein in sjlaop valle es 't gezellig is, wie 's naachs of tiedens 'n ónjerweer.

source_string: The world of Minecraft is made from millions of blocks. Each one is breakable, collectable, and placeable. There are almost no limits to what you can build!
translation: De waereld vaan Minecraft is gemaak vaan mieljoene blokke. Eder ein is breekbaar, verzamelbaar en plaotsbaar. D'r zeen biena gein limiete aan waat doe kans bouwe!

source_string: Most blocks you will have to find in the world, but some can only be crafted such as combining other blocks on a crafting table like a Redstone Block or smelted in a furnace like Glass.
translation: De mieste blokke moots te in de waereld vènje, mer sómmige könne allein gecraft wure zoeas 't combinere vaan angere blokke op 'n werkbank wie 'n Redstoneblok of gesmoltje in 'n oven wie glaas.

source_string: Most blocks are not affected by gravity and can float in mid air, but some like Sand and Gravel, will fall if there is no block underneath them.
translation: De mieste blokke wure neet beïnvlood door graviteit en könne in de loeft zweve, mer sómmige zoeas zand en gruus valle es d'r gein blok ónjer hun is.

source_string: Here are some examples of the more interesting blocks in Minecraft:
translation: Hie zeen get veurbeelde vaan de interessantere blokke in Minecraft:

source_string: §eGlass§f - This is a transparent block that is made by smelting Sand in a Furnace.
translation: §eGlaas§f - Dit is 'n doorzichtig blok gemaak door zand te smöltje in 'ne oven.

source_string: §eConcrete§f - This is made by dropping a Concrete Powder block into water.
translation: §eBeton§f - Dit is gemaak door 'ne betonpoeder-blok in water te legge.

source_string: §eTerracotta§f - This is found naturally in Badlands biomes or can be crafted and dyed from Clay that is found underwater. Terracotta can be made into Glazed Terracotta by smelting it in a Furnace.
translation: §eTerracotta§f - Dit wuurt natuurlik gevónje in Badlands-biomes of kan gecraft en gekleurd wure vaan klei die ónjer water gevónje wuurt. Terracotta kan glazuurd wure door 't in 'ne oven te smöltje.

source_string: §eMagma Block§f - This is found naturally in the Nether, it gives off a little light and will burn whoever steps on it.
translation: §eMagmablok§f - Dit wuurt natuurlik in de Nether gevónje, 't geuf get licht en verbrant wieë d'rop treet.

source_string: §eCoarse Dirt§f - This is almost like a normal Dirt block but Grass can't grow on it. It can be found in Windswept Savanna and Old Growth Taiga biomes.
translation: §eGroffe grónj§f - Dit is biena wie 'ne normale grónjblok mer graas kan d'rop neet groeie. Te vènje in Windswept Savanna- en Old Growth Taiga-biomes.

source_string: The Book and Quill lets you record your adventures. Tell your story by entering text into the pages. You can even change the title and the author! Sign the Book and Quill to finalize your work. The Book and Quill will be editable until it is signed.
translation: De Book en Pen laet diech diech aoventuure vaastlègge. Vertel diech verhaol door tekst in te vöre op de bladzieë. Doe kans zelfs de titel en de auteur veranderen! Zèt diech naam ónjer de Book en Pen óm diech werk aaf te ronde. De Book en Pen kan bewerk wure totdet 'm ondertekend is.

source_string: Brewing potions requires a Brewing Stand. Every potion starts off with a bottle of water, which is made by filling a Glass Bottle with water from a Cauldron or water source.
translation: Brouwe vaan drankjes hèt 'ne Brouwstandaard noedig. Eder drankje begint mèt 'n fles water, gemaak door 'n Glaasfles te vulle mèt water vaan 'n Ketel of waterbrón.

source_string: A Brewing Stand has three slots for creating different potions. One ingredient can be used over all three bottles, so always brew three potions at the same time to best use your resources.
translation: 'n Brouwstandaard hèt drei sleuve veur 't make vaan versjillendje drankjes. Ein ingredient kan euver alle drei fleske gebroek wure, dus brouw altied drei drankjes gelieks óm diech grónjstoffe optimaal te gebroeke.

source_string: Putting Nether Wart in the top position of the Brewing Stand will give you an Awkward Potion. This doesn't have any effect by itself, but creates a base potion that can be used to create more advanced potions.
translation: 't Zette vaan Netherwort in de boavepositie vaan de Brouwstandaard geuf diech 'n Óngemaklik drankje. Dit hèt op zichzelf gein effek, mer maak 'ne basisdrankje die gebroek kan wure óm mie geaovaanceerdje drankjes te make.

source_string: There are many potion effects to discover, experiment with different ingredients and combinations to become a true alchemist.
translation: D'r zeen väöl drankjeseffekte te ontdèkke, experimenteer mèt versjillendje ingredienten en kombinaties óm 'ne echte alchemist te wure.

source_string: How to Play: Building a Shelter
When danger comes lurking, a sturdy §eshelter§f can protect you from the threats outside.
translation: Es 't gevaor lourt, kan 'n sterke §eschuulplaats§f diech besjerme tegen de dreiginge daobuite.

source_string: Building a shelter is critical to surviving your first night, and it doesn't have to be hard.
translation: 'n Schuulplaats bouwe is krities veur 't euverleve vaan diech ieste naach, en 't moot neet moeilik zeen.

source_string: You can build one with anything from dirt to stone, or even close up a cave for a makeshift lodging!
translation: Doe kans ein bouwe mèt alles vaan grónj tot sjtein, of zelfs 'n gröt aafsjluute veur 'n behelpshuisvesting!

source_string: The Cauldron is a container that can hold buckets or bottles of liquid.
translation: De Ketel is 'ne container die emmere of fleske vloeistof kan haode.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Cauldron while holding a Bucket of Water or a Potion to fill the Cauldron with its contents.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op 'n Ketel terwiel doe 'ne Emmer Water of 'n Drankje vashaods óm de Ketel te vulle mèt de inhaod.

source_string: Tap a Cauldron while holding a Bucket of Water or a Potion to fill the Cauldron with its contents.
translation: Tik 'n Ketel terwiel doe 'ne Emmer Water of 'n Drankje vashaods óm de Ketel te vulle mèt de inhaod.

source_string: A Potion will only partially fill a Cauldron so you will have to use multiple Potions to fill it up completely.
translation: 'n Drankje vult 'n Ketel allein deelwies, dus moots te mieër Drankjes gebroeke óm 'm ganskelik te vulle.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Cauldron with your Arrow in hand to create all kinds of different arrows!
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op 'n Ketel mèt diech piel in de han óm allerhande versjillendje piele te make!

source_string: Tap a Cauldron with your Arrow in hand to create all kinds of different arrows!
translation: Tik 'n Ketel mèt diech piel in de han óm allerhande versjillendje piele te make!

source_string: To dye Leather Armor or Leather Horse Armor, press :_input_key.use: on a Cauldron filled with water while holding the desired dye. This will change the color of the water inside of the Cauldron. Then dip your armor into the Cauldron by pressing :_input_key.use: with armor in your hand.
translation: Óm Leer-pantser of Leer-perdepantser te kleure, druk :_input_key.use: op 'n Ketel gevuld mèt water terwiel doe de gewenste kleurstof vashaods. Dit verandert de kluer vaan 't water in de Ketel. Doop dan diech pantser in de Ketel door :_input_key.use: te drökke mèt pantser in diech han.

source_string: To dye Leather Armor or Leather Horse Armor, tap a Cauldron filled with water while holding the desired dye. This will change the color of the water inside of the Cauldron. Then dip your armor into the Cauldron by tapping the Cauldron with the armor in your hand.
translation: Óm Leer-pantser of Leer-perdepantser te kleure, tik 'n Ketel gevuld mèt water terwiel doe de gewenste kleurstof vashaods. Dit verandert de kluer vaan 't water in de Ketel. Doop dan diech pantser in de Ketel door de Ketel aan te tikke mèt 't pantser in diech han.

source_string: If you want to wash the dye off, dip the dyed item into a Cauldron of undyed Water.
translation: Es doe de kleurstof wils aafwasse, doop de gekleurdje item in 'n Ketel mèt ongekleurd water.

source_string: Press :_input_key.chat: to open Chat. Type your message and press ENTER.
translation: Druk :_input_key.chat: óm de Chat te ëpene. Tik diech bericht en druk ENTER.

source_string: Press :_input_key.chat: to open Chat. Type your message and press the send button.
translation: Druk :_input_key.chat: óm de Chat te ëpene. Tik diech bericht en druk de zendknop.

source_string: Tap the chat button to open Chat. Type your message and tap the send button.
translation: Tik de chatknop óm de Chat te ëpene. Tik diech bericht en tik de zendknop.

source_string: Once you have crafted a Chest, you can place it in the world and then open it with :_input_key.use: to store items from your inventory.
translation: Ins te 'n Kis gecraft höbs, kans te 'm in de waereld plaotse en dan mèt :_input_key.use: ëpene óm items vaan diech inventaris op te sjlage.

source_string: Once you have crafted a Chest, you can place it in the world and then tap to open it and store items from your inventory.
translation: Ins te 'n Kis gecraft höbs, kans te 'm in de waereld plaotse en dan tikke óm 'm te ëpene en items vaan diech inventaris op te sjlage.

source_string: Items in the Chest will be stored there for you to put into your inventory later.
translation: Items in de Kis wure doa opgeslage totdet doe ze later in diech inventaris zets.

source_string: Two Chests placed next to each other will be combined to form a Large Chest.
translation: Twee Kiste naeve elkander geplaats wure gecombineerd tot 'n Grote Kis.

source_string: Command Blocks are a powerful tool for map creators. They store and execute commands upon receiving a Redstone signal.
translation: Opdrachblokke zeen 'n krachtig gereedsjap veur kaartmakers. Zie sjlage opdrachte op en veure ze oet bié 't kriege vaan 'n Redstonesignaal.

source_string: To get a command block you must use /give.
translation: Óm 'n opdrachblok te kriege moots te /give gebroeke.

source_string: When a Command Block has either executed or failed to execute its stored command, it sends a Redstone signal from the side where the arrow is pointing.
translation: Es 'n Opdrachblok zieng opgeslagje opdrach hèt oetgeveuerd of dit neet is geluk, zendt 't 'n Redstonesignaal vaan de zie wo de piel nao wiest.

source_string: You can set the name of the Command Block in the Hover Note field.
translation: Doe kans de naam vaan 't Opdrachblok instelle in 't Hover Note-veld.

source_string: §eBlock Type§f - There are three types of Command Blocks, each with their own color and behavior:
translation: §eBloktype§f - D'r zeen drei types opdrachblokke, eder mèt zieng eige kluer en gedraog:

source_string: §eImpulse§f - Only executes the stored command when the block receives a redstone signal.
translation: §eImpuls§f - Veurt allein de opgeslagje opdrach oet es 't blok 'n redstonesignaal ontvangt.

source_string: §eChain§f - Executes the stored command when the Command Block behind it has or has not executed its command.
translation: §eKette§f - Veurt de opgeslagje opdrach oet es 't Opdrachblok d'rachter zieng opdrach heet oetgeveuerd of neet.

source_string: §eRepeat§f - Once activated, this Command Block will continue executing its stored command as long as it exists.
translation: §eHerhaol§f - Ins geaktiveerd, blieft dit Opdrachblok zieng opgeslagje opdrach oetveure zolang 't besjteet.

source_string: §eCondition§f - There are two conditions, each will affect the behavior of the Command Block:
translation: §eVeurwaerde§f - D'r zeen twee veurwaerde, eder beïnvlood 't gedraog vaan 't Opdrachblok:

source_string: §eUnconditional§f - Executes the stored command even if the Command Block behind it failed to execute its command.
translation: §eOnveurwaerdelik§f - Veurt de opgeslagje opdrach oet zelfs es 't Opdrachblok d'rachter zieng opdrach neet heet oetgeveuerd.

source_string: §eConditional§f - Only executes the stored command if the Command Block behind it succeeded in executing its command.
translation: §eVeurwaerdelik§f - Veurt de opgeslagje opdrach allein oet es 't Opdrachblok d'rachter zieng opdrach heet geluk.

source_string: §eRedstone§f - There are two redstone settings, each will affect the behavior of the Command Block:
translation: §eRedstone§f - D'r zeen twee redstone-insjtellinge, eder beïnvlood 't gedraog vaan 't Opdrachblok:

source_string: §eNeeds Redstone§f - Requires a redstone signal to activate.
translation: §eRedstone noedig§f - Vereist 'n redstonesignaal óm te aktiveere.

source_string: §eAlways Active§f - Does not require a redstone signal to activate.
translation: §eAltied aktief§f - Vereist gein redstonesignaal óm te aktiveere.

source_string: A Command Block will also show you its previous output. This will help you figure out if a Command Block failed to execute its command and why.
translation: 'n Opdrachblok wies te ouch zieng vörege oetvoer. Dit hölpt te ontdèkke of 'n Opdrachblok mislök is en waoróm.

source_string: Commands can be executed from Chat. Type / before you type the command.
translation: Opdrachte könne oetgeveuerd wure vaanoet de Chat. Tik / veurdet doe de opdrach intiks.

source_string: There are multitudes of commands that will allow you to do amazing things. There are many sources out there that will provide you with all of the info that you'll ever need.
translation: D'r zeen väöl opdrachte die diech laote geweldige zaake doon. D'r zeen väöl brónne die diech alle info gaeve die doe ëver noedig zols höbbe.

source_string: An active Conduit gives you powers when you are underwater and when it rains.
translation: 'n Aktief krachtban geuf diech krachte es te ónjerwater bis en es 't rejent.

source_string: A Conduit is crafted with Nautilus Shells and a Heart of the Sea. The Conduit draws power from Prismarine and Sea Lanterns.
translation: 'n Krachtban is gecraft mèt Nautilusschèlpe en 'n Hert vaan de Zee. De Krachtban haolt zieng kraf oet Prismarine en Zeelantaerns.

source_string: Once activated, a Conduit will grant Conduit Power to anything nearby.
translation: Ins geaktiveerd, geuf 'n krachtban Krachtbankraf aan alles in de omgeving.

source_string: The more power it draws in, the further its abilities reach.
translation: Hoe mie kraf 't oettrèkt, hoe wieder zieng krachte raeke.

source_string: How to Play: Crafting a Tool
§eTools§f help you get things done faster. Some, like the §epickaxe§f:wood_pickaxe: , let you mine stone and various ores. Others, like the §esword§f:wood_sword: , help you keep enemies at bay.
translation: §eGereedsjap§f hölpt diech zaake sjneller te doon. Sómmige, wie de §epikhouwel§f:wood_pickaxe: , late diech sjtein en versjillendje ërts mine. Angere, wie 't §esjweerd§f:wood_sword: , helpe diech vijande op aafstand te haode.

source_string: To craft a tool, open up your §ecrafting table§f:crafting_table: by walking up to it and right-clicking it. You can craft a basic version of most tools using two sticks and a few planks - your §erecipe book§f will tell you how!
translation: Óm 'ne gereedsjap te craften, ëpen diech §ewerkbank§f:crafting_table: door d'r nao toe te loupe en rechs op 'm te klikke. Doe kans 'n basisversie vaan de mieste gereedsjap craften mèt twee sjtökskes en get plankjes - diech §ereceptebook§f zal diech zègge wie!

source_string: To craft a tool, open up your §ecrafting table§f:crafting_table: by walking up to it and pressing :_input_key.use:. You can craft a basic version of most tools using two sticks and a few planks - your §erecipe book§f will tell you how!
translation: Óm 'ne gereedsjap te craften, ëpen diech §ewerkbank§f:crafting_table: door d'r nao toe te loupe en :_input_key.use: te drökke. Doe kans 'n basisversie vaan de mieste gereedsjap craften mèt twee sjtökskes en get plankjes - diech §ereceptebook§f zal diech zègge wie!

source_string: To craft a tool, open up your §ecrafting table§f:crafting_table: by walking up to it and tapping it. You can craft a basic version of most tools using two sticks and a few planks - your §erecipe book§f will tell you how!
translation: Óm 'ne gereedsjap te craften, ëpen diech §ewerkbank§f:crafting_table: door d'r nao toe te loupe en d'rop te tikke. Doe kans 'n basisversie vaan de mieste gereedsjap craften mèt twee sjtökskes en get plankjes - diech §ereceptebook§f zal diech zègge wie!

source_string: To place or use certain Minecraft Education blocks or items, a player must possess a special ability called 'World Builder'.
translation: Óm bepaaldje Minecraft Education-blokke of items te plaotse of te gebroeke, moot 'ne sjpeler 'n speciael abiliteit höbbe die 'Waereldbouwer' heet.

source_string: With cheats activated, the host can enable or disable the World Builder ability for any players in the world.
translation: Mèt cheats geaktiveerd, kan de host de Waereldbouwer-abiliteit veur eder sjpeler in de waereld in- of oetsjakele.

source_string: To grant World Builder ability to all players in the world, run the following command:
translation: Óm de Waereldbouwer-abiliteit aan alle sjpelers in de waereld te gaeve, veur de volgendje opdrach oet:

source_string: To quickly toggle your own World Builder ability, run either of the following commands:
translation: Óm sjnel diech eige Waereldbouwer-abiliteit te toggele, veur ein vaan de volgendje opdrachte oet:

source_string: To query your World Builder ability, run the following command:
translation: Óm diech Waereldbouwer-abiliteit op te vraoge, veur de volgendje opdrach oet:

source_string: Minecraft Education features several special blocks that make it easier for teachers to create and employ lessons. Only players with World Builder ability can place and destroy these blocks. Only players without World Builder ability are subject to the restrictions imposed by these blocks.
translation: Minecraft Education bevat versjillendje speciael blokke die 't maekkeliker make veur leraers óm lèsse te make en toe te passe. Allein sjpelers mèt de Waereldbouwer-abiliteit könne dees blokke plaotse en vernaetege. Allein sjpelers zónger de Waereldbouwer-abiliteit zeen ónjerworpe aan de beperkinge deur dees blokke opgeleg.

source_string: Allow and Deny blocks control where players can build in a world.
translation: Toestaon- en Weigereblokke beheerse wo sjpelers in 'n waereld könne bouwe.

source_string: Players can place or destroy blocks above Allow blocks. Players cannot place or destroy blocks above Deny blocks.
translation: Sjpelers könne blokke plaotse of vernaetege boave Toestaonblokke. Sjpelers könne gein blokke plaotse of vernaetege boave Weigereblokke.

source_string: Allow and Deny blocks do not affect the area below them.
translation: Toestaon- en Weigereblokke beïnvlöde 't gebeed d'ronjer neet.

source_string: An Allow block with a Deny block somewhere below it prevents players from building in the space between the two blocks. Above the Allow block, players can place and destroy blocks.
translation: 'n Toestaonblok mèt 'n Weigereblok d'ronjer verhinderd sjpelers óm te bouwe in de ruimde tösje de twee blokke. Boave 't Toestaonblok könne sjpelers blokke plaotse en vernaetege.

source_string: Border blocks provide a force field that extends infinitely upward and downward, regardless of the presence of other blocks. Players cannot move through, over, or under a Border block. Players cannot place or destroy blocks that are above or below a Border block.
translation: Grensblokke gaeve 'n kraftveld det ónbeperk naor boave en ónjer doorgeet, ongeach de aanwezigheid vaan angere blokke. Sjpelers könne neet door, euver of ónjer 'n Grensblok bewaege. Sjpelers könne gein blokke plaotse of vernaetege die boave of ónjer 'n Grensblok zeen.

source_string: Minecraft is a §emultiplayer§f game by default.
Every new world you create starts with multiplayer enabled. If you want to make it §eprivate§f, go to World Settings to turn off multiplayer.
translation: Eder nuuj waereld deste maaks, begint mèt multiplayer aan. Es doe 't §eprivaat§f wils make, gank nao Waereldinsjtellinge óm multiplayer oet te zette.

source_string: To play with others, go to the §eFriends tab§f to see all available Realms, Friends, and LAN games. Just select any game to join it.
translation: Óm mèt angere te sjpele, gank nao 't §eVrunjetabblad§f óm alle besjikbaar Realms, Vrunj, en LAN-sjpelle te zeen. Selekteer gewoen eder sjpel óm 't binne te gaon.

source_string: When you start or join an online game, your friends can see this in their Friends tab. If they join, it'll be visible to their friends as well.
translation: Es doe 'n online sjpel begins of binnegeis, könne diech vrunj dit zeen in hun Vrunjetabblad. Es zie binnegaon, is 't ouch zichtbaar veur hun vrunj.

source_string: You need to be signed in to a §eMicrosoft account§f with an active internet connection to play multiplayer.
translation: Doe moots ingelogd zeen op 'ne §eMicrosoft-account§f mèt 'ne aktief internetverbènjing óm multiplayer te sjpele.

source_string: Realms - The best way to play together
translation: Realms - De beste manier óm samen te sjpele

source_string: It's easy to play with friends using §eRealms§f.
translation: 't Is maekkelik óm mèt vrunj te sjpele mèt §eRealms§f.

source_string: You and up to 10 friends get 24/7 access to a world that's always online. Explore, get creative, or try curated content from Marketplace.
translation: Doe en tot 10 vrunj kriege 24/7 toegang tot 'n waereld die altied online is. Ontdèk, wees creatief, of probeer gecureerdje content vaan Marketplace.

source_string: All you need is a paid Realms subscription. Why not try a free 30-day trial?
translation: Alles waat doe noedig höbs, is 'ne betaald Realms-abonnement. Probeer 'ne gratis proefpeeriod vaan 30 daag?

source_string: You decide what people can do in your world by changing §eplayer permissions§f.
translation: Doe besjeis waat lui könne doon in diech waereld door §esjpelerpermissies§f te veranderen.

source_string: Open the game menu to see a list of players currently in your world, then select the permissions icon to adjust that player's permissions.
translation: Ëpen 't sjpelmenu óm 'n lieste te zeen vaan sjpelers die op dit moment in diech waereld zeen, en selekteer dan 't permissie-icoon óm de permissies vaan die sjpeler aan te passe.
Meld diech aan óm Realms te probeere

source_string: Chalkboards are used to display text in the world. Chalkboards display more text than Signs, can be edited after they have been placed, and come in three sizes: Slate, Poster, and Board. The lock toggle allows you to prevent non-World Builders from destroying or editing your chalkboards. Press :_input_key.use: on an existing chalkboard to edit it.
translation: Sjriefborde wure gebroek óm tekst in de waereld te wieze. Sjriefborde wieze mie tekst es Bordjes, könne bewerk wure nao det zie geplaats zeen, en kómme in drei groette: Leie, Poster, en Bord. De sloetsjakelaar laet diech verhindere det neet-Waereldbouwers diech sjriefborde vernaetege of bewerke. Druk :_input_key.use: op 'n besjtaond sjriefbord óm 't te bewerke.

source_string: Chalkboards are used to display text in the world. Chalkboards display more text than Signs, can be edited after they have been placed, and come in three sizes: Slate, Poster, and Board. The lock toggle allows you to prevent non-World Builders from destroying or editing your chalkboards. Tap an existing chalkboard to edit it.
translation: Sjriefborde wure gebroek óm tekst in de waereld te wieze. Sjriefborde wieze mie tekst es Bordjes, könne bewerk wure nao det zie geplaats zeen, en kómme in drei groette: Leie, Poster, en Bord. De sloetsjakelaar laet diech verhindere det neet-Waereldbouwers diech sjriefborde vernaetege of bewerke. Tik 'n besjtaond sjriefbord óm 't te bewerke.

source_string: Students can simulate real world chemistry by using the Chemistry Equipment blocks. Build any of the 118 different elements by adjusting the sliders in the Element Constructor or view the composition of elements by placing them in the Element Constructor. Combine elements in the Compound Creator to produce chemical compounds. Put elements and compounds into the Lab Table to create Minecraft items. Reduce blocks to their component elements with the Material Reducer.
translation: Studente könne echte chemie simuleere door de Chemie-appearatuurblokke te gebroeke. Bouw eder vaan de 118 versjillendje elemente door de sjuivers in de Elementopbouwer aan te passe of bekiek de samestelling vaan elemente door ze in de Elementopbouwer te plaotse. Combineer elemente in de Combinatiemaker óm chemische verbindinge te make. Zèt elemente en verbindinge in de Labtafel óm Minecraft-items te make. Herleej blokke tot hunne elemente mèt de Materiaalreducer.

source_string: Download the Chemistry Journal from the Minecraft Education website for a comprehensive guide to chemistry in Minecraft.
translation: Download 't Chemiejournaal vaan de Minecraft Education-website veur 'n compleet gids euver chemie in Minecraft.

source_string: NPCs are non-player characters that can provide additional lesson information, hints, or instructions.
translation: NPC's zeen neet-sjpeler-personages die extra lèsinfo, tips, of instructies könne gaeve.

source_string: Only World Builders can place, delete, name, or edit NPCs. NPCs can execute commands and link to websites. Commands can be assigned to buttons in the NPC's dialog window; website links will always have a button.
translation: Allein Waereldbouwers könne NPC's plaotse, verwiedere, herneume, of bewerke. NPC's könne opdrachte oetveure en linke nao websites. Opdrachte könne toegewezen wure aan knöppe in 't dialoogvinster vaan de NPC; websitelinks höbbe altied 'n knop.

source_string: NPCs have a variety of skins to choose from and are immobile.
translation: NPC's höbbe 'n verscheidenheid aan skins en zeen onbewaeglik.

source_string: The Camera allows players to take pictures in the world.
translation: De Camera laet sjpelers foto's make in de waereld.

source_string: To take a picture from your point of view, press :_input_key.use:.
translation: Óm 'n foto te make vaanoet diech eigen perspectief, druk :_input_key.use:.

source_string: To take a picture from your point of view, tap and hold, then release.
translation: Óm 'n foto te make vaanoet diech eigen perspectief, tik en haod vas, en loas dan los.

source_string: To take a selfie, place a camera and press :_input_key.use: on it.
translation: Óm 'n selfie te make, plaots 'n camera en druk :_input_key.use: d'rop.

source_string: To take a selfie, place a camera and tap the Take Picture button.
translation: Óm 'n selfie te make, plaots 'n camera en tik op de Foto make-knop.

source_string: Pictures can be viewed in the Portfolio or inserted into the Book and Quill.
translation: Foto's könne bekeke wure in de Portfolio of ingeveug wure in de Book en Pen.

source_string: Pictures you have taken appear in the Portfolio. Press :_input_key.use: to view the Portfolio. When viewing the Portfolio, you can add captions to pictures, delete pictures, and export pictures as a PDF.
translation: Foto's deste gemaak höbs, erschiene in de Portfolio. Druk :_input_key.use: óm de Portfolio te bekieke. Bij 't bekieke vaan de Portfolio kans te ondertitels toevoege aan foto's, foto's verwiedere, en foto's exporteere es PDF.

source_string: Pictures you have taken appear in the Portfolio. Tap and hold to view the Portfolio. When viewing the Portfolio, you can add captions to pictures, delete pictures, and export pictures as a PDF.
translation: Foto's deste gemaak höbs, erschiene in de Portfolio. Tik en haod vas óm de Portfolio te bekieke. Bij 't bekieke vaan de Portfolio kans te ondertitels toevoege aan foto's, foto's verwiedere, en foto's exporteere es PDF.

source_string: Classroom Mode is an external application that provides educators with features designed to facilitate interaction with students. You can download Classroom Mode from the Minecraft Education website.
translation: Klassenmodus is 'n externe applicatie die docente functies geuf óm interactie mèt studente te faciliteere. Doe kans Klassenmodus downloade vaan de Minecraft Education-website.

source_string: As the host of a world, use the command /classroommode to launch the Classroom Mode app and connect it to Minecraft Education.
translation: Es host vaan 'n waereld, gebroek de opdrach /classroommode óm de Klassenmodus-app te opestarte en te verbènje mèt Minecraft Education.

source_string: Code Builder allows players to explore, create, and play in Minecraft by writing code using familiar learn-to-code platforms.
translation: Code Builder laet sjpelers ontdèkke, make, en sjpele in Minecraft door code te sjrieve mèt bekendje leer-code-platforms.

source_string: Launch Code Builder by pressing :_input_key.codeBuilder: or by using the command /code.
translation: Opestarte Code Builder door :_input_key.codeBuilder: te drökke of door de opdrach /code te gebroeke.

source_string: Launch Code Builder by tapping :code_builder_button: or by using the command /code.
translation: Opestarte Code Builder door :code_builder_button: te tikke of door de opdrach /code te gebroeke.

source_string: The Crafting Table will let you craft more complicated recipes.
translation: De Werkbank laet diech complexere receptes craften.

source_string: Place it in the world, then press :_input_key.use: on the Crafting Table to use it.
translation: Plaots 'm in de waereld, en druk dan :_input_key.use: op de Werkbank óm 'm te gebroeke.

source_string: Place it in the world, then tap the Crafting Table to use it.
translation: Plaots 'm in de waereld, en tik dan op de Werkbank óm 'm te gebroeke.

source_string: Creative Mode is there so you can build the land of your dreams mob free!
translation: Creativemodus is er zoedet doe 't land vaan diech drome kans bouwe, zónger mobs!

source_string: The creative mode interface allows any item in the game to be moved into the player's inventory without the need for mining or crafting the item. The items in the player's inventory will not be removed when they are placed or used in the world, and this allows the player to focus on building rather than resource gathering.
translation: De creativemodus-interface laet eder item in 't sjpel nao de inventaris vaan de sjpeler versjuve zónger de noedigheid óm 't te mine of te craften. De items in de inventaris vaan de sjpeler wure neet verwiederd es zie geplaats of gebroek wure in de waereld, en dit laet de sjpeler focusse op bouwe in plaots vaan resourceverzamelen.

source_string: If you create, load, or save a world in Creative Mode, that world will have achievements and leaderboard updates disabled, even if it is then loaded in Survival Mode.
translation: Es doe 'n waereld maaks, laads, of opsjlags in Creativemodus, zal die waereld prestaties en klassementupdates oetgesjakeld höbbe, ouch es 't later in Survivalmodus gelaje wuurt.

source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, press :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, push :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession or press :_input_key.sprint: while flying. When in flying mode, you can hold down :_input_key.jump: to move up and :_input_key.sneak: to move down.
translation: Óm te vlege in Creativemodus, druk :_input_key.jump: twee kier sjnel. Óm te stoppe mèt vlege, herhaol dees aktie. Óm sjneller te vlege, druk :_input_key.forward: twee kier sjnel op eerivölgend of druk :_input_key.sprint: terwiel te vlegs. In vligmodus kans te :_input_key.jump: ingedrök haode óm boave te gaon en :_input_key.sneak: óm nao ónjer te gaon.

source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, press :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward twice in rapid succession while flying. When in flying mode, you can hold down :_input_key.jump: to move up and :_input_key.sneak: to move down.
translation: Óm te vlege in Creativemodus, druk :_input_key.jump: twee kier sjnel. Óm te stoppe mèt vlege, herhaol dees aktie. Óm sjneller te vlege, druk :_gamepad_stick_left: veuruut twee kier sjnel op eerivölgend terwiel te vlegs. In vligmodus kans te :_input_key.jump: ingedrök haode óm boave te gaon en :_input_key.sneak: óm nao ónjer te gaon.

source_string: To fly tap :tip_virtual_button_jump: twice quickly, and to stop flying tap :tip_virtual_button_fly_down: twice quickly.
translation: Óm te vlege tik :tip_virtual_button_jump: twee kier sjnel, en óm te stoppe mèt vlege tik :tip_virtual_button_fly_down: twee kier sjnel.

source_string: Tap :tip_virtual_button_sprint: to fly faster. To fly up tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_fly_up:, and to fly down tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_fly_down:.
translation: Tik :tip_virtual_button_sprint: óm sjneller te vlege. Óm nao boave te vlege tik en haod vas :tip_virtual_button_fly_up:, en óm nao ónjer te vlege tik en haod vas :tip_virtual_button_fly_down:.

source_string: To fly tap :touch_jump: twice quickly, and to stop flying tap :touch_stop_flying: twice quickly.
translation: Óm te vlege tik :touch_jump: twee kier sjnel, en óm te stoppe mèt vlege tik :touch_stop_flying: twee kier sjnel.

source_string: Tap :touch_forward: twice quickly to fly faster. To fly up tap and hold :touch_fly_up:, and to fly down tap and hold :touch_fly_down:.
translation: Tik :touch_forward: twee kier sjnel óm sjneller te vlege. Óm nao boave te vlege tik en haod vas :touch_fly_up:, en óm nao ónjer te vlege tik en haod vas :touch_fly_down:.

source_string: How to Play: Death and Respawn
translation: Wie te sjpele: Sjterve en herrieze

source_string: Enemies appear every night, and even the best of us can be caught off guard. If your §ehealth bar§f:heart: runs out, you'll die - and then respawn right where you started!
translation: Vijande erschiene eder naach, en zelfs de beste vaan os könne besjeide wure. Es diech §egezóndheidsbalk§f:heart: op is, sjterfs te - en herrieze dan wo doe begós!

source_string: You have unlimited lives, but you drop all items in your inventory when you die. If you're quick enough, you can pick your items back up right where you dropped them.
translation: Doe höbs onbeperk lieve, mer doe verlees alle items in diech inventaris es doe sjterfs. Es doe sjnel genóg bis, kans te diech items terug oppikke wo doe ze verlore höbs.

source_string: Minecraft has varying levels of difficulty so you can tailor the game to your level.
translation: Minecraft hèt versjillendje niveaus vaan moeilikheidsgraad zoedet doe 't sjpel op diech niveau kans aanpasse.

source_string: No hostile mobs will spawn except for shulkers and the Ender Dragon, but they won't do any damage to you.
translation: Gein vijandige mobs spawne, buiten shulkers en de Ender Dragon, mer zie doon diech gein schade.

source_string: Hostile mobs spawn but deal less damage. Hunger bar depletes and drains health down to 5 hearts.
translation: Vijandige mobs spawne mer doon minder schade. Hongerbalk droogt oet en drainere gezóndheid tot 5 hertjes.

source_string: Hostile mobs will do normal damage, and if your hunger level drops to zero your health will begin to drop, but you won't die.
translation: Vijandige mobs doon normaal schade, en es diech hongerniveau nao nul zakkt, begint diech gezóndheid te dale, mer doe sjterfs neet.

source_string: Hostile mobs will do more damage, zombies will break through doors, and if your hunger level drops to zero, your health will drop and you could die.
translation: Vijandige mobs doon mie schade, zombies breke door duere, en es diech hongerniveau nao nul zakkt, valt diech gezóndheid en kans te sjterve.

source_string: Dispensers are used to shoot out items. You will need to power each Dispenser with a redstone signal (for example, with a lever) to trigger it.
translation: Dispensers wure gebroek óm items oet te sjete. Doe moots eder Dispenser mèt 'n redstonesignaal (bijveurbeeld mèt 'ne haaindel) van kraf voorzien óm 'm te trigere.

source_string: To fill a Dispenser with items, press :_input_key.use: on the Dispenser, then move the items that you want to dispense from your inventory to the Dispenser.
translation: Óm 'ne Dispenser mèt items te vulle, druk :_input_key.use: op de Dispenser, en versjuif dan de items deste wils oetsjete vaan diech inventaris nao de Dispenser.

source_string: To fill a Dispenser, tap the Dispenser, then move the items that you want to dispense from your inventory into the Dispenser.
translation: Óm 'ne Dispenser te vulle, tik de Dispenser, en versjuif dan de items deste wils oetsjete vaan diech inventaris nao de Dispenser.

source_string: Whenever you power a Dispenser, an item will shoot out.
translation: Eder kier deste 'ne Dispenser vaan kraf veurzeens, sjeet 'n item d'roet.

source_string: Dispensers can also be used to place items as well, such as Pumpkins on Iron Golems and equipment on Armor Stands.
translation: Dispensers könne ouch gebroek wure óm items te plaotse, zoeas Pompoene op Iezere Golems en oetröstinge op Pantserrekke.

source_string: When powered by Redstone, Droppers will drop a single random item contained within. Press :_input_key.use: on the Dropper to open it and then you can load it with items from your inventory.
translation: Es 'n Dropper vaan Redstone vaan kraf veurzeen wuurt, laot 'm 'n eenkelvoudig raandóm item d'rin valle. Druk :_input_key.use: op de Dropper óm 'm te ëpene en dan kans te 'm vulle mèt items vaan diech inventaris.

source_string: When powered by Redstone, Droppers will drop a single random item contained within. Tap the Dropper to open it and then you can load it with items from your inventory.
translation: Es 'n Dropper vaan Redstone vaan kraf veurzeen wuurt, laot 'm 'n eenkelvoudig raandóm item d'rin valle. Tik de Dropper óm 'm te ëpene en dan kans te 'm vulle mèt items vaan diech inventaris.

source_string: If a Dropper is facing a Chest or another type of container, the item will be placed into that instead. Long chains of Droppers can be constructed to transport items over a distance.
translation: Es 'ne Dropper naor 'n Kis of 'n angere type container wiest, wuurt 't item doa in geplaats. Lang kette vaan Droppers könne gebauwd wure óm items euver 'n aafstand te transporteere.

source_string: Dye is used to change the color of many things in Minecraft.
translation: Kleurstof wuurt gebroek óm de kluer vaan väöl zaake in Minecraft te veranderen.

source_string: Some Dye materials are harder to find than others. Most Dyes can be crafted from flowers, like §eRed Dye§f from a Poppy, but some Dyes are found or created in more obscure ways such as:
translation: Sómmige kleurstofmaterialen zeen moeiliker te vènje es angere. De mieste kleurstöffe könne gecraft wure vaan bluume, wie §eRoje kleurstof§f vaan 'n papavier, mer sómmige kleurstöffe wure gevónje of gemaak op mie obscuurdje maniere zoeas:

source_string: §eBlue Dye§f - Mining Lapis Lazuli deep underground
translation: §eBlauwe kleurstof§f - Lapis lazuli mine deep ónjer de grónj

source_string: §eBlack Dye§f - Collecting Ink Sacs from Squids
§eBrown Dye§f - Harvesting Cocoa Beans in the Jungle
translation: §eBroeng kleurstof§f - Cacaobiëne oesde in de jóngel

source_string: Elytra are an item that can be equipped to allow gliding. Elytra are equipped in the chest armor slot.
translation: Elytra zeen 'n item detste kans draoge óm te gliede. Elytra wure gedraoge in de borstpantsersleuf.

source_string: Elytra cannot be crafted, but are found in Item Frames in rare End Ships, guarded by fearsome Shulkers.
translation: Elytra könne neet gecraft wure, mer wure gevónje in itembekkers in zeldzame Endsjipe, beweaakt door schrikwekkende Shulkers.

source_string: When equipped with Elytra, a player can press :_input_key.jump: while falling to start gliding. Note that you need to be quite high to really get the full effect!
translation: Mèt Elytra gedraoge, kan 'ne sjpeler :_input_key.jump: drökke terwiel te valls óm te beginne te gliede. Onthaod detste vrie hoeg moots zeen óm 't ganse effek te kriege!

source_string: When equipped with Elytra, tap :touch_jump: or :tip_virtual_button_fly_up: while falling to start gliding. Make sure you're high up to get the full effect!
translation: Mèt Elytra gedraoge, tik :touch_jump: of :tip_virtual_button_fly_up: terwiel te valls óm te beginne te gliede. Zörg detste hoeg genóg zeens óm 't ganse effek te kriege!

source_string: While gliding, you can steer by looking around. If you look downwards, you'll move faster - but you'll also hit the ground sooner. If you look upwards, you'll gain some height - but do it for too long and you'll stall, falling instead of rising!
translation: Terwiel te gliets, kans te sture door róndj te kieke. Es doe nao ónjer kieks, geis te sjneller - mer doe raeks ouch sjneller de grónj. Es doe nao boave kieks, kriejs te hoegde - mer doon 't te lang en doe valls in plaots vaan te stiege!

source_string: You can steer while gliding by looking around. If you look downwards, you'll gain some speed, but you'll also hit the ground faster. If you look upward, you'll gain some height, but do it for too long and you'll stall - which means you'll start falling.
translation: Doe kans sture terwiel te gliets door róndj te kieke. Es doe nao ónjer kieks, kriejs te get sjnelheid, mer doe raeks ouch de grónj sjneller. Es doe nao boave kieks, kriejs te hoegde, mer doon 't te lang en doe valls in plaots.

source_string: Your Elytra will slowly lose durability while flying, and if they break mid-flight you'll fall. You can repair them by combining them with Phantom Membrane at an Anvil.
translation: Diech Elytra verliese langzaam duurzaomheid terwiel te vlegs, en es zie mid-vlucht breke, valls te. Doe kans ze herstelle door ze te combinere mèt 'n Fantoommembraan op 'n Aambeeld.

source_string: Firework Rockets that have no effects can be used to extend Elytra flight. You will be damaged if you use a Firework Rocket that has effects to extend flight.
translation: Vuurwerkröket zónger effekte könne gebroek wure óm Elytra-vlucht te verlengere. Doe wuurs beschadig es doe 'n Vuurwerkröket gebroeks mèt effekte óm de vlucht te verlengere.

source_string: The Experience Points collected by picking up Experience Orbs can be used to enchant Weapons, Armor, Tools, and Books.
translation: De ervaringspunte gehaold door ervaringsbolle op te pikke, könne gebroek wure óm wapens, pantser, gereedsjap, en books te betouvere.

source_string: When an enchantable item is placed in the slot below the book in the Enchanting Table, the three buttons to the right of the slot will display some enchantments with their Experience Level cost and Lapis Lazuli cost.
translation: Es 'n betouverbaar item in de sleuf ónjer 't book op 't Betouvertaofel geplaats wuurt, wieze de drei knöppe rechs vaan de sleuf get betouveringe mèt hun ervaringsniveau-koste en lapis lazuli-koste.

source_string: The actual enchantment applied is randomly selected based on the cost displayed.
translation: De echte betouvering die toegepast wuurt, wuurt raandóm gekozen op basis vaan de weergegeve koste.

source_string: If the Enchanting Table is surrounded by Bookshelves (up to a maximum of 15), with a one block gap between the Bookshelf and the Enchanting Table, arcane glyphs will be seen going to the book on the Enchanting Table and the potency of the enchantments will be increased.
translation: Es 't Betouvertaofel omringd is door boekekaste (tot 'n maximum vaan 15), mèt 'n gaping vaan ein blok tösje de Boekekas en 't Betouvertaofel, wure mystiek glyfe gezeen die nao 't book op 't Betouvertaofel gaon, en de kraf vaan de betouveringe wuurt verhoogd.

source_string: Enchanted Books are used at the Anvil to apply enchantments to items. This gives you more control over which enchantments you would like on your items.
translation: Betouverdje Books wure gebroek op 't Aambeeld óm betouveringe op items toe te passe. Dit geuf diech mie kontrole euver welke betouveringe doe op diech items wils.

source_string: After killing the Ender Dragon, an End Gateway will appear. Throwing an Ender Pearl into the portal will teleport you to the outer islands.
translation: Nao 't verslaon vaan de Ender Dragon, erschient 'n Endpoort. 'n Enderpaerel in 't portaal wérpe teleporteert diech nao de boetenste eilande.

source_string: This alien new landscape must hide something interesting, and maybe something to bring back with you.
translation: Dit vreem nuuj landschap moot get interessants verberge, en mesjiens get óm mèt te nimme.

source_string: All Ender Chests in a world are linked. Items placed into an Ender Chest are accessible in any other Ender Chest. However, the contents of the Ender Chests are specific for each player. This allows players to store items in any Ender Chest, and retrieve them from other Ender Chests in different positions in the world.
translation: Alle Enderkiste in 'n waereld zeen verbónje. Items geplaats in 'n Enderkis zeen toegankelik in eder angere Enderkis. Wietöt de inhaod vaan de Enderkiste is specifiek veur eder sjpeler. Dit laet sjpelers items opsjlage in eder Enderkis, en ze weer haole vaan angere Enderkiste op versjillendje plekke in de waereld.

context: How To Play help text header. {MaxLength="80"}

source_string: Eyes of Ender are mysteriously connected to the End and will behave strangely when used.
translation: Ogen vaan Ender zeen mysterieus verbónje mèt de End en gedraoge zich vreem es zie gebroek wure.

source_string: Rumor has it that they can lead you to open another dimension.
translation: D'r geet 't gerócht det zie diech kanne laede nao 'n angere dimensie te ëpene.

source_string: There are a variety of different crops that you can farm in Minecraft. Farming, while challenging, can provide an infinite food source.
translation: D'r zeen versjillendje geweas deste kans verboue in Minecraft. Landbouw, hoewol oetdaogend, kan 'n onbeperkte voedselbrón geve.

source_string: Crops require light, water, and farmland to grow. You need a hoe, a water source, and seeds to farm.
translation: Geweas höbbe licht, water, en landbouwgrónj noedig óm te groeie. Doe höbs 'ne hak, 'n waterbrón, en zaad noedig óm te verboue.

source_string: The Blocks next to the water need to be converted to farmland, do this with the hoe. Water will saturate up to four block away.
translation: De blokke naeve 't water moote geconverteerd wure nao landbouwgrónj, doon dit mèt de hak. Water verzadigt tot vier blokke wieder.

source_string: Now you can plant your seeds. Make sure your crops are protected as they can easily die from being trampled or lack of water or light.
translation: Now kans te diech zaad plante. Zörg det diech geweas beschermd zeen, want zie sjterve maekkelik door vertraaje te wure of gebrek aan water of licht.

source_string: Fences can help protect your crops from hungry rabbits or trampling toes!
translation: Ómhèininge könne diech geweas besjerme tegen hongerige kónikke of vertraajendje voete!

source_string: When the crops are fully grown they change in appearance and can be harvested.
translation: Es de geweas volledig gegroeid zeen, veranderen zie vaan oetzeen en könne geoesd wure.

source_string: Some plants like pumpkins and melons grow on stalks. Be careful not to harvest the stalks!
translation: Sómmige plante wie pompoene en meloene groeie op stengele. Wees veurzichtig óm de stengele neet te oesde!

source_string: Fireworks are a fun way to create your own unique celebration in Minecraft!
translation: Vuurwerk is 'n leuke manier óm diech eige unieke viering te make in Minecraft!

source_string: Fireworks have two components, the Firework Rocket and the Firework Star.
translation: Vuurwerk hèt twee onderdeile, de Vuurwerkröket en de Vuurwerksjter.

source_string: To use a Firework, press :_input_key.use: on a block to send the Firework shooting into the sky.
translation: Óm vuurwerk te gebroeke, druk :_input_key.use: op 'n blok óm 't vuurwerk de loeft in te sjete.

source_string: To use a Firework, tap on a block to send the Firework shooting into the sky.
translation: Óm vuurwerk te gebroeke, tik op 'n blok óm 't vuurwerk de loeft in te sjete.

source_string: Fireworks have no effect other than shooting up into the air.
translation: Vuurwerk hèt gein angere effek es de loeft in sjete.

source_string: Firework Stars can be added to during the crafting of the Firework Rocket to give it many different colors and effects.
translation: Vuurwerksjterre könne toegevoegd wure tiedens 't craften vaan de Vuurwerkröket óm 't versjillendje klöre en effekte te gaeve.

source_string: Firework Stars are made from gunpowder and various other items:
translation: Vuurwerksjterre zeen gemaak vaan bösjkroed en versjillendje angere items:

source_string: §eColor§f - Adding dye of any color will make an explosion of that color.
translation: §eKluer§f - 'n Kleurstof vaan eder kluer toevoege maak 'n explosie vaan die kluer.

source_string: §eTwinkle§f - Adding Glowstone Dust will make the explosion twinkle.
translation: §eGeflèkker§f - Glowstone-poeder toevoege laet de explosie flèkkere.

source_string: §eCreeper Shaped§f - Adding a Head will make a creeper pattern in the sky.
translation: §eCreeper-vörm§f - 'ne Kop toevoege maak 'n creeperpatroon in de loeft.

source_string: §eBurst§f - Adding a feather will give the explosion a burst effect.
translation: §eBarst§f - 'n Vaer toevoege geuf de explosie 'ne barsteffek.

source_string: §eTrail§f - Adding a Diamond will give the explosion trails.
translation: §eSpoer§f - 'ne Diamant toevoege geuf de explosie sporen.

source_string: §eStar Shaped§f - Adding a Gold Nugget will make a star pattern in the sky.
translation: §eSjter-vörm§f - 'ne Gaolklump toevoege maak 'n sjterpatroon in de loeft.

source_string: Fireworks can be fired from a dispenser. This will shoot the Firework in the direction that the dispenser is facing.
translation: Vuurwerk kan vaanoet 'ne dispenser aafgeschote wure. Dit sjeet 't Vuurwerk in de richting wo de dispenser nao wiest.

source_string: Fishing must be done with a Fishing Rod and is an excellent way to catch some fish or other cool items from the sea!
translation: Vèsse moot mèt 'ne Vèsgaert gedaon wure en is 'n excellente manier óm vès of angere coole items oet de zee te haole!

source_string: Aim at a block of water and press :_input_key.use: while holding a fishing rod to cast the lure into the water.
translation: Rich op 'ne waterblok en druk :_input_key.use: terwiel te 'ne vèsgaert vashaods óm de lokaas de waeter in te werpe.

source_string: Look at a block of water and tap the Fish button while holding a Fishing Rod to cast the lure into the water.
translation: Kiek nao 'ne waterblok en tik de Vèsse-knop terwiel te 'ne Vèsgaert vashaods óm de lokaas de waeter in te werpe.

source_string: Wait until you start to see a trail of bubbles coming for the lure.
translation: Wach totdet doe 'n spoer vaan bobbele nao de lokaas zuugs kómme.

source_string: When the bubbles touch the lure, it will bob up and down. Press :_input_key.use: to reel in the lure. Be careful not to let your fish get away!
translation: Es de bobbele de lokaas raeke, gaeit dit boave en ónjer. Druk :_input_key.use: óm de lokaas in te haole. Wees veurzichtig det diech vès neet ontsnapt!

source_string: When the bubbles touch the lure, it will bob up and down. Tap the Fish button again to reel in the lure. Be careful not to let your fish get away!
translation: Es de bobbele de lokaas raeke, gaeit dit boave en ónjer. Tik weer op de Vèsse-knop óm de lokaas in te haole. Wees veurzichtig det diech vès neet ontsnapt!

source_string: You'll slowly get hungry during your adventures - fortunately the Overworld is full of food! You can gather apples from trees, meat from animals, or why not grow your own crops using a hoe?
translation: Doe wuurs langzaam hóngerig tiedens diech aoventuure - gelökkig is de Euverwaereld vol aete! Doe kans appele plökke vaan buim, vlees vaan diere, of waoróm neet diech eige geweas verboue mèt 'n hak?

source_string: To eat a food, select it in your hotbar, then click and hold the right mouse button. Keep the §ehunger bar§f:shank: full to regain health when you take damage.
translation: Óm te aete, selekteer 't in diech hotbar, en klik en haod dan de rechs moesknop ingedrök. Haod de §ehongerbalk§f:shank: vol óm gezóndheid te herwinne es doe schade neims.

source_string: To eat a food, select it in your hotbar, then press and hold :_input_key.use:. Keep the §ehunger bar§f:shank: full to regain health when you take damage.
translation: Óm te aete, selekteer 't in diech hotbar, en druk en haod dan :_input_key.use: ingedrök. Haod de §ehongerbalk§f:shank: vol óm gezóndheid te herwinne es doe schade neims.

source_string: To eat a food, select it in your hotbar, then tap the screen and hold. Keep the §ehunger bar§f:shank: full to regain health when you take damage.
translation: Óm te aete, selekteer 't in diech hotbar, en tik en haod dan 't sjerm ingedrök. Haod de §ehongerbalk§f:shank: vol óm gezóndheid te herwinne es doe schade neims.

source_string: Some raw foods are better when cooked first on a campfire or in a furnace - your tummy will thank you!
translation: Sómmige rauw aete zeen beter es zie ieerst gekoch wure op 'n kampvuur of in 'n oven - diech maog zal diech bedanke!

source_string: A Furnace allows you to cook or smelt items. For example, you can smelt Iron Ore into Iron Ingots.
translation: 'n Oven laet diech items koche of smöltje. Bijveurbeeld kans te iezerërts smöltje nao iezerklumpjes.

source_string: Place the Furnace in the world and press :_input_key.use: to use it.
translation: Plaots de Oven in de waereld en druk :_input_key.use: óm 't te gebroeke.

source_string: Place the Furnace in the world and tap to use it.
translation: Plaots de Oven in de waereld en tik óm 't te gebroeke.

source_string: You need to put some fuel into the bottom of the Furnace, and the item that you want smelted in the top. The Furnace will then fire up and start working. Lots of things can be used as fuel; try experimenting with anything burnable!
translation: Doe moots braandstof ónjeraan de Oven zette, en 't item detste wils smöltje boave. De Oven zal dan aanslaon en beginne te werke. Väöl zaake könne es braandstof gebroek wure; probeer te experimentere mèt alles wat brenbaar is!

source_string: When creating a world, you have many options. Below are the various settings that can be used to fine tune your experience. Don't worry if you didn't set them when you created the world, they can be changed at any time.
translation: Bij 't make vaan 'n waereld höbs te väöl opties. Ónjer staon de versjillendje insjtellinge die gebroek könne wure óm diech ervaring fien aaf te stelle. Gein zörg es doe ze neet insjteldes bij 't make vaan de waereld, zie könne altied veranderd wure.

source_string: §eWorld Name§f: This is where you can name your world.
translation: §eWaereldnaam§f: Hie kans te diech waereld 'n naam gaeve.

source_string: §eDefault Game Mode§f: This is the gamemode that all new players to the world will start with. You can have players start in either survival or creative mode. Selecting creative mode will turn cheats on.
translation: §eStanderdsjpelmodus§f: Dit is de sjpelmodus wo alle nuuj sjpelers in de waereld mèt beginne. Doe kans sjpelers laote beginne in survival of creativemodus. Creativemodus keze zet cheats aan.

source_string: §eDifficulty§f: This setting affects how difficult the world will be. You can choose Peaceful, Easy, Normal, or Hard.
translation: §eMoeilikheidsgraod§f: Dees insjtelling beïnvlood hoe moeilik de waereld zal zeen. Doe kans keze oet Vredzaam, Ëinvaudig, Normaal, of Moeilik.

source_string: §eStarting Map§f: If this setting is turned on, every player will start with a map in their hotbar.
translation: §eBeginkaort§f: Es dees insjtelling aan is, begint eder sjpeler mèt 'n kaort in de hotbar.

source_string: §eBonus Chest§f: If this setting is turned on, there will be a chest with some starting loot near your initial spawn location.
translation: §eBonuskis§f: Es dees insjtelling aan is, sjteet d'r 'n Kis mèt get startloot bij diech ieste spawnpunt.

source_string: §eWorld Type§f: This setting controls the way the world is created. Select Infinite or Flat from the drop down menu to change the world type.
translation: §eWaereldtype§f: Dees insjtelling beheerst hoe de waereld gemaak wuurt. Selekteer Onbeperk of Plat vaan de klapmenu óm 't waereldtype te veranderen.

source_string: §eInfinite worlds§f go on and on forever.
§eFlat worlds§f do not have any hills or trees, just an infinite flat area to fill with your creations.
translation: §ePlate waerelde§f höbbe gein heuvels of buim, allein 'n onbeperk plat gebeed óm te vulle mèt diech creaties.

source_string: §eSeed§f: This is a unique number for the world. By entering a seed when you make a new world, you can control how it is created. You can also use a word or phrase for the seed and the game will convert it to a number for you.
translation: §eSeed§f: Dit is 'n unieke nummer veur de waereld. Door 'n seed in te vöre bij 't make vaan 'n nuuj waereld, kans te beheersje wie 't gemaak wuurt. Doe kans ouch 'n woord of zin gebroeke veur de seed en 't sjpel zal 't veur diech omzette nao 'ne nummer.

source_string: §eActivate Cheats§f: This setting allows players to use commands. When a world is created with this setting on, all achievements are disabled.
translation: §eCheats aktiveere§f: Dees insjtelling laet sjpelers opdrachte gebroeke. Es 'n waereld mèt dees insjtelling aan gemaak wuurt, zeen alle prestaties oetgesjakeld.

source_string: Below are gamerules, cheats must be turned on to use them:
translation: Ónjer staon sjpelregels, cheats moote aanstaon óm ze te gebroeke:

source_string: §eAlways Day§f: Night will never fall when this setting is turned on.
translation: §eAltied daag§f: 't Wuurt noeit naach es dees insjtelling aanstaot.

source_string: §eDaylight Cycle§f: The time will not advance when this setting is turned off.
translation: §eDaagcyclus§f: De tied schrijdt neet veuruut es dees insjtelling oetstaot.

source_string: §eKeep Inventory§f: This setting allows players to keep their inventory when they die.
translation: §eInventaris beweer§f: Dees insjtelling laet sjpelers hun inventaris haode es zie sjterve.

source_string: §eMob Spawning§f: This prevents all mobs from spawning when this setting is off.
translation: §eMobs spawne§f: Dit verhinderd alle mobs óm te spawne es dees insjtelling oetstaot.

source_string: §eMob Griefing§f: Prevents mobs from destroying the world.
translation: §eMobverwuesting§f: Verhinderd mobs óm de waereld te vernaetege.

source_string: §eEntities Drop Loot§f: Controls whether things like minecarts and armor stands will drop themselves when they are broken.
translation: §eEntiteite loate loot valle§f: Beheerst of zaake wie mienkarre en pantserrekke zichzelf loate valle es zie breke.

source_string: §eWeather Cycle§f: The weather will not change when this setting is turned off.
translation: §eWeercyclus§f: 't Weer verandert neet es dees insjtelling oetstaot.

source_string: Hoppers are used to automatically move items. Hoppers can be attached to some other items like containers such as Chests or Jukeboxes.
translation: Trechters wure gebroek óm automaatisch items te versjuve. Trechters könne bevestig wure aan angere items wie containers zoeas Kiste of Jukebokse.

source_string: Hoppers will continuously remove items out of a container placed above them and move them into the container they are pointing to.
translation: Trechters haole doorlopend items oet 'n container boave hun geplaats en versjuve ze nao de container wo zie nao wiese.

source_string: To make a Hopper point to a particular block, place the Hopper against that block while sneaking.
translation: Óm 'ne Trechter nao 'n bepaald blok te laote wieze, plaots de Trechter tegen dat blok terwiel te sluips.

source_string: If a Hopper is powered by Redstone, it will become inactive and stop moving items.
translation: Es 'n Trechter vaan Redstone vaan kraf veurzeen wuurt, wuurt 't inaktief en stopt 't mèt items versjuve.

source_string: When playing with cheats on, host options will allow you to teleport yourself or friends, change the weather, set the time of day, and change the entry point or world spawn of your game. Once cheats have been enabled, you can find these options in the chat window by pressing the [/] button next to the chat bar.
translation: Es te sjpels mèt cheats aan, late hostopties diech teleporteere zelf of vrunj, 't weer veranderen, de tied vaan de daag insjtelle, en 't intreepunt of waereldspawn vaan diech sjpel veranderen. Ins cheats geaktiveerd zeen, kans te dees opties vènje in 't chatvinster door de [/]-knop naeve de chatbalk te drökke.

source_string: When playing with cheats on, host options will allow you to teleport yourself or friends, change the weather, set the time of day, and change the entry point or world spawn of your game. Once cheats have been enabled, you can find these options in the chat window by tapping the chat button.
translation: Es te sjpels mèt cheats aan, late hostopties diech teleporteere zelf of vrunj, 't weer veranderen, de tied vaan de daag insjtelle, en 't intreepunt of waereldspawn vaan diech sjpel veranderen. Ins cheats geaktiveerd zeen, kans te dees opties vènje in 't chatvinster door op de chatknop te tikke.

source_string: Use your tools a lot and they'll eventually break. As you gather new materials, such as stone, you'll be able to craft better tools.
translation: Gebroek diech gereedsjap väöl en 't breekt eventueel. Es doe nuuj materiaal verzamels, wie sjtein, kans te beter gereedsjap craften.

source_string: Tools of higher tiers are more durable, more efficient, and able to gather more valuable resources. Go out into the world and find out for yourself!
translation: Gereedsjap vaan hogere klasse is duurzaomer, efficiënter, en kan waardevollere resources verzamele. Gank de waereld in en vènj 't zelf oet!

source_string: Your hotbar will fill up as you gather more resources. Press :_input_key.inventory: to access your §einventory§f, where you'll have more space for everything you've collected.
translation: Diech hotbar vult zich es doe mie resources verzamels. Druk :_input_key.inventory: óm toegang te kriege tot diech §einventaris§f, wo doe mie plaats höbs veur alles wat te verzameld höbs.

source_string: Your hotbar will fill up as you gather more resources. Tap :tip_touch_inventory: to access your §einventory§f, where you'll have more space for everything you've collected.
translation: Diech hotbar vult zich es doe mie resources verzamels. Tik :tip_touch_inventory: óm toegang te kriege tot diech §einventaris§f, wo doe mie plaats höbs veur alles wat te verzameld höbs.

source_string: Your hotbar will fill up as you gather more resources. Press :rift_B: to access your §einventory§f, where you'll have more space for everything you've collected.
translation: Diech hotbar vult zich es doe mie resources verzamels. Druk :rift_B: óm toegang te kriege tot diech §einventaris§f, wo doe mie plaats höbs veur alles wat te verzameld höbs.

source_string: Your hotbar will fill up as you gather more resources. Press :windowsmr_left_grab: to access your §einventory§f, where you'll have more space for everything you've collected.
translation: Diech hotbar vult zich es doe mie resources verzamels. Druk :windowsmr_left_grab: óm toegang te kriege tot diech §einventaris§f, wo doe mie plaats höbs veur alles wat te verzameld höbs.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Open your inventory, click the item of your choice, then drag it to the empty item slot you'd like to move it to.
translation: Wils te get versjuve tösje diech §ehotbar§f en diech inventaris? Ëpen diech inventaris, klik 't item vaan diech keus, en versjuif 't dan nao de laege itemsleuf wo doe 't nao wils versjuve.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Use the cursor to select an item and press :_gamepad_face_button_down:. Then, move your cursor to an empty item slot and press again to drop the item.
translation: Wils te get versjuve tösje diech §ehotbar§f en diech inventaris? Gebroek de cursor óm 'n item te selektere en druk :_gamepad_face_button_down:. Versjuif dan diech cursor nao 'n laege itemsleuf en druk weer óm 't item te loate valle.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Tap the item of your choice, then tap the empty item slot that you'd like to move it to.
translation: Wils te get versjuve tösje diech §ehotbar§f en diech inventaris? Tik 't item vaan diech keus, en tik dan de laege itemsleuf wo doe 't nao wils versjuve.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Use the cursor to select an item and press :_input_key.use:. Then, move your cursor to an empty item slot and press again to drop the item.
