translation: Wils te get versjuve tösje diech §ehotbar§f en diech inventaris? Gebroek de cursor óm 'n item te selektere en druk :_input_key.use:. Versjuif dan diech cursor nao 'n laege itemsleuf en druk weer óm 't item te loate valle.

source_string: Jigsaw Blocks give creators the ability to generate large structures in the world by connecting multiple structure templates.
translation: Puzzelblokke gaeve makers de mögelikheid óm grote structure te ginnerere in de waereld door mieër structuursjablone aan te verbènje.

source_string: To get a Jigsaw Block you must use the /give slash command. To use a Jigsaw Block, you must have Operator permissions.
translation: Óm 'ne Puzzelblok te kriege moots te de /give-sjlaghoge-opdrach gebroeke. Óm 'ne Puzzelblok te gebroeke, moots te Operator-permissies höbbe.

source_string: Jigsaw Blocks have multiple settings that control how they join together to form a larger structure.
translation: Puzzelblokke höbbe mieër insjtellinge die beheersje wie zie zich aan elkander verbènje óm 'n gröttere structuur te vörme.

source_string: §eTarget Pool§f - The path of the template pool to search for a connecting structure template. The template pool should contain at least one structure that matches the Jigsaw's "Target Name" field.
translation: §eDoelpöl§f - Diech pad vaan de sjabloonpöl óm te zeuke nao 'ne verbènjendje structuursjabloon. De sjabloonpöl zol minstens ein structuur moote bevatte die past bij 't 'Doelnaam'-veld vaan de Puzzel.

source_string: §eName§f - The name of the Jigsaw. This is used when connecting from Jigsaws with a matching "Target Name".
translation: §eNaam§f - De naam vaan de Puzzel. Dit wuurt gebroek bij 't verbènje vaan puzzels mèt 'n gelieke 'Doelnaam'.

source_string: §eTurns Into§f - The type of block the Jigsaw Block will turn into when placed in the world during structure generation.
translation: §eWuurt§f - 't Type blok wo de Puzzelblok in verandert es 't in de waereld geplaats wuurt tiedens structuurginneratie.

source_string: §eSelection Priority§f - When the parent piece is being processed for connections, this is the order in which this Jigsaw block attempts to connect to its target piece. Jigsaws will be processed in descending priority with random ordering breaking ties.
translation: §eSelectieveurrang§f - Terwiel 't uderdeel wuurt geverwerk veur verbènjinge, is dit de volgeorde wo dees Puzzelblok probeert te verbènje mèt zieng doelöndjerdeel. Puzzels wure geverwerk in aafdalendje veurrang mèt raandóm ordening bij geliekspel.

source_string: §ePlacement Priority§f - When this Jigsaw block connects to a piece, this is the order in which that piece is processed for connections in the wider structure. Pieces will be processed in descending priority with insertion order breaking ties.
translation: §ePlaatsingsveurrang§f - Es dees Puzzelblok verbindt mèt 'ne stök, is dit de volgeorde wo die stök wuurt geverwerk veur verbènjinge in de brëddere structuur. Stökke wure geverwerk in aafdalendje veurrang mèt invögeorde bij geliekspel.

source_string: §eJoint Type§f - A joint can be either Rollable (default) or Aligned. If the joint type is Rollable, the target structure will be rotated randomly around the source Jigsaw Block. If the joint type is Aligned, the target structure will be placed such that the rotation of the target Jigsaw Block aligns with the rotation of the source Jigsaw Block. Note that this only applies when the Jigsaw Block is placed facing up or down.
translation: §eGeweg-type§f - 'ne Geweg kan of Rollable (standerd) of Aligned zeen. Es 't geweg-type Rollable is, wuurt de doelstructuur raandóm gedraaid róndj de bróngPuzzelblok. Es 't geweg-type Aligned is, wuurt de doelstructuur zoedanig geplaats det de rotatie vaan de doelpuzzelblok euvereenkump mèt de rotatie vaan de bróngpuzzelblok. Merk op det dit allein geldt es de Puzzelblok naor boave of ónjer wiest.

source_string: The Jukebox will play Music Discs that you have found.
translation: De Jukebox sjpelt Muziekplate deste gevónje höbs.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Jukebox with a Music Disc in your hand to play it. Press :_input_key.use: the Jukebox again to eject the Music Disc.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: op 'n Jukebox mèt 'n Muziekplaot in diech han óm 't te sjpele. Druk :_input_key.use: de Jukebox weer óm de Muziekplaot te oetsjete.

source_string: Tap a Jukebox with a Music Disc in your hand to play it. Tap the Jukebox again to eject the Music Disc.
translation: Tik 'n Jukebox mèt 'n Muziekplaot in diech han óm 't te sjpele. Tik de Jukebox weer óm de Muziekplaot te oetsjete.

source_string: When a Jukebox is playing a Music Disc, it will power Redstone Dust.
translation: Es 'n Jukebox 'n Muziekplaot sjpelt, geuf 't kraf aan Redstonepoeder.

source_string: Try different Music Discs for a different power level.
translation: Probeer versjillendje Muziekplate veur 'n angere kraftniveau.

source_string: See what happens when you let it play to the end.
translation: Zuug waat gebeurt es te 't tot 't ing loats sjpele.

source_string: A Hopper can put a Music Disc in for you, and take it out when it's done playing.
translation: 'ne Trechter kan 'n Muziekplaot veur diech naer inne zette, en 't d'roet haole es 't klaor is mèt sjpele.

source_string: There are a couple of Music Discs that can be found in Chests around the world.
translation: D'r zeen get Muziekplate die gevónje könne wure in kiste róndj de waereld.

source_string: Others are more difficult to come by, Creepers secretly appreciate music.
translation: Angere zeen moeiliker te kriege, Creepers waardere heimelik muziek.

source_string: The Loom is a fast and efficient way to apply patterns to Banners. The Loom only uses one Dye to apply a pattern. It can also use Loom patterns to apply special patterns.
translation: De Weefstoel is 'n sjnel en efficiënt manier óm patrone toe te passe op Vaandele. De Weefstoel gebroek allein ein kleurstof óm 'n patroon toe te passe. 't Kan ouch weefstoelpatrone gebroeke óm speciael patrone toe te passe.

source_string: By placing a Banner into the Loom's first slot, and any color dye into the second slot, patterns can be added to the Banner. Once a pattern is selected, take it from the output slot on the right and move it to your inventory.
translation: Door 'n Vaandel in de ieste sleuf vaan de Weefstoel te plaotse, en eder kleurstof in de twiede sleuf, könne patrone toegevoegd wure aan de Vaandel. Ins 'n patroon geselekteerd is, hael 't oet de oetvoersleuf rechs en versjuif 't nao diech inventaris.

source_string: A Banner can have multiple layers allowing you to experiment with many different banner possibilities. Up to 6 patterns can be applied to a Banner to create a unique design.
translation: 'n Vaandel kan mieër laoge höbbe zoedet doe kans experimentere mèt väöl versjillendje vaandelmögelikheite. Tot 6 patrone könne toegepast wure op 'n Vaandel óm 'n unieke ontwerp te make.

source_string: Adding a Loom Pattern to the Loom's third slot will allow the crafting of special patterns like a creeper face or a flower pattern. You will not lose your Loom Patterns when you apply these patterns to your Banners.
translation: 'n Weefstoelpatroon toevoege aan de derde sleuf vaan de Weefstoel laet 't craften vaan speciael patrone wie 'n creeperkop of 'n bluumpatroon. Doe verlees diech weefstoelpatrone neet es doe dees patrone toepas op diech Vaandele.

source_string: Explore thrilling themed worlds, parceled up with matching skins, textures and more!
translation: Ontdèk spannende themawaerelde, gepakt mèt bijpassendje skins, texture en mie!

source_string: Explore a world of possibility with Minecoins: Minecraft's in-game currency! Minecoins let you add variety to your gameplat across supported Minecraft games.
translation: Ontdèk 'n waereld vaan mögelikheite mèt Minecoins: Minecraft's in-sjpelvaluta! Minecoins laete diech variatie toevoege aan diech gameplay euver ondersteundje Minecraft-sjpelle.

source_string: Once redeemed, your Minecoins are linked to your Microsoft account, so you can access your coins and purchases on other supported devices, too!
translation: Ins ingewisseld, zeen diech Minecoins verbónje mèt diech Microsoft-account, zoedet doe toegang höbs tot diech coins en koupe op angere ondersteundje toestelle, ouch!

source_string: *Minecoins require a version of Minecraft: Bedrock Edition with Minecraft Marketplace. Minecoins are not compatible on PlayStation®. For compatibility information see minecraft.net/minecoins
translation: *Minecoins vereist 'n versie vaan Minecraft: Bedrock Edition mèt Minecraft Marketplace. Minecoins zeen neet compatibel op PlayStation®. Veur compatibiliteitsinfo zuug minecraft.net/minecoins

source_string: Not all crafting materials are on the surface - some may require you to dig underground or into a mountain.
translation: Neet alle craftmaterialen zeen aan de oppervlak - sómmige vereise détste ónjer de grónj of in 'ne berg graafs.

source_string: A §epickaxe§f:wood_pickaxe: helps you uncover all sorts of materials, such as stone, coal, iron, and precious ore - though you may need extra sturdy tools for some rarer materials!
translation: 'ne §epikhouwel§f:wood_pickaxe: hölpt diech allerhande materialen te ontdèkke, zoeas sjtein, kool, iezer, en waardevolle ërts - hoewol te mesjiens extra sterke gereedsjap noedig höbs veur zeldzamere materialen!

source_string: Some raw metals will need to be smelted using a §efurnace§f:furnace: . Place a fuel like coal or wood logs in the fuel slot, then add raw ore to smelt it into something useful.
translation: Sómmige rauw metale moote gesmoltje wure mèt 'ne §eoven§f:furnace: . Plaots braandstof wie kool of hoottblökke in de braandstofsleuf, en veug dan rauwe ërts toe óm 't te smöltje nao get bruikbaars.

source_string: A player can ride any adult §eHorse§f, §eDonkey§f, §eMule§f, or §eCamel§f. Only Horses can be armored.
translation: 'ne Sjpeler kan eder volwasse §ePeerd§f, §eEzel§f, §eMuulezel§f, of §eKamel§f rije. Allein Peerde könne bepantserd wure.

source_string: Mules and Donkeys may be equipped with saddlebags (for transporting items) by attaching a Chest. These saddlebags can then be accessed whilst riding or sneaking.
translation: Muulezels en Ezels könne oetgeröst wure mèt zaddeltassje (veur 't transporteere vaan items) door 'n Kis te bevestige. Dees zaddeltassje könne dan bereik wure terwiel te rijs of sluips.

source_string: Horses, Donkeys, and Mules must be §etamed§f before they can be used. A player can tame a horse by riding it and staying on while it tries to buck them off. Press :_input_key.use: with an empty hand to attempt to tame Horses, Donkeys, and Mules.
translation: Peerde, Ezels, en Muulezels moote §egetaamd§f wure veurdet zie gebroek könne wure. 'ne Sjpeler kan 'ne peerd tamme door 't te rije en d'rop te blieve terwiel 't probeert 'm aaf te wérpe. Druk :_input_key.use: mèt 'n laege han óm te probeere Peerde, Ezels, en Muulezels te tamme.

source_string: Horses, Donkeys, and Mules must be §etamed§f before they can be used. A player can tame a horse by riding it and staying on while it tries to buck them off. Tap the Mount button that appears when near a horse  to attempt to tame Horses, Donkeys, and Mules.
translation: Peerde, Ezels, en Muulezels moote §egetaamd§f wure veurdet zie gebroek könne wure. 'ne Sjpeler kan 'ne peerd tamme door 't te rije en d'rop te blieve terwiel 't probeert 'm aaf te wérpe. Tik de Rij-knop die erschient bij 'ne peerd óm te probeere Peerde, Ezels, en Muulezels te tamme.

source_string: When Hearts appear around the horse, it has been tamed and will no longer attempt to throw the player off.
translation: Es hertjes róndj de peerd erschiene, is 't getaamd en probeert 't neet mie de sjpeler aaf te wérpe.

source_string: To steer horses and camels, the player must equip it with a §eSaddle§f.
translation: Óm peerde en kamele te sture, moot de sjpeler ze oetröste mèt 'ne §eZaddel§f.

source_string: Saddles can be bought from villagers, found inside Chests hidden in the world, or acquired by fishing. While riding a horse, open your inventory and put a saddle in the horse's saddle slot.
translation: Zaddele könne gekoch wure vaan durpelinge, gevónje wure in Kiste verstoke in de waereld, of verkrege wure door te vèsse. Terwiel te 'ne peerd rijs, ëpen diech inventaris en zèt 'ne zaddel in de zaddelsleuf vaan de peerd.

source_string: A camel can carry two players at the same time.
translation: 'ne Kamel kan twee sjpelers gelieks draoge.

source_string: Horses and Donkeys can be bred like other animals using Golden Apples or Golden Carrots.
translation: Peerde en Ezels könne gefokt wure wie angere diere mèt Gaole appele of Gaole peekes.

source_string: Foals will grow into adult horses over time, although feeding them Wheat or Hay will speed this up.
translation: Veule groeie mèt de tied nao volwasse peerde, hoewol ze vaere mèt Kaore of Hooi dit versjnelt.

source_string: Llamas are another ridable mob which can be tamed and used to transport large shipments of items.
translation: Lama's zeen 'n angere riebaar mob die getaamd kan wure en gebroek veur 't transporteere vaan groate zendinge items.

source_string: Llamas can be tamed the same as horses. However, even when tamed, the player can't control their movements when riding them.
translation: Lama's könne getaamd wure zoeas peerde. Wietöt, zelfs getaamd, kan de sjpeler hun bewegingen neet controlere terwiel te ze rijs.

source_string: A lead can be attached to one, and when this happens, surrounding llamas (both tamed and un-tamed) will follow, making a caravan.
translation: 'n Leine kan aan ein bevestig wure, en es dit gebeurt, volge omringendje lama's (zoewel getaamd es óngetaamd), wat 'n karavaan maak.

source_string: Llamas can be equipped with chests, giving it 3-15 slots of inventory space depending on the strength of the Llama. They can also be equipped with carpets. Each carpet color yields a different pattern.
translation: Lama's könne oetgeröst wure mèt kiste, wat hun 3-15 sleuve inventarisruimde geuf, aafhankelik vaan de sterkte vaan de Lama. Zie könne ouch oetgeröst wure mèt tepiete. Eder tepietkluer geuf 'n angere patroon.

source_string: Pigs can be ridden as well, although they won't go where you want without a little incentive.
translation: Verke könne ouch geride wure, hoewol zie neet gaon wo doe wils zónger get aanmoedeging.

source_string: Equip a pig with a Saddle and point a Carrot on a Stick in the direction you want to go.
translation: Rüst 'ne verke oet mèt 'ne Zaddel en wies mèt 'ne Peekes-op-'n-sjtok in de richting wo doe wils gaon.
Druk op :_input_key.sneak: um aaf te stappe.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_jump: to dismount an animal.
translation: Bij gebroek vaan 't D-Pad-besjturingsschema, tik :touch_jump: óm aaf te stappe vaan 'n dier.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to dismount an animal.
translation: Bij gebroek vaan 'n Joystick-besjturingsschema, tik :tip_virtual_button_dismount: óm aaf te stappe vaan 'n dier.

source_string: Welcome to the Overworld, a blocky world full of adventure and possibility!
translation: Welkom in de Euverwaereld, 'n blokkige waereld vol aoventuur en mögelikheite!

source_string: Look around by touching and dragging the screen.
translation: Kiek róndj door 't sjerm aan te raoke en te versjuve.
Bewaeg diech de waereld róndj mèt :_input_key.forward: :_input_key.left: :_input_key.back: :_input_key.right:.
Bewaeg diech de waereld róndj mèt :_gamepad_stick_left:.

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen joystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .
translation: Bewaeg diech de waereld róndj mèt de sjermjoystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen buttons.
translation: Bewaeg diech de waereld róndj mèt de sjermknöppe.

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen joystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .
translation: Bewaeg diech de waereld róndj mèt de sjermjoystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .
Bewaeg diech de waereld róndj mèt :rift_left_stick:.
Bewaeg diech de waereld róndj mèt :windowsmr_left_stick:.

source_string: The world is full of resources, including §ebuilding blocks§f, §ecrafting materials§f, and §efood§f.
translation: De waereld is vol resources, mèt daoronder §ebouwblokke§f, §ecraftmaterialen§f, en §eaete§f.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §epress and hold§f :_input_key.attack:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Doe kans §eblokke breke§f mèt diech blote hen óm resources te verzamele wie grónj en holt. Rich op 'ne blok, en §edruk en haod dan§f :_input_key.attack:  ingedrök totdet 't breekt en de resources valle.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. §eTouch and hold§f on the block until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Doe kans §eblokke breke§f mèt diech blote hen óm resources te verzamele wie grónj en holt. §eRaok en haod vas§f op de blok totdet 't breekt en de resources valle.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §etouch and hold§f :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Doe kans §eblokke breke§f mèt diech blote hen óm resources te verzamele wie grónj en holt. Rich op 'ne blok, en §eraok en haod vas§f :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy:  totdet 't breekt en de resources valle.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §eclick and hold§f :_input_key.attack:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Doe kans §eblokke breke§f mèt diech blote hen óm resources te verzamele wie grónj en holt. Rich op 'ne blok, en §eklik en haod vas§f :_input_key.attack:  totdet 't breekt en de resources valle.

source_string: Pick up any dropped resources by walking over the floating icons.
translation: Pik eder gevallendje resource op door euver de zweve iconne te loupe.

source_string: Resources you pick up will appear in your §ehotbar§f, which you'll find at the bottom of the screen.
translation: Resources deste oppikks erschiene in diech §ehotbar§f, die doe ónjeraan 't sjerm vinjs.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, scroll the mouse wheel to select the item. You can also use a number key: 1 is the first hotbar slot and 9 is the last.
translation: Óm 'ne item in diech han te haode, scroll de moeswiel óm 't item te selektere. Doe kans ouch 'ne cijferknop gebroeke: 1 is de ieste hotbarsleuf en 9 de lëtste.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to select the item.
translation: Óm 'ne item in diech han te haode, gebroek :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: en :_input_key.cycleItemRight: óm 't item te selektere.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, simply tap it in the hotbar.
translation: Óm 'ne item in diech han te haode, tik gewoen d'rop in de hotbar.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :rift_left_trigger: and :rift_left_grab: to select the item.
translation: Óm 'ne item in diech han te haode, gebroek :rift_left_trigger: en :rift_left_grab: óm 't item te selektere.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to select the item.
translation: Óm 'ne item in diech han te haode, gebroek :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: óm 't item te selektere.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by tapping the build/use button :_input_key.use:.
translation: Doe kins sómmige items, wie emmere, vèsroetjes en bogen, gebruke door te tikke op de bouw/gebroek-knop :_input_key.use:.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by touching and holding anywhere on the screen.
translation: Sómmige items, wie emmere, vèsgaerte, en bogen, könne gebroek wure door 't sjerm aan te raoke en vas te haode.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by tapping the build/use button :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.
translation: Doe kins sómmige items, wie emmere, vèsroetjes en bogen, gebruke door te tikke op de bouw/gebroek-knop :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.

source_string: Any block you've picked up can placed back into the world. This way you can build a cozy §eshelter§f or anything else you can imagine!
translation: Eder blok deste opgepik höbs kan weer geplaats wure in de waereld. Zoe kans te 'n gezellige §eschuulplaats§f bouwe of get angers wat doe diech kans veurstelle!

source_string: Choose a block in your hotbar, then press :_input_key.use: to place it.
translation: Kies 'ne blok in diech hotbar, en druk dan :_input_key.use: óm 't te plaotse.

source_string: Tap a block in your hotbar to select it, then tap somewhere in the world to place it.
translation: Tik 'ne blok in diech hotbar óm 't te selektere, en tik dan iërgens in de waereld óm 't te plaotse.

source_string: Tap a block in your hotbar to select it, then tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to place it.
translation: Tik 'ne blok in diech hotbar óm 't te selektere, en tik dan :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: óm 't te plaotse.

source_string: Don't worry if you place something in the wrong spot - simply break it again, then pick it back up!
translation: Gein zörg es doe get op de verkierdje plaats zets - breek 't gewoen weer, en pik 't weer op!

source_string: Navigation is an important skill that you will learn in Minecraft as it's not always easy to find your way home.
translation: Navigatie is 'n belangrieke veardigheid deste zals lieëre in Minecraft, want 't is neet altied maekkelik óm diech waeg thoes te vènje.

source_string: First of all, there are some basic tools that you should know about.
translation: Ieerst zeen d'r get basisgereedsjap deste zols kenne.

source_string: A Compass will point in the direction of the first place you spawned into the world, an easy way to find where you started.
translation: 'n Kompas wiest in de richting vaan de ieste plaats wo doe spawnde in de waereld, 'n maekkelike manier óm te vènje wo doe begós.

source_string: A Map lets you see the area you've explored. Put it in your offhand slot to use it like a mini-map. You can increase its size by adding more paper to the edges in a Crafting Table.
translation: 'n Kaort laet diech 't gebeed zeen deste ontdèk höbs. Zèt 't in diech anger han-sleuf óm 't te gebroeke wie 'n minikaort. Doe kans de groette verhoage door mie papier toe te voege aan de kante bij 'n Werkbank.

source_string: A Locator Map will show you where you are and what direction you are facing in relation to the Locator Map's origin. It will also show you the location of other players in the same world.
translation: 'n Locatiekaort wies te wo doe bis en welke richting doe naor kieks in relatie tot de oorsprónk vaan de Locatiekaort. 't Wies ouch de locatie vaan angere sjpelers in de zelfde waereld.

source_string: A Cartography Table can help you create, expand, copy and even name maps.
translation: 'n Kaortentaofel kan diech hölpe kaorte te make, te vergroate, te kopiëre en zelfs 'n naam te gaeve.

source_string: Place paper into the first slot to craft a Map. If you add a compass into the second slot you can craft a Locator Map. Adding Paper or a blank Map will let you expand or copy your Map.
translation: Plaots papier in de ieste sleuf óm 'n Kaort te craften. Es doe 'ne kompas toevoegs in de twiede sleuf, kans te 'n Locatiekaort craften. Papier of 'n laege Kaort toevoege laet diech diech Kaort vergroate of kopiëre.

source_string: Try to watch for landmarks as you explore. The more you play on a world, the more you will be able to remember where you are. Another good trick is to place Torches as you go so that you may find your way back home.
translation: Kiek oet veur baken terwiel te ontdèks. Hoe mie te op 'n waereld sjpels, hoe mie te zals kenne herinnere wo doe bis. 'n Angere gooj trik is fakkele te plaotse terwiel te goons, zoedet doe diech waeg terug thoes vinjs.

source_string: The sun can also tell you what direction you are facing. Remember: the sun rises in the east and sets in the west!
translation: De zon kan diech ouch zègge welke richting doe naor kieks. Onthaod: de zon geet op in 't oosten en ondergeet in 't weste!

source_string: There are several places for you to explore. Find a village and look for a Cartographer. He will trade you Explorer Maps that will lead you to strange places very far away.
translation: D'r zeen versjillendje plaatse veur diech óm te ontdèkke. Vènj 'n durp en zeuk nao 'ne Kaortentekener. Hae zal diech Ontdèkkerskaorte handele die diech nao vreem plaatse wied weg zólle brenge.

source_string: A Nether Portal allows you to travel to a different dimension.
translation: 'n Netherportaal laet diech nao 'n angere dimensie reize.

source_string: If constructed correctly the Nether Portal can be lit and activated.
translation: Es 't gooj gebauwd is, kan 't Netherportaal aangestoke en geaktiveerd wure.

source_string: Example of a portal construction shown here:
In Minecraft, the sun rises and sets as you adventure in your world. As the sun sets, you must take precautions. There are many dangers at night!
translation: In Minecraft geet de zon op en ondergeet terwiel te ontdèks in diech waereld. Terwiel de zon óngeet, moots te veurzichtige moatregele nemme. D'r zeen väöl gevare 's naachs!

source_string: If you have not already, you will need a place to take shelter from the dark and what lurks within it. This can be as simple as a hole in the side of a hill or a small cabin in the forest.
translation: Es doe dit noch neet höbs, höbs te 'n plaats noedig óm te schuule vaan 't dónker en waat d'rin lourt. Dit kan zoe eenvaudig zeen es 'ne gaat in de zie vaan 'ne heuvel of 'n klein hüske in 't bos.

source_string: Be sure to block off all entrances, you may want to use a door so you can go in and out. If you have made a bed this is a good place to put it along with your Crafting Table and Furnace.
translation: Zörg det doe alle ingange aafsjluuts, doe wils mesjiens 'n duer gebroeke zoedet te kans in- en oetgaon. Es doe 'n bèd höbs gemaak is dit 'n gooj plaats óm 't te zette same mèt diech Werkbank en Oven.

source_string: Also be sure to light up the area with torches, it may save your life.
translation: Zörg ouch det doe 't gebeed verlicht mèt fakkele, dit kan diech laeve redde.

source_string: When the sun starts to set, it's time to get ready.
translation: Es de zon begint te óngaon, is 't tied óm klaor te zeen.

source_string: At night, the Overworld is home to zombies, spiders, skeletons, and other dangerous creatures we call §ehostile mobs§f.
translation: 's Naachs is de Euverwaereld thoes veur zombies, spinne, skeletten, en angere gevaarlike wezens die we §evijandige mobs§f neume.

source_string: Crafting some §etorches§f can help you see in the dark, while also keeping mobs from spawning too close.
translation: Get §efakkele§f craften kan diech hölpe zeen in 't dónker, en gelieks mobs verhindere te dich bié te spawne.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by right-clicking a nearby free surface.
translation: Terwiel te 'n fakkel draogs, plaots 't in de waereld door rechs te klikke op 'ne dichbijzeendje vrieje oppervlak.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by pressing :_input_key.use:.
translation: Terwiel te einen fakkel vaste höls, plaats 't in de waereld door te drökke op :_input_key.use:.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by tapping a nearby free surface.
translation: Terwiel te 'n fakkel draogs, plaots 't in de waereld door te tikke op 'ne dichbijzeendje vrieje oppervlak.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by aiming at a nearby block and tapping :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.
translation: Terwiel te einen fakkel vaste höls, plaats 't in de waereld door te richte op ein dichbijzeendje blok en te tikke op :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.

source_string: There are several mobs in Minecraft that you can tame and make your pet. Each can be tamed by giving them an item that they like. Once tamed you can have them stay by pressing :_input_key.use: while looking at them.
translation: D'r zeen versjillendje mobs in Minecraft die doe kans tamme en diech hoesdier make. Eder kan getaamd wure door 'm 'n item te gaeve wat 'm leuk vinjt. Ins getaamd, kans te ze laote blieve door :_input_key.use: te drökke terwiel te nao hun kieks.

source_string: There are several mobs in Minecraft that you can tame and make your pet. Each can be tamed by giving them an item that they like. Once tamed you can have them stay by tapping the Sit Button.
translation: D'r zeen versjillendje mobs in Minecraft die doe kans tamme en diech hoesdier make. Eder kan getaamd wure door 'm 'n item te gaeve wat 'm leuk vinjt. Ins getaamd, kans te ze laote blieve door de Zitknop te tikke.

source_string: Wolves are a neutral mob that hunt in the colder climates. They will attack Rabbits, Skeletons, and Sheep but run away from Llamas. They won't attack you unless you provoke them. You can tame them by giving them Bones.
translation: Wólve zeen 'n neutrale mob die jaag in de koudere klimate. Zie valle Kónikke, Skeletten, en Sjaop aan mer loupe wèg vaan Lama's. Zie valle diech neet aan zonder detste ze provoceers. Doe kans ze tamme door ze Bèinder te gaeve.

source_string: Cats are a neutral mob that can be found in villages. They will attack Rabbits and Baby Turtles. They will also keep Phantoms and Creepers away. They will try to run from you so taming them can be tough. They like fish so give them Raw Cod or Salmon to tame them.
translation: Katse zeen 'n neutrale mob die gevónje wure in durpe. Zie valle Kónikke en Babyschöldpadde aan. Zie haode ouch Fantoms en Creepers weg. Zie probeere vaan diech te loupe dus zie tamme kan moeilik zeen. Zie höbbe vès leuk dus gaef ze Rauwe kabeljauw of Zalm óm ze te tamme.

source_string: Parrots are a passive mob that live in the Jungle. They will imitate any other mob in the area. Seeds are their favorite, give them a few to tame them. Parrots will also sit on your shoulder... Yes, you can have more than one up there.
translation: Pappegaeje zeen 'n passieve mob die in de Jóngel leve. Zie imiteere eder angere mob in de omgeving. Zaad is hun favoriet, gaef ze get óm ze te tamme. Pappegaeje gaon ouch op diech sjölder zitte... Joa, doe kans mie es ein daoboave höbbe.

source_string: While exploring the world you may encounter a Pillager encampment or patrol. Pillagers are always looking for villages to raid. Taking their Banners will get their attention, and they may choose to attack a nearby village.
translation: Terwiel te de waereld ontdèks kans te 'n Roversplekke of patrouille traofe. Rovers zeuke altied nao durpe óm te euvervalle. Hun Vaandele naeme trèkt hun aandach, en zie kanne kieze óm 'n dichbijzeendje durp aan te valle.

source_string: Be sure to defend your village, the attack will stop if you defeat all the raiders.
translation: Zörg det doe diech durp verdeedigs, de aanval stopt es doe alle rovers verslaogs.

source_string: Villagers will most likely be very grateful that you have saved them from the raiders. Be sure to check back with them, you might get a good deal.
translation: Durpelinge zólle mieëstwoal väöl dankbaar zeen detste ze gered höbs vaan de rovers. Zörg det doe weer bij hun terugkump, doe kriejs mesjiens 'n gooj deal.

source_string: In Minecraft, you can have your own ranch filled with livestock! Ranching provides lots of resources such as wool, eggs, and raw meat.
translation: In Minecraft kans te diech eige boerderij höbbe vol vie! Vieboerderij geuf väöl resources zoeas wol, eier, en rauw vlees.

source_string: In order to keep your livestock growing, you have to make baby animals. Adult animals must enter Love Mode for this to happen. Feed the animals their preferred food to get them to enter Love Mode.
translation: Óm diech vie te laote groeie, moots te babydiere make. Volwasse diere moote de Liefdesmodus binnegaon veurdet dit gebeurt. Vaer de diere hun favoriete aete óm ze de Liefdesmodus te laote binnegaon.

source_string: When two like animals are nearby and in Love Mode, they will kiss for a moment and then a baby animal will appear! The baby animal will stay with their parents until they grow into an adult. After having a baby, adult animals must wait 1 minute before entering Love Mode.
translation: Es twee gelieke diere naeve elkander zeen en in de Liefdesmodus zeen, kösse zie eve en dan erschient 'n babydier! 't Babydier blieft bij hunne oldere totdet zie volwasse zeen. Nao 'n baby te höbbe gehad, moote volwasse diere 1 minuut wachte veurdet zie de Liefdesmodus weer könne binnegaon.

source_string: Cows, mooshrooms, and sheep all eat Wheat. Pigs can eat Carrots or Beetroot. Chickens love Seeds of any kinds. Rabbits will eat Carrots, Golden Carrots, or Dandelions. Ocelots enjoy Raw Cod or Salmon. Wolves like to eat any kind of meat.
translation: Koeë, mooshrooms, en sjaop aete alle Kaore. Verke könne Peekes of Bietwortel aete. Kiekes höbbe alle Zaad graeg. Kónikke aete Peekes, Gaole peekes, of Paardebloome. Ocelots höbbe Rauwe kabeljauw of Zalm graeg. Wólve aete graeg eder vörm vaan vlees.

source_string: Animals will follow you when you hold their desired food item. This will help you lead them to your ranch or another animal.
translation: Diere volge diech es doe hun gewenste aete vashaods. Dit hölpt diech ze te leje nao diech boerderij of 'n angere dier.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply click a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Gein zörg, doe moots neet eder recept oet 't kop kenne. 't §ereceptebook§f in diech inventaris haod bij welke blokke en items doe kans craften - klik gewoen op 'n recept óm te zeen waat doe noedig höbs óm 't te craften.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply select a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Gein zörg, doe moots neet eder recept oet 't kop kenne. 't §ereceptebook§f in diech inventaris haod bij welke blokke en items doe kans craften - selekteer gewoen 'n recept óm te zeen waat doe noedig höbs óm 't te craften.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply tap a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Gein zörg, doe moots neet eder recept oet 't kop kenne. 't §ereceptebook§f in diech inventaris haod bij welke blokke en items doe kans craften - tik gewoen op 'n recept óm te zeen waat doe noedig höbs óm 't te craften.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, click the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Ins te de veurgesjreve craftingredienten verzameld höbs, klik nog ins op 't recept, en versjuif 't dan vaan de oetvoersleuf nao diech hotbar of inventaris.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, select the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Ins te de veurgesjreve craftingredienten verzameld höbs, selekteer nog ins 't recept, en versjuif 't dan vaan de oetvoersleuf nao diech hotbar of inventaris.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, tap the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Ins te de veurgesjreve craftingredienten verzameld höbs, tik nog ins op 't recept, en versjuif 't dan vaan de oetvoersleuf nao diech hotbar of inventaris.

source_string: Redstone Dust comes from Redstone Ore. This dust transmits an electrical signal. When it has power it lights up and transmits its signal to other Redstone items that are next to it.
translation: Redstonepoeder kump vaan Redstoneërts. Dees poeder verzendt 'n elektrisch signaal. Es 't kraf hèt, licht 't op en verzendt zieng signaal nao angere Redstoneitems die d'rnaeve zeen.

source_string: In order for one of these items to be powered, it needs a power source such as a Lever, Button, or Pressure Plate. Experiment to find them all!
translation: Óm eder vaan dees items vaan kraf te veurzeen, hèt 't 'ne kraftbrón noedig zoeas 'ne haaindel, knop, of drökplaot. Experimenteer óm ze allemaol te vènje!

source_string: Place some Redstone Dust next to a power source and turn it on to power it.
translation: Plaots get Redstonepoeder naeve 'ne kraftbrón en zet 'm aan óm 't vaan kraf te veurzeen.

source_string: There are many items that use a Redstone signal to do something, such as a Hopper or a Piston.
translation: D'r zeen väöl items die 'n Redstonesignaal gebroeke óm get te doon, zoeas 'ne Trechter of 'ne Zoegpomp.

source_string: Redstone allows for endless possibilities! Try creating something useful for yourself like an automatic farm!
translation: Redstone laet ónbeperk mögelikheite toe! Probeer get bruikbaars te make veur diechzelf wie 'n automaatische boerderij!

source_string: A social hub for you and all the members of the Realm. Share your adventures and creations by posting stories to the Story Feed, like and comment to celebrate stories posted by other members.
translation: 'ne Sociale trefpunt veur diech en alle ledje vaan de Realm. Deil diech aoventuure en creaties door verhaole te plaotse op de Verhaolefeed, leuk en kommentaar óm verhaole vaan angere ledje te vieren.

source_string: Clicking the ADD STORY button on the Story Feed will let you write a story of your own. You can choose to include a screenshot or text (or both!). Clicking the POST button will post your text/screenshot to the Story Feed for all the Realm's members to enjoy. If you don't have any screenshots to post, use the §ecamera§f:camera: on the game menu to capture the moment.
translation: Klik op de VERHAOL TOEVOEGE-knop op de Verhaolefeed óm diech eige verhaol te sjrieve. Doe kans keze óm 'n sjermaafbeelding of tekst (of beide!) toe te voege. Klik op de PLAOTSE-knop óm diech tekst/sjermaafbeelding op de Verhaolefeed te plaotse veur alle ledje vaan de Realm óm te genete. Es doe gein sjermaafbeeldinge höbs óm te plaotse, gebroek de §ecamera§f:camera: op 't sjpelmenu óm 't moment vas te legge.

source_string: Whenever there is a new story in the Feed that you haven't read yet, a number will appear on the REALMS STORIES button. You'll always know when there is something new to read from your Realm's community. If you like what someone shared, go ahead and leave them a like or comment on their story!
translation: Wenneer d'r 'n nuuj verhaol in de Feed sjteet detste noch neet gelaeze höbs, erschient 'ne nummer op de REALMS STORIES-knop. Doe wees altied wenneer d'r get nuuj te laeze is vaan diech Realm's gemeinschap. Es doe leuk vinjs waat emes deelde, gaef dan 'n leuke of kommentaar op hun verhaol!

source_string: See who's playing and when in the Timeline. Scroll through the members of the Realm to see when they played last and who they played with. Use this information to set up times when you can all play together.
translation: Zuug wieë sjpelt en wenneer in de Tiedlien. Scroll door de ledje vaan de Realm óm te zeen wenneer zie 't lëts sjpelde en mèt wieë. Gebroek dees info óm tieden aaf te sjpreke wo te allemaol samen kans sjpele.

source_string: Know who is on the Realm
translation: Weet wieë op de Realm is

source_string: Get to know who is part of the Realm by using the Members tab. It's a list of all the players who can play here. You can see who the Realm owner is, who the operators are, and who has joined Realms Stories for this Realm. There are search, sort, and filter options to help you find exactly who you're looking for.
translation: Leer wieë ónjerdeel is vaan de Realm door 't Ledjetabblad te gebroeke. 't Is 'n lieste vaan alle sjpelers die hie könne sjpele. Doe kans zeen wieë de Realm-eigenaer is, wieë de operators zeen, en wieë Realms Stories veur dees Realm is binnegegaon. D'r zeen zeukj-, sorteer-, en filteropties óm diech te hölpe precies te vènje wieë doe zeuks.

source_string: Realms Stories is available in the game menu when you're playing in the Realm and on the Realms Tab. You can keep up to date and tell your story from anywhere you are, even when you aren't playing. From your console, computer, and mobile device, Realms Stories is available everywhere.
translation: Realms Stories is besjikbaar in 't sjpelmenu terwiel te sjpels in de Realm en op 't Realms-tabblad. Doe kans up to date blieve en diech verhaol vertelle vaan eder plaats wo doe bis, zelfs es doe neet sjpels. Vaan diech console, computer, en mobiel toestel, Realms Stories is euveral besjikbaar.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :_input_key.jump:. If you want to travel downward you can press :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Sjtellage kan diech hölpe om grôte structure veilig te make! Doe kans loupe binne sjtellage en d'rop staon. Es doe ein kolom vaan sjtellage höbs, kans te noa boave gaon door in de sjtellage te staon en :_input_key.jump: te drökke. Es doe nao ónjer wils gaon, kans te drökke op :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :_input_key.jump:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Sjtellage kan diech hölpe om grôte structure veilig te make! Doe kans loupe binne sjtellage en d'rop staon. Es doe ein kolom vaan sjtellage höbs, kans te noa boave gaon door in de sjtellage te staon en :_input_key.jump: te drökke. Es doe nao ónjer wils gaon, kans te drökke en ingedrök haode op :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help with building large structures by offering a way to reach higher places and safely descend without taking fall damage.
translation: Sjtellage kan hölpe bij 't bouwe vaan grote structure door 'n manier te gaeve óm hoegere plaatse te bereike en veilig aaf te dale zónger valschade.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_jump: to climb up a column of scaffolding. Tap :touch_fly_down: to climb down.
translation: Bij gebroek vaan 't D-Pad-besjturingsschema, tik :touch_jump: óm 'n kolom vaan sjtellage op te klimme. Tik :touch_fly_down: óm aaf te klimme.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, press :tip_virtual_button_jump: to climb up a column of scaffolding. Tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak: to climb down.
translation: Bij gebroek vaan 'n Joystick-besjturingsschema, druk :tip_virtual_button_jump: óm 'n kolom vaan sjtellage op te klimme. Tik :tip_virtual_button_sneak: óm aaf te klimme.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :rift_A:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :rift_X:.
translation: Sjtellage kan diech hölpe om grôte structure veilig te make! Doe kans loupe binne sjtellage en d'rop staon. Es doe ein kolom vaan sjtellage höbs, kans te noa boave gaon door in de sjtellage te staon en :rift_A: te drökke. Es doe nao ónjer wils gaon, kans te drökke en ingedrök haode op :rift_X:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :windowsmr_right_touchpad:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :windowsmr_right_stick:.
translation: Sjtellage kan diech hölpe om grôte structure veilig te make! Doe kans loupe binne sjtellage en d'rop staon. Es doe ein kolom vaan sjtellage höbs, kans te noa boave gaon door in de sjtellage te staon en :windowsmr_right_touchpad: te drökke. Es doe nao ónjer wils gaon, kans te drökke en ingedrök haode op :windowsmr_right_stick:.

source_string: Scaffolding needs support. You can only place so many scaffolding horizontally without touching a different block. When you attempt to place too many scaffolding blocks without proper support, it will fall. Scaffolding can be placed like normal blocks, but it can also be placed on its own foundation to quickly build a tall tower.
translation: Sjtellage hèt ondersteuning noedig. Doe kans allein zoevöl sjtellage horizontaal plaotse zónger 'ne angere blok aan te raoke. Es doe probeers te väöl sjtellageblokke te plaotse zónger juuste ondersteuning, zal 't valle. Sjtellage kan geplaats wure wie normale blokke, mer 't kan ouch op zieng eige fundament geplaats wure óm sjnel 'ne hoge toren te bouwe.

source_string: When Scaffolding is broken it will also break every Scaffolding block that was being supported by it. This will let you quickly clean up your scaffolding by breaking the supporting blocks!
translation: Es Sjtellage kapot gaeit, breekt 't ouch eder Sjtellageblok af det d'r door woor ondersteund. Dit laet diech sjnel diech sjtellage opruime door de ondersteunendje blokke te breke!

source_string: Put on some fresh pixels and express yourself with a huge variety of inspired looks.
translation: Trèk get fresse pixels aan en druk diechzelf oet mèt 'n grote verscheidenheid aan geïnspireerde looks.

source_string: Structure Blocks give creators the ability to copy and save out sections of their world into structures. Saved structures can then be pasted back into the world.
translation: Structuurblokke gaeve makers de mögelikheid óm sekties vaan hunne waereld te kopiëre en op te sjlage es structure. Opgeslagje structure könne dan weer terug in de waereld geplakt wure.

source_string: To get a Structure Block you must use the /give slash command. To use a Structure Block, you must have Operator permissions.
translation: Óm 'ne Structuurblok te kriege moots te de /give-sjlaghoge-opdrach gebroeke. Óm 'ne Structuurblok te gebroeke, moots te Operator-permissies höbbe.

source_string: Structure Blocks have 4 modes that can be switched between with the Mode dropdown: Save, Load, Corner, and 3D Export.
translation: Structuurblokke höbbe 4 modusse die geswitcht könne wure via de Modus-klapmenu: Opsjlage, Laje, Hook, en 3D-exporteere.

source_string: Save mode saves an area of the world as a structure.
translation: Opsjlage-modus sjlaog 'n gebeed vaan de waereld op es 'n structuur.

source_string: Load mode loads a structure into the world. Only structures saved to the world or included in a behavior pack that is applied to the world can be loaded.
translation: Laje-modus laadt 'n structuur in de waereld. Allein structure opgeslage in de waereld of ingesloate in 'n gedraogspack die toegepast is op de waereld, könne gelaje wure.

source_string: Corner mode is used with save mode's detect button to automatically set the area you want to save. See the Corner Mode section below for more details.
translation: Hook-modus wuurt gebroek mèt de detecteerknop vaan de opsjlage-modus óm automaatisch 't gebeed det te wils opsjlage in te stelle. Zuug de Hookmodus-sectie ónjer veur mie details.

source_string: 3D Export exports a 3D model file on supported platforms.
On the right side of the Structure Block screen, a preview of the area you have selected or the structure to load will appear depending on the mode the block is in.
translation: Rechs op 't Structuurblok-sjerm erschient 'n veurbekiek vaan 't gebeed deste geselekteerd höbs of de structuur óm te laje, aafhankelik vaan de modus wo 't blok in sjteet.

source_string: Press :_input_key.attack: and drag, to rotate the 3D preview.
translation: Druk :_input_key.attack: en versjuif, óm de 3D-veurbekiek te draaie.

source_string: Touch and drag on the preview to rotate the 3D preview.
translation: Raok en versjuif op de veurbekiek óm de 3D-veurbekiek te draaie.

source_string: Redstone can be used to activate a Structure Block. This will cause it to either save a structure out or load a structure into the world, depending on the mode of the block and its settings.
translation: Redstone kan gebroek wure óm 'ne Structuurblok te aktiveere. Dit zal 'm of 'n structuur laote opsjlage of laje in de waereld, aafhankelik vaan de modus vaan 't blok en zieng insjtellinge.

source_string: You can change how much of a structure is loaded in by changing the values for Integrity and Seed.
translation: Doe kans veranderen wovöl vaan 'n structuur wuurt gelaje door de waerdes veur Integriteit en Seed te veranderen.

source_string: Integrity - the percentage of blocks to load in from the structure, accepted values are 0 to 100. Blocks will be chosen randomly if a Seed is not specified.
translation: Integriteit - 't percentaog blokke te laje vaan de structuur, geaksepteerdje waerdes zeen 0 tot 100. Blokke wure raandóm gekozen es d'r gein Seed is opgegeve.

source_string: Seed - the value entered here will determine which blocks to remove when using Integrity. Leave this field blank if you want the blocks to be chosen randomly.
translation: Seed - de waerde hie ingeveuerd besjeis welke blokke te verwiedere bij 't gebroeke vaan Integriteit. Loat dit veld laeg es doe wils det de blokke raandóm gekozen wure.

source_string: When a structure with Structure Void blocks is loaded into the world, any block that would have been removed where the structure void block is loading into, will instead stay in the world.
translation: Es 'n structuur mèt Structuurleegteblokke gelaje wuurt in de waereld, blieft eder blok det zol wure verwiederd wo de structuurleegteblok wuurt gelaje, in de waereld staon.

source_string: Example: loading an empty shipwreck into the bottom of the ocean will normally copy air over the water blocks. If the shipwreck was filled with structure void, then the water will stay, and you will have a shipwreck filled with water.
translation: Veurbeeld: 'n laeg sjipswrak in de bedëmp vaan de oceaan laje kopieert normaal loeft euver de waterblokke. Es 't sjipswrak gevuld woor mèt structuurleegte, blieft 't water staon, en höbs te 'ne sjipswrak vol water.

source_string: To automatically select the area you want to save, you can place Corner Mode blocks around your structure and name them with the same name as the structure you want to save.
translation: Óm automaatisch 't gebeed te selektere det te wils opsjlage, kans te Hookmodusblokke róndj diech structuur plaotse en ze de zelfde naam gaeve es de structuur die te wils opsjlage.

source_string: Pressing the Detect button in Save mode will find all of the Corner Blocks with the same name and create a selection area so that it will save everything inside of the volume those Corner Blocks make.
translation: 't Drökke vaan de Detecteerknop in Opsjlage-modus vinjt alle Hookblokke mèt de zelfde naam en maak 'n selectiegebeed zoedet 't alles binne de omvang die dees Hookblokke vörme, opsjlagt.

source_string: Combine two Shulker Shells with a Chest to create a Shulker Box. Shulker Shells are dropped by Shulkers found in End Cities. Unlike other containers, Shulker Boxes keep their items when broken. Shulker Boxes will break and drop as an item if pushed by Pistons, and can be placed using Dispensers.
translation: Combineer twee Shulkersjèlpe mèt 'n Kis óm 'n Shulkerdoeas te make. Shulkersjèlpe wure vaan Shulkers gedropp gevónje in Endstädje. Angers es angere containers, haode Shulkerdoeas hunne items ins zie breke. Shulkerdoeas breke en valle es item es zie geduwd wure door Zoegpompe, en könne geplaats wure via Dispensers.

source_string: How to Play: The Crafting Table
Ready to take your crafting to the next level? Place four planks in a square in your crafting grid, and you'll get a §ecrafting table§f :crafting_table: - a whole new way to craft.
translation: Klaor óm diech craften nao 't volgend niveau te trèkke? Plaots vier plankjes in 'n vierkant op diech craftrooster, en te kriejs 'n §ewerkbank§f :crafting_table: - 'ne ganse nuuj manier óm te craften.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then right-click it to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Plaots diech werkbank in de waereld, en klik dan rechs d'rop óm 't te ëpene. 't Gröttere craftrooster laet diech gröttere en betere zaake make, mèt daoronder gereedsjap, bèdje, en duere.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then walk up to it and press :_input_key.use: to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Plaots diech werkbank in de waereld, en loup dan d'r nao toe en druk :_input_key.use: óm 't te ëpene. 't Gröttere craftrooster laet diech gröttere en betere zaake make, mèt daoronder gereedsjap, bèdje, en duere.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then tap it to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Plaots diech werkbank in de waereld, en tik dan d'rop óm 't te ëpene. 't Gröttere craftrooster laet diech gröttere en betere zaake make, mèt daoronder gereedsjap, bèdje, en duere.

source_string: The End is another dimension which can be accessed through an active End Portal. The End Portal can be found in a Stronghold, which is deep underground in the Overworld.
translation: De End is 'n angere dimensie die te bereike is door 'n aktief Endpoort. De Endpoort kan gevónje wure in 'ne Fort, die deep ónjer de grónj lig in de Euverwaereld.

source_string: Every End Portal Frame block is missing something mysterious to bring out the power within.
translation: Eder Endpoortkader-blok mist get mysterieus óm de kraf d'rin te oetbrenge.

source_string: Once the portal is active, jump into it to go to The End.
translation: Ins 't portaal aktief is, sjpring d'rin óm nao The End te gaon.

source_string: The End is home to the dreaded Ender Dragon. She is a fierce and powerful enemy and seems to draw power from strange crystals. Her breath and fireball attacks leave lingering acid across the battlefield. Bring some friends to ensure your victory!
translation: The End is thoes veur de gevreesde Ender Dragon. Ze is 'n fel en machtig vijand en liek kraf te haole vaan vreem kristalle. Har aodem- en vuurbalaanvalle laote nablievend zuur euver 't sjlachveld. Brèng get vrunj óm diech euverwinning te verzeekere!

source_string: If once wasn't enough, add four End Crystals to the exit portal corners to reawaken the Ender Dragon.
translation: Es einmaol neet genóg woor, veug vier Endkristalle toe aan de oetgankspoorthook óm de Ender Dragon te herwekke.

source_string: Texture packs visually transform the game's appearance, applying a fresh coat of paint to your Minecraft world.
translation: Texturepacks transformere visueel 't oetzeen vaan 't sjpel, en gaeve 'n frisse laag verf aan diech Minecraft-waereld.

source_string: There are many tools in Minecraft that will allow you mine blocks faster than your fist. Tools can be crafted from Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite.
translation: D'r zeen väöl gereedsjap in Minecraft die diech laete blokke sjneller mine es mèt diech vuus. Gereedsjap kan gecraft wure vaan holt, sjtein, iezer, gaol, diamant, of Netherit.

source_string: Using the right tool for the job will not only mine that block faster, but will also lose less durability. More complex tools must be created in order to mine rarer resources.
translation: 't Juuste gereedsjap gebroeke veur de klus zal neet allein die blok sjneller mine, mer ouch minder duurzaomheid verliese. Complexere gereedsjap moot gemaak wure óm zeldzamere resources te mine.

source_string: The Pickaxe is good at breaking hard blocks like Cobblestone, Iron, or Furnaces.
translation: De Pikhouwel is gooj in 't breke vaan hardje blokke wie Kobblesjtein, iezer, of Ovens.

source_string: The Axe is good at breaking wooden blocks like Logs, Planks, or Crafting Tables.
translation: De Bijl is gooj in 't breke vaan hooten blokke wie Hoottblökke, Plankjes, of Werkbenke.

source_string: The Shovel is good at breaking loose blocks like Dirt, Sand, and Gravel. Shovels can also create a path by pressing :_input_key.use: on grass blocks.
translation: De Sjop is gooj in 't breke vaan losse blokke wie grónj, zand, en gruus. Sjoppe könne ouch 'n pad make door :_input_key.use: te drökke op graasblokke.

source_string: The Shovel is good at breaking loose blocks like Dirt, Sand, and Gravel. Shovels can also create a path by tapping on grass blocks.
translation: De Sjop is gooj in 't breke vaan losse blokke wie grónj, zand, en gruus. Sjoppe könne ouch 'n pad make door te tikke op graasblokke.

source_string: The Hoe is required for tilling Dirt to plant crops. Press :_input_key.use: on Dirt or Grass blocks to turn them into Farmland.
translation: De Hak is noedig veur 't bewerke vaan grónj óm geweas te plante. Druk :_input_key.use: op grónj- of graasblokke óm ze te veranderen nao landbouwgrónj.

source_string: The Hoe is required for tilling Dirt to plant crops. Tap Dirt or Grass blocks to turn them into Farmland.
translation: De Hak is noedig veur 't bewerke vaan grónj óm geweas te plante. Tik grónj- of graasblokke óm ze te veranderen nao landbouwgrónj.

source_string: All of these tools can accept enchantments, either from the Enchanting Table or Anvil.
translation: Alle vaan dees gereedsjap kanne betouveringe akkepteere, of vaan 't Betouvertaofel of 't Aambeeld.

source_string: There are even more tools to aid you on your adventure:
translation: D'r zeen noch mie gereedsjap óm diech te hölpe op diech aoventuur:

source_string: A Bucket will allow you to collect things like Water, Milk, Lava, and even Fish.
translation: 'ne Emmer laet diech zaake verzamele wie water, mèlk, lava, en zelfs vès.

source_string: Flint & Steel allows you to light fires... be careful in densely wooded areas!
translation: Vuursteen & Iezer laet diech vuur aansjteke... wees veurzichtig in dicht beboste gebeede!

source_string: A Fishing Rod lets you catch fish and other loot from water blocks. It can also be used to pull other players and mobs. Fishing Rods can also be enchanted!
translation: 'ne Vèsgaert laet diech vès en angere loot vaan waterblokke haole. 't Kan ouch gebroek wure óm angere sjpelers en mobs te trèkke. Vèsgaerte könne ouch betouverd wure!

source_string: Shears are very handy for collecting items like Wool, Leaves, and Cobwebs.
translation: Sjaer zeen zieër handig veur 't verzamele vaan items wie wol, blaaier, en sjpinnewéb.

source_string: Trading can be done in villages. Each villager has a profession; they can be Farmers, Butchers, Blacksmiths, Cartographers, Librarians, or Priests. Some professions will trade for items that other professions cannot. Explore and trade with many villagers to find all the trades.
translation: Hendel kan gedaon wure in durpe. Eder durpeling hèt 'n beroep; zie könne Boere, Sjlachters, Smede, Kaortentekeners, Bibliotecarisse, of Priestere zeen. Sómmige beroepe hendele items die angere neet könne. Ontdèk en handel mèt väöl durpelinge óm alle hendele te vènje.

source_string: You can find out what a villager is offering as trade by interacting with them. A villager may adjust the price of a trade whenever a player trades with it. A villager may run out of stock, temporarily disabling the trade if it is used too frequently. Trades usually involve buying or selling items for emeralds.
translation: Doe kans oetvènje waat 'ne durpeling aanbeut es hendel door mèt hun te interagere. 'ne Durpeling kan de pries vaan 'n hendel aanpasse eder kier détste mèt hum handels. 'ne Durpeling kan zónjer voorraod raake, wat de hendel tiedelik oetsjakelt es 't te väöl gebroek wuurt. Hendele geet mieëstwoal euver 't koupe of verkoupe vaan items veur smaragde.

source_string: As you trade with villagers, they will get better at their profession and start to offer better and more valuable trades.
translation: Es te met durpelinge handels, wure zie beter in hunne beroep en beginne zie betere en waardevollere hendele aan te beje.

source_string: Take care of your villagers, they need to rest, work, and eat to thrive.
translation: Zörg veur diech durpelinge, zie moote rüste, werke, en aete óm te gedeie.

source_string: There are many ways to get around other than walking or riding a mount or flying.
translation: D'r zeen väöl maniere óm róndj te kómme angers es te loupe of te rije op 'n dier of te vlege.

source_string: Minecarts are ridable carts that roll on Rails. You can make the Rails go wherever you want by placing them next to each other. Place a Minecart on the Rails and you are ready to ride.
translation: Mienkarre zeen riebaar karre die rolle op rails. Doe kans de rails laote gaon wo doe wils door ze naeve elkander te plaotse. Plaots 'ne Mienkar op de rails en doe bis kloor óm te rije.

source_string: Minecarts are ridable carts that roll on Rails, which you can build to go anywhere. Just place multiple Rails next to each other, place a Minecart on it, and you're ready to ride.
translation: Mienkarre zeen riebaar karre die rolle op rails, die te kans bouwe óm te gaon wo te wils. Plaots gewoen mieër rails naeve elkander, plaots 'ne Mienkar d'rop, en doe bis kloor óm te rije.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: terwiel te nao 'ne Mienkar kieks óm d'rin te sjtappe en te rije. Druk :_input_key.forward: óm veuruut te rolle. Druk :_input_key.jump: of :_input_key.sneak: óm oet te sjtappe.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Minecart to hop in and ride. Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward to roll forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Druk :_input_key.use: terwiel te nao 'ne Mienkar kieks óm d'rin te sjtappe en te rije. Druk :_gamepad_stick_left: veuruut óm veuruut te rolle. Druk :_input_key.jump: of :_input_key.sneak: óm oet te sjtappe.

source_string: Look at a Minecart and tap "Ride" to hop in.
translation: Kiek nao 'ne Mienkar en tik "Rije" óm in te sjtappe.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap and hold :touch_forward: to start moving forward and build momentum, and tap :touch_jump: to get out.
translation: Bij gebroek vaan 't D-Pad-besjturingsschema, tik en haod :touch_forward: ingedrök óm veuruut te beginne bewaege en momentum te bouwe, en tik :touch_jump: óm oet te sjtappe.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, drag :tip_virtual_joystick: up to start moving forward and build momentum, and tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to get out.
translation: Bij gebroek vaan 'n Joystick-besjturingsschema, versjuif :tip_virtual_joystick: naor boave óm veuruut te beginne bewaege en momentum te bouwe, en tik :tip_virtual_button_dismount: óm oet te sjtappe.

source_string: Boats let you travel across water. Place one on a water block and you are ready to go.
translation: Boeaters late diech euver 't water reize. Plaots ein op 'n waterblok en doe bis kloor óm te gaon.

source_string: Boats let you travel across water. Just place one on a water block and you're ready to go.
translation: Boeaters late diech euver 't water reize. Plaots gewoen ein op 'n waterblok en doe bis kloor óm te gaon.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press :_input_key.forward: to move forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.

source_string: Our ability to support this VR/MR graphic device has come to an end. translation: Ós ondersjteuning veur dit VR/MR-graphicstoestel geet bènkort aafgeloupe. source_string: Our ability to support this VR/MR graphic device has come to an end. This VR/MR device is no longer supported. You have received the final update supporting this graphics device, and you will still receive updates on your PC and be able to play without a VR/MR device. From this point on you can keep building in your worlds, and your Marketplace purchases (including Minecoins) will continue to be available on a non-VR/MR graphics devices such as a computer monitor. You will no longer be able to use your VR/MR device with Minecraft as it will no longer be supported in the latest updates.%sClick on the button for more information. We know this is an inconvenience, and deeply appreciate the time you spent with our game, and your support.
translation: Ós ondersjteuning veur dit VR/MR-graphicstoestel is aafgeloupe. Dit VR/MR-toestel weurt neet mie ondersjtund. Se hébs dien lèste update veur dit graphicstoestel al gehad, en se kries nog altied updates op dien PC en kins sjpeule zonder VR/MR-toestel. Vanaaf noe kins se doorgaon te bouwe in dien waerelde, en dien Marketplace-aankäöp (mit inbegrip van Minecoins) bliewe besjikbaar op non-VR/MR-graphicstoestelle zoas e computerscherm. Se kins dien VR/MR-toestel neet mie gebroeke mit Minecraft, want dat weurt neet mie ondersjtund in de nuujste updates.%sKlik op de knóp veur mie informatie. Weer wete dat dit óngerief is, en waardere 't zeer det se tied mit ós sjpel doorgebrach hébs, en dien ondersjteuning.

source_string: Don't stop with just one! You can load multiple Add-Ons onto a single world at once.
translation: Höw neet op bie ein! Se kins mierdere Add-Ons tegeliekertied op ein waereld laje.

translation: Geavanceerde tip: e Resource Pack kan de textures van versjillende blokke en entiteite verangere.

translation: Geavanceerde tip: e Behavior Pack kan verangere wie versjillende voorwerpe, entiteite of blokke werke.

source_string: Add-Ons add new blocks, items, or mobs to your worlds.
translation: Add-Ons voege nuuje blokke, voorwerpe of mobs toe aan dien waerelde.

source_string: Worlds and Add-ons are complex! While some work great together, you might get funky results with others.
translation: Waerelde en Add-Ons zeen complex! Sommige werke good tegoare, mer bie angere kins se rare resultate kriege.

source_string: More Add-Ons mean more fun, but the game might take longer to load.

source_string: This world has required Resource Packs from Add-Ons applied to it. Would you like to download them and join?

source_string: Not enough local free space to support cloud sync.

source_string: The world has been corrupted. Please report this at bugs.mojang.com

source_string: Resource packs are applied bottom to top. This means any asset that is in two packs will be overridden by the higher pack.
translation: Resource packs waere toegepas van ónder nao boven. Dit betekent det eder aet det in twie pakke sjteet, weurt euverschreve door 't hoegere pak.

source_string: You can edit these in Settings.

source_string: Resource packs are applied bottom to top. This means any asset that is in two packs will be overridden by the higher pack. Packs in your worlds will apply on top of these global packs. These resources are just for you. No one else will see the resources you set here. Resource Packs in your worlds or worlds you join will apply on top of these global resources.
translation: Resource packs waere toegepas van ónder nao boven. Dit betekent det eder aet det in twie pakke sjteet, weurt euverschreve door 't hoegere pak. Pakke in dien waerelde waere toegepas boven op deze globale pakke. Deze resources zeen allein veur dich. Niemest angesj zuut de resources die se hie insjtèls. Resource Packs in dien waerelde of waerelde woe se bie toetreeds, waere toegepas boven op deze globale resources.

source_string: Behavior Packs are applied bottom to top. That means anything that is in two Behavior Packs will be overridden by the higher one.
translation: Behavior Packs waere toegepas van ónder nao boven. Dit betekent det alles det in twie Behavior Packs sjteet, weurt euverschreve door 't hoegere.

source_string: Resource packs are applied bottom to top. This means any asset that is in two packs will be overridden by the higher pack. These packs in your world apply on top of your global pack(s).

translation: Inhoud in deze waereld weurt neet oondersteund door Minecraft Education.
