translation: Wils se diene waereld noe speule?

source_string: Adding an external server requires knowing the server name and server IP address. Once added, the server can be found in the server list for play.
translation: Veur 't toeveuge van eine externe server moot se de servernaam en 't server-IP-adres wisse. Ins toegeveug, kan de server gevonge wuure in de serverlies veur te speule.

source_string: This server has already been added

translation: Selectaer alles wat van toepassing is:
Duurde te lang oem te laje

source_string: Got stuck on an error message
I didn't know it was free
translation: Ich wos neet dat 't gratis waor

source_string: I thought I needed a Xbox console
translation: Ich dach dat ich e Xbox-console noedig had

source_string: Feedback: Why didn't you sign in?
translation: Feedback: Woróm hesse dich neet aongemeld?

source_string: You can hold down Shift to take a close up picture using the Camera.
translation: Se kanne Shift ingedrök hawwe oem eine close-up-foto te make mit de camera.

source_string: Unlike Signs, you can edit Slates, Posters, and Boards over and over again.
translation: In tegesjtelling tot bordjes, kanse leie, posters en boorde telkes opnuuts bewerken.

source_string: Use Ctrl+B to turn on text-to-speech capabilities for in-game chat.
translation: Gebroek Ctrl+B oem teks-nao-sjpraok in te sjakele veur de in-game-chat.

source_string: You can export your Minecraft world to share it with others.
translation: Se kanne diene Minecraft-waereld exportere oem 'm mit angere te deile.

source_string: To have your peers connect to your world, pause your game and share your join code.
translation: Oem diene klasgenote mit diene waereld te laote verbinje, pauzeer diene sjpel en deil dien toetredingscode.

source_string: Remember that to use slash commands, you need to enable cheats in your world.
translation: Denk der aan dat se cheats moots inschakele in diene waereld oem slash-commando's te gebroeke.

source_string: Done with your creation? Have others tour your world as visitors to protect your work.
translation: Klaor mit diene creatie? Laot angere door diene waereld toere es bezeukers oem diene werk te beschermen.

source_string: To code in Minecraft, press "C" on your keyboard or touch the Agent icon at the top of your screen.
translation: Oem te codere in Minecraft, druk op "C" op dien toetseboord of raak 't Agent-icoon aan boaven op dien scherm.

source_string: Use the Library to find new game worlds to build in.
translation: Gebroek de bibliotheek oem nuuj sjpelwaerelde te vinje oem in te bouwe.

source_string: Looking for a specific biome? Try the Library.
translation: Op zeuk nao eine specifieke biotoop? Probeer de bibliotheek.

source_string: In Survival Mode, players must find their own resources.
translation: In Survival-modus moote sjpelers hun eige rijkdomme vinje.

source_string: In Creative Mode, players can freely choose to build from any of the blocks in Minecraft.
translation: In Creative-modus kanne sjpelers vriej keeze veur te bouwe mit gelieke welk blok in Minecraft.

source_string: Your code building robot helper is called the Agent.
Redstone can be used in Minecraft to create circuits and simple machines.
translation: Redstone kan gebroekt wuure in Minecraft veur circuits en simpel machiene te make.

source_string: You can copy and paste from a text editor to a slate, poster, board, or into chat.
translation: Se kanne kopiere en plakke van eine teksteditor nao eine leie, poster, boord, of in de chat.

source_string: Show hints for commonly-used keyboard and mouse controls by pressing "H" on your keyboard.
translation: Toon hints veur veul gebroekde toetseboord- en muisbesjturinge door op "H" te drukken op dien toetseboord.

source_string: You can toggle Auto Jump on or off in the Settings menu under Controls.
translation: Se kanne Auto Sprong aan of oet zette in 't Insjtellingemenu oonder Besjturinge.

source_string: While in Creative Mode, quickly press jump twice to fly.
translation: In Creative-modus, druk sjnel tweemaol op sprong oem te vleie.

source_string: Choose a Default Game Mode when creating a world to specify the type of gameplay you want.
translation: Kees eine sjtandaard sjpelmodus bie 't make van eine waereld oem 't tiep sjpel te bepaole dat se wils.

source_string: Use the command "/setworldspawn" to have new players begin playing where you are standing.
translation: Gebroek 't commando "/setworldspawn" oem nuuj sjpelers te laote beginne woe se sjteis.

source_string: Choose a default player permission when creating your world to specify the permissions you want your classmates to have when they join.
translation: Kees eine sjtandaard sjpelerspermissie bie 't make van diene waereld oem te bepaole welke permissies diene klasgenote hebbe wanneer ze toetreden.

source_string: Press "I" on your keyboard or touch the Immersive Reader icon to read or translate in-game text.
translation: Druk op "I" op dien toetseboord of raak 't Immersive Reader-icoon aan oem in-game-teks te laeze of te vertale.

source_string: To add or change an NPC in your world, first make yourself a world builder with "/wb".
translation: Oem eine NPC toe te veuge of te veranjere in diene waereld, mak dich eerst waereldbouwer mit "/wb".

source_string: There's a brand new build challenge every month! Find them all in the Library under Monthly Build Challenges.
translation: Der is eine gans nuuje bouwoetdaging edere maond! Vin ze allemaol in de bibliotheek oonder Maondelikse Bouwoetdaginge.

source_string: Find related lessons by clicking on tags in the Library.
translation: Vin verwante lesse door op tags te klikke in de bibliotheek.

source_string: Game moving slowly? Try turning down the render distance in Settings.
translation: Sjpel geit langsaam? Probeer de renderaafstand nao ónger te zette in Insjtellinge.

source_string: Want to use Code Builder? Make sure cheats are toggled on.
translation: Wils se de Codebouwer gebroeke? Wees zeker dat cheats aan sjtaon.

source_string: Press F5 to change player perspective.
translation: Druk op F5 oem 't sjpelersperspectief te veranjere.

source_string: Use "/spawnpoint" to change your spawn point. It's just like you slept in a bed!
translation: Gebroek "/spawnpoint" oem dien sjpawnpunt te veranjere. 't Is net esof se in e bèd geslaope hesse!

source_string: Most monsters only come out at night. During the day you're safe... probably.
translation: De mieste monsters kómme allein 's nachs boete. Overdaag ben se vaeilig... vermeundelik.

source_string: Break blocks, pick up resources. Use the crafting grid to make helpful items. Now you're crafting!
translation: Brek blokke, verzammel rijkdomme. Gebroek 't vervaardigingsroeëster oem hulpvolle veurwerpe te make. Noe bis se an 't vervaardige!

source_string: You have endless lives, but your items drop to the ground when you die. Hurry back to pick them up!
translation: Se hebbe onendige laeve, mer diene veurwerpe valle op de grond wanneer se dood gees. Haas dich trök oem ze op te rapen!

source_string: It's a good idea to build a place where you can safely spend the night.
translation: 't Is eine goei idee oem eine plaats te bouwe woe se vaeilig de nach kans doorbrenge.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Chopping wood with an axe is much faster than using your hands.
translation: Gebroek 't jueste gereedschap veur de klus! Hout kappe mit eine bijl geit vöal sjneller es mit dien hangs.

source_string: Even in Minecraft you'll get hungry, so try to find something to eat before that happens.
translation: Zelfs in Minecraft kries se hoonger, dus probeer get te vinje oem te aete veurdat dat gebeurt.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up might not be a great idea.
translation: Recht nao onger of recht nao boaven graven is meugelik geen goei idee.

source_string: Monsters spawn in the dark. Craft a torch to brighten up any space.
translation: Monsters sjpawne in 't duuster. Vervaardig eine fakkel oem elke ruumde lechter te make.

source_string: Beds are great! Craft one to quickly pass the night and set your respawn point.
translation: Bedde zint jans! Vervaardig einen oem sjnel de nach door te kómme en dien respawnpunt in te sjtelle.

source_string: Be careful when you swim. Stay under water for too long and you'll run out of air.
translation: Wees veurzichtig es se zwömme. Blief neet te lang oonger water of se raoke zoender loch.

source_string: Survival mode has 4 different difficulty levels - Peaceful, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Or play Creative mode and get endless resources!
translation: Survival-modus hèt 4 verschillende moeilikheidsjraode - Vreedzaam, Gemekelik, Normaal en Moeilik. Of speul Creative-modus en kreig onendige rijkdomme!

source_string: The world of Minecraft is endlessly surprising. You'll find lots of different animals, plants, and even §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r
translation: De waereld van Minecraft is onendig verrassend. Se vinje vöal versjillende diere, plante, en zelfs §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
translation: Iezere golems zulle veur dich vechte!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Geef eine bein aan eine wolf oem 'm te tame. Se kans 'm dan laote zitte of dich laote volge.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Eine pómpoen op dien kop drage haod Endermen aaf van dich aanvalle.

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Winnen laeder van koeë en gebroek 't oem waopenroestinge en boeker te make.

source_string: You can fill an empty bucket with water, lava, milk, powdered snow... and even some mobs.
translation: Se kanne eine laege emmer vulle mit water, lava, milch, poeiersneuw... en zelfs bepaolde wezes.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Voer geven aan e dier haod 't aaf van 't verdwiene. Bouw eine wei oem diene diere vaeilig te haode.

source_string: Get to your destination faster with a minecart and some rails!
translation: Kóm sjneller op dien besjtimming mit eine mienkar en get sjpore!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension called the Nether.
translation: 't Bouwe van eine portaal loat dich reize nao eine anger dimensie geheite de Nether.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Beemael (vervaardig van eine skeletbein) kan gebroekt wuure es gruundstóf en kan dinger onmiddellik laote groeie!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidiaan wuurt gemaak wanneer water eine lavabronblok raak.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Es de bronblok veur water of lava weg is, sjtopt de sjtroom volledig.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice.
translation: Blokke die es lechtbron gebroekt kanne wuure, smelte sneuw en ies.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Wees veurzichtig bie 't bouwe van sjtructure van wol in de boetenloch, want bliksem van oonweer kan wol in brand zette.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Ein enkele emmer lava kan gebroekt wuure in eine smeltowe oem 100 blokke te smelte.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: 't Instrumint gesjpeuld door eine noteblok hangt aaf van 't materiaal daaronger.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack you.
translation: 't Aanvalle van eine wolf zorgt daoveur dat gelieke welke wolve in de buurt hostiel wuure en dich aanvalle.

source_string: Wolves and iron golems won't attack creepers.
translation: Wolve en iezere golems zulle geine creepers aanvalle.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Hoonder legge ein ei alle 5 tot 10 minute.

source_string: Obsidian can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidiaan kan gedolve wuure mit eine diamante pikhouwel.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creepers zint de gemekelikste bron van bösjkroet.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Getaamde wolve tone hun gezondheid mit de positie van hun kwêrt. Geef ze vleis oem ze te haele.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Versjillende kleurde verf kanne gemaak wuure van verschillende materiale, kook cactus in eine smeltowe veur greune verf!

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become zombified piglins.
translation: Varkes die door bliksem geraak wuure, wuure zombiepiglins.

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Saoms geven iezere golems bloome aan de dörpkinger!
Ozelotte tone creepers wie de baos is!

source_string: Use seagrass to attract and breed sea turtles.
translation: Gebroek zeegraas oem zeeschelpaddig aan te trekke en te kweke.

source_string: Protect baby turtles from hostile mobs!
Baby turtles will drop scutes when they grow - these can be crafted into turtle shells.
translation: Babbie-schelpadde laote schoebe valle wanneer ze groeie - deze kanne vervaardig wuure tot schelpaddesjilde.

source_string: Brew some water breathing potions for underwater exploration!
Dolphins can lead you to shipwrecks and underwater ruins, feed them cod and follow their trail!
translation: Dolfiene kanne dich leie nao sjeepswrakke en oonderwaterroïnes, geef ze kabeljauw en volg hun spoor!

source_string: Use shears to carve a pumpkin.
translation: Gebroek eine sjeer oem eine pómpoen te sniede.

source_string: There are 3587 types of tropical fish!
Sea pickles can be smelted into lime green dye.
translation: Zeekomkommers kanne gesmolte wuure tot limoengreune verf.

source_string: Use hay bales to breed Llamas!
translation: Gebroek hooibale oem Lama's te kweke!

source_string: Compasses always point to the world spawn - craft one to find your way!
translation: Kompasse wiese altied nao de waereldsjpawn - vervaardig einen oem diene weg te vinje!

source_string: Trade with villagers to obtain food, tools, and even explorer maps!
translation: Doe zaake mit dörpelinge oem aete, gereedschap, en zelfs verkennerskaarte te kriege!

source_string: Did you know you can hold a map in your off-hand?
translation: Wisse se dat se eine kaart in dien andere hangs kans haode?

source_string: Leads can be used on boats.
translation: Leibande kanne gebroek wuure op boete.

source_string: Sneak to walk safely on magma blocks.
translation: Sluip oem vaeilig op magmablokke te loupe.

source_string: You can gather cobwebs using shears.
translation: Se kanne sjpinneweb verzammele mit eine sjeer.

source_string: Tridents are dropped by the Drowned, and can be held or thrown.
translation: Drietande wuure gelaote valle door de Verdronkene, en kanne gehaode of gegoje wuure.

source_string: You can smelt 20 items in a furnace by using a block of dried kelp as fuel.
translation: Se kanne 20 veurwerpe smelte in eine smeltowe door eine blok gedreugde zeewier es breenstóf te gebroeke.

source_string: Taming a skeleton horse doesn't require a saddle.
translation: 't Tame van eine skeletpaerd hèt geine zaal noedig.

source_string: Phantoms are dangerous mobs that appear during the night. Make sure to sleep regularly!
translation: Fantome zint gevaarlike wezes die 's nachs versjiene. Wees zeker dat se regelmaotig sjlaop!

source_string: Zombies turn into drowned if they sink underwater.
translation: Zombies wuure Verdronkene as ze oonger water zinke.
Sprint in water oem te zwömme!
Doe geine dolfiene doedmake, se monster!

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Es se recht nao boaven graves, zet eine fakkel bie diene voete oem gelieke welk zand of grieskraam te breke dat op dich zoo kanne valle.

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey.
translation: Sjeer eine bieënkorf of nes veur hónigraat, gebroek eine fles veur hónig.

source_string: Place a campfire under a beehive or nest to harvest honey.
translation: Zet eine kampvuur oonger eine bieënkorf of nes oem hónig te winne.

source_string: Emerald ores are the rarest ores in Minecraft! They can only be found in mountains and meadows.
translation: Emeraudertse zint de raarste ertse in Minecraft! Se kanne allein gevonge wuure in berge en weie.

source_string: Need diamonds? They get more common as you go deeper.
translation: Diamante noedig? Ze wuure gebrukeliker es se deiper gees.

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: Kikkere aete klein en blokkig wezes.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: De Allay lief 't oem veurwerpe te verzammele! Es se 'm eine bepaold veurwerp geefs, zal 'm probere mie daovan te verzammele.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: Kikkere kieze eine variant gebaseerd op de temperatuur van de biotoop woe de kikkervis groeit.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
translation: Se kanne kikkervisse verzammele in emmers.

source_string: Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Ouwde sjtede kanne gevonge wuure oonger bergraeg.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with noteblocks!
translation: Allays lieve musiek en interaktere daoveur mit noteblokke!

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Gebroek eine waterfles op eine ierdeblok veur slik!

source_string: When wandering in the deep dark, silence is key.
translation: Es se in de deep dark rondwangdele, is sjtilte de sleutel.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Bepaolde diere zulle dich volge es se koar in diene hangs hebbe.

source_string: Before you mine diamonds, redstone, or gold, make sure you're using an iron or diamond pickaxe or it won't work.
translation: Veurdat se diamante, redstone, of góld dels, wees zeker dat se eine iezere of diamante pikhouwel gebroeks of 't geit neet.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: 't Zette van twie kiste nevenein maak eine groete kis.

source_string: Can't find any coal for your torches? Try putting some logs in a furnace.
translation: Kanse geine kole vinje veur diene fakkels? Probeer get boomsjtamme in eine smeltowe te zette.

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Plant get zaailinge en ze zulle oetgroeie tot boum.

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Gebroek eine hark oem ruumde grond te bereie veur 't plante.

source_string: Zombified piglins won't attack you - unless you make them angry.
translation: Zombiepiglins zulle dich neet aanvalle - behauve as se ze booas make.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Sjlaog die vuurballe trök nao de Ghast!

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Kasseisjtein is resistent tege Ghast-vuurballe, wat 't handig maak veur 't bewake van portale.

source_string: Our music is by C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, and Kumi Tanioka.
translation: Oos musiek is van C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, en Kumi Tanioka.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Der kómp eirans eine update veur dit sjpel!

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
translation: Creepers zint geboare oet eine codefaot.

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: De eerste versie van Minecraft is gemaak in mer 6 daag!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: De Endermen-taal is eigelik Ingels achtersteveure.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: De originele naam veur Minecraft waor Cave Game.

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the Overworld.
translation: Ein blok reize in de Nether is gelieke aan ach blokke reize in de Overworld.

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: De Vloedgank-verbetering sjtuurt dich door de loch in de raege.

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a Nether star from the Wither!
translation: 't Baken is e krachtig veurwerp dat allein vervaardig kan wuure mit eine netherster van de Wither!

source_string: Nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions.
translation: Netherstère kanne neet vernietig wuure door explosies.

source_string: Respawning in the Nether requires a charged respawn anchor.
translation: Respawne in de Nether vereist eine gelade respawnanker.

source_string: You can charge a respawn anchor with glowstone.
translation: Se kanne eine respawnanker laje mit gloedsjtein.

source_string: You can breed hoglins with crimson fungus, but be careful.
translation: Se kanne hoglins kweke mit karmezinsjwam, mer wees veurzichtig.

source_string: Gold is most common in the Nether and in the badlands biome.
translation: Góld is 't gebrukelikste in de Nether en in de woastenieklimaotbiotoop.

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.

A Realm is always online, so you and your friends can play here whenever you want.

source_string: Keep up to date with what's going on in your Realm by checking the Story Feed in Realms Stories.
translation: Blief op de hoegde van wat der gebeurt in dien Realm door de storyfeed in Realms Stories te bekieke.

source_string: Access Realms Stories from the game menu while playing on the Realm.
translation: Toegank tot Realms Stories via 't sjpelmenu wieël se speult op 't Realm.

source_string: Get to know your Realm's community on the Members tab in Realms Stories.
translation: Lier dien Realm-gemeinsjap kenne via 't Leje-tabblad in Realms Stories.

source_string: Use Realms Stories to get social, keep up with your friends' progress, and organize playtime.
translation: Gebroek Realms Stories oem sociaal te blieve, op de hoegde te blieve van diene vrunj hun vöartgank, en sjpeultied te organisere.

source_string: Bored of gravity? Jump twice to fly!
translation: Zat van zjwoartekrach? Sprong tweemaol oem te vleie!
context: A fun way to tell players that they can fly if they press the jump button twice.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Summon mobs in an instant with spawn eggs.
translation: Roef wezes op in ein instant mit sjpawn-eier.
context: Players can use an item called Sawn Egg to summon animals and monsters.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Collect goat horns and fill the world with music.
translation: Verzammel geitehoare en vul de waereld mit musiek.
context: Goat horn is an object players can use to play loud sounds.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Combine flint and steel with a TNT block for explosive results.
translation: Combineer vuursjteen en sjtaal mit eine TNT-blok veur explosieve resultate.
context: Flint and steel is a tool used to create fire or to ignite certain blocks, structures and mobs. TNT will explode when you light it.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Try blinking around the map with an ender pearl. Don't get dizzy!
translation: Probeer rondzappe op de kaart mit eine enderpaerel. Waer neet dizzelich!
context: An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown and teleports the thrower to where it lands.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
translation: Gebroek sjpore en eine mienkar oem 't perfekte transportsysteem te bouwe. Of achbaan!
context: To  encourage players to build railroads{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Seeking a little more danger? Survival mode has plenty.
translation: Op zeuk nao get mie gevaar? Survival-modus hèt der genóg.
context: In the Game mode Survival mode you can die. In Creative you can’t.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.
translation: Kruisboge hebbe munitie noedig. Voeg get piele toe aan dien inventaris veur se op jach gees.
context: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: You can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
translation: Se kans neet dood gaon, mer dörpelinge wal. Gebroek die informatie... wies.
context: This means you can do things that will get villagers killed. Like attracting monsters to the village.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Villagers are great at building villages. Think you can do better?
translation: Dörpelinge zint jans in 't bouwe van dörper. Denks se 't bèter te kanne?
context: This is a prompt to encourage players to build things.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
translation: Wolve zulle skelette aanvalle oem op hun lekkere bein te kauwe.
context: Wolves will attack skeletons. It’s also a discrete hint that you should feel wolves with bones to tame them.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Tame wild horses by sitting on them until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside of Minecraft.)
translation: Tam wilde paerd door drop te zitte tot ze rustig zint, en zaal dan op en riej weg. (Nota: Paerd werken neet zoea boete Minecraft.)
context: It’s a bit unintuitive how you tame horses. Most other animals are tamed by feeding them. Not Horses. {MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Eat as much as you want, you'll never get full! And you'll never starve.
translation: Aet zoevöal se wils, se wuurs noeats vol! En se zul noeats verhóngere.
context: In Creative Mode you don’t get hungry. Eating the food it just for fun.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Move through solid objects using spectator mode.
translation: Beweeg door vaste veurwerpe mit toekiek-modus.
context: There is a Game mode called Spectator Mode. It allows you to fly through walls and blocks and everything.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Who needs tools? Punch your way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
translation: Wee hèt gereedschap noedig? Sjlaog dich eine weg nao 't succes en verwieder blokke onmiddellik in creative-modus.
context: Block breaking happens very fast when you’re in Creative Mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Like what you see? Use the pick block button to start building with whatever you're looking at. Yes, even mobs!
translation: Wat se zuus, bevalt dich? Gebroek de blokkeezersknóp oem te beginne bouwe mit wat gelieke se aankiek. Jao, zelfs wezes!

source_string: Get there now with the /tp command.
context: You can teleport yourself in Creative. You use the /tp command in the chat.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Mobs won't notice you in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other…
translation: Wezes valle dich neet op in creative-modus, mer ze valle eikaar wal op…
context: Mobs(animals & monsters) won’t notice you in creative mode, but they’ll still notice each other… meaning that they can still kill each other.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A warden a day keeps the… well, everything away.
translation: Ein warden per daag haod... nauw, alles weg.
context: The Warden is a scary monster that live in underground cities.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like you can drown.
translation: Woróm neet eine oonderwaterbasis bouwe? 't Is neet esof se kans verdrenke.
context: You can’t drown in creative mode. So it’s possible to build underwater without danger.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Whatever you can dream, you can build. There's no limit to your resources (in creative mode...).
translation: Wat se kans dreume, kanse bouwe. Der is geine limiet aan diene rijkdomme (in creative-modus...).
context: Players have endless resources in Creative mode. They get all the building blocks from their inventory.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Phantoms can't hurt you, but you can still shoo them off by using a bed. Just...not literally. You sleep in it.
translation: Fantome kanne dich neet ziejer make, mer se kanse ze nog altied verjage door e bèd te gebroeke. Neet lettelik. Se sjlaop erin.

source_string: You can subscribe to a Realms plan:
translation: Se kènt eu aanmelde veur 'ne Realms-plan:

source_string: Realms Core plan: %1$s per month. Add infinite members, play online with 2 other players at the same time.
translation: Realms Core-plan: %1$s per maond. Voog oneindig leje toe, speul online mit 2 ander speulers gelick.

source_string: Realms Plus plan: %1$s per month. Add infinite members, play online with 10 other players at the same time. Plus, enjoy over 150 pieces of Marketplace content from the Marketplace Pass catalog for free.
translation: Realms Plus-plan: %1$s per maond. Voog oneindig leje toe, speul online mit 10 ander speulers gelick. Boavendrop geneet se vaan mie es 150 sjtökker Marketplace-inhold oet de Marketplace Pass-catalogus, gratis.

source_string: How much does a Realm cost?

Your worlds are yours to keep. You have 18 months to download them to your device after your subscription expires. If you resubscribe within that time, you will regain access to your Realm just as you left it.
translation: Eur waerelde blieve vaan eu. Se han 18 maonde um ze te downloade nao eur apparaat nao det eur abonnement is verlaupe. As se eu binne dees tied obbenuits aanmeldt, kriegt se weer toegang tot eur Realm precies zoas se 't han verlaote.

source_string: What happens to the worlds on my Realm when my subscription expires?
translation: Wat gebeurt mit de waerelde op mien Realm wen mien abonnement verlaup?

source_string: The people you invite (members) don’t need to purchase a Realms subscription to play on your Realm. You can invite any Minecraft player to join and play in your Realm for free.
translation: De luuj die se oetnoodig (leje) han gein Realms-abonnement noedig um op eur Realm te speule. Se kènt eeder Minecraft-speuler oetnoodige um bie te kome en gratis in eur Realm te speule.

source_string: Do my friends need to purchase a Realms subscription to play on my Realm?
translation: Han mien vrunde 'n Realms-abonnement noedig um op mien Realm te speule?

source_string: You can store up to 3 worlds on your Realm at one time. Activate any one of them to make that world playable. Only one world is playable at a time.
translation: Se kènt tot 3 waerelde opsloa op eur Realm gelick. Activeer eeder daovaan um deze waereld speulbaar te make. Allein ein waereld is gelick speulbaar.

source_string: How many worlds can I have on my Realm?
translation: Wie vaeke waerelde kèn ich han op mien Realm?

source_string: We put your world on a super-computer, with a huge amount of speed and power. We keep the computer running all the time so you can play that world whenever you and your friends want. We protect your world from getting corrupted by saving it automatically all the time. You control who connects to the world. How you play with it is up to you (the server will do all the heavy lifting).
translation: Weer zetje eur waereld op 'ne supercomputer, mit 'n enorme hoeveelheid snelheid en kraf. Weer haote de computer aaltied aan zoedet se dees waereld kènt speule wanneer se en eur vrunde det wilt. Weer besjörme eur waereld tege corruptie door 't aaltied automatisch op te sloa. Se behier wae verbind mit de waereld. Hoe se 't speult is aan eu\u00A0(de server dut al 't zware wèrk).

source_string: Realms are small personal servers to host your Minecraft world. Unlike a regular multiplayer session, Realms are always online, so you don’t have to be there for your friends to play. Unlike a large public Minecraft server, Realms are by invite only, so you control who gets in.
translation: Realms zint klein persoonlike servers um eur Minecraft-waereld te hoste. Aanders es 'n gewoene multiplayersessie, zint Realms aaltied online, zoedet se der neet moot zin veur eur vrunde te speule. Aanders es 'ne gruus openbare Minecraft-server, zint Realms allein op invitasie, zoedet se behier wae bie kèt kome.

source_string: Get additional content with Realms Plus
translation: Kriegt extra inhold mit Realms Plus

source_string: Realms Plus subscriptions include Marketplace Pass: free Marketplace content, updated monthly. With skins, Character Creator items, worlds, and more, there's always something new for you to try.
translation: Realms Plus-abonnemente bevatte Marketplace Pass: gratis Marketplace-inhold, maandelijks geüpdate. Mit skins, Character Creator-voorwerpe, waerelde, en mie, is 'r aaltied get nuits um te probere.

source_string: Realms Plus comes with Marketplace Pass

source_string: Share your adventures on the Story Feed, watch your Realm grow with the Members tab, know when people have been playing on the Realm with the Timeline.
translation: Deil eur avonture op de Sjtoriefeed, kiek eur Realm groeie mit de Ledetab, wèt wen luuj gespeuld han op de Realm mit de\u00A0Timeline.

source_string: No need for technical know-how. Free, no-hassle backups. No sharing personal information.
translation: Gein technische kennis noedig. Gratis, moeitelöze reservekopieë. Gein deile vaan persoonlike infermasie.

source_string: People you invite become Realm members. They don’t need to pay to join and play on the Realm; they just need a copy of Minecraft: Bedrock Edition.
translation: Luuj die se oetnoodig were Realm-leje. Ze moote neet betale um bie te kome en te speule op de Realm; ze han allein 'n kopie vaan Minecraft: Bedrock\u00A0Edition noedig.

source_string: Worlds uploaded to your Realm are always available to you and your invited Realm members – at any time, on any device. Members can play even when you’re away.
translation: Waerelde geüploadet nao eur Realm zint aaltied besjikbaar veur eu en eur oetgenoodigde Realm-leje\u00A0– wanneer se wilt, op eeder apparaat. Leje kènt speule och wen se weg zint.

source_string: Run your own Minecraft server! You set the rules: who can join and how to play. Members play for free, even when you’re offline. Easy to set up, manage, and access from any device.
translation: Draaf eur eige Minecraft-server! Se stelt de regele op: wae kèt bie kome en hoe se speult. Leje speule gratis, och wen se offline zint. Gemakkelik in te stelle, te behiere, en te gebroeke vaanaaf eeder apparaat.

source_string: Global context for both crosshair and tool modes

source_string: Great! You now know the basics of Minecraft Editor—enjoy creating your first Editor experience![*newLine]Use Test World to playtest anytime, then Export or upload to Realms to share with friends.[*newLine]For more, visit [*link|%1$s]Minecraft Editor Documentation[*link] or press the Info button on tooltips for details on specific tools.
translation: Prima! Se wees now de basis van Minecraft Editor—genoot van dien eerste Editor-ervaring![*newLine]Gebroek Test Welt um op eder momint te teste, en Exporteer of laad nao Realms um mit vreng te deele.[*newLine]Veur mier, bezuk [*link|%1$s]Minecraft Editor-documentatie[*link] of druk op de Info-knop op tooltips veur details óaver specifieke werktoeg.

source_string: The hotbar sets the block for Fill operations, brushes, and more.[*newLine]Switch slots with 1-9 keys or the mouse.[*newLine]To change the block, reselect the active slot.
translation: De hotbar bepaolt 't blok veur Fill-bewerkinge, penseels en mier.[*newLine]Wisel vak mit toetse 1-9 of de moes.[*newLine]Um 't blok te veranderen, selecteer 't actieve vak opnuuj.

source_string: Movement[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Right Click to move the camera around the world.[*%s]Use %s, %s, %s, and %s to move forward, backward, left and right.[*%s]Use %s and %s to move up and down.[*%s]Use Middle Mouse scroll to zoom.[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Middle Mouse Button to pan the camera.
translation: Beweging[*%s]Gebroek de moes terwiel se Rechts Klikke ingedruk hats um de camera róndj de welt te beweege.[*%s]Gebroek %s, %s, %s en %s um veuruit, achteruit, links en rechts te beweege.[*%s]Gebroek %s en %s um op en neer te beweege.[*%s]Gebroek de middelste moesknop-scroll um in te zoome.[*%s]Gebroek de moes terwiel se de middelste moesknop ingedruk hats um de camera te panne.

source_string: Movement[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Right Click to move the camera around the world.[*%s]Use %s, %s, %s, and %s to move forward, backward, left and right.[*%s]Use %s and %s to move up and down.
translation: Beweging[*%s]Gebroek de moes terwiel se Rechts Klikke ingedruk hats um de camera róndj de welt te beweege.[*%s]Gebroek %s, %s, %s en %s um veuruit, achteruit, links en rechts te beweege.[*%s]Gebroek %s en %s um op en neer te beweege.

source_string: Let’s explore the Selection tool.[*newLine]Activate the Selection tool by clicking %1$s on the toolrail or pressing %2$s.
translation: Laot os de Selectietoeg bekieke.[*newLine]Activeer de Selectietoeg door op %1$s te klikke op de toolrail of door op %2$s te drukke.

source_string: Left-click to set the selection start, then drag to adjust its size.
translation: Links klikke um de selectiestart te zette, dan sjuve um de groette aan te passe.

source_string: Click the Fill button on the Action Bar or press %s to fill the selection with blocks.
translation: Klik op de Fill-knop op de Actiebalk of druk op %s um de selectie te vulle mit blökke.

source_string: The Selection tool lets you move, copy, and build with precision.
translation: De Selectietoeg lat dich beweege, kopiëere en bouwe mit precisie.

source_string: Welcome to Minecraft Editor, a powerful tool for creating stunning Bedrock worlds with ease.[*newLine]Things work differently in Editor and it's important that you understand a few basics first or you might get lost.[*newLine]Let's dive into the basics.
translation: Welkom bij Minecraft Editor, ein krachtig werktoeg um verstommende Bedrock-wèlte gemakkelik te make.[*newLine]De zake werke angersj in de Editor en 't is belangriek detste eerst get basis begripts, angersj kèns se de wèg verleze.[*newLine]Laot os in de basis dieke.
Probeer 't oet um door te gaon...

source_string: Set the font size for text in the Editor.
translation: Zèt de lettertypegroette veur tekst in de Editor.

source_string: Set the theme for the UI in Editor.
translation: Zèt 't thema veur de UI in de Editor.

source_string: Set the size of the UI elements.
translation: Zèt de groette van de UI-elemente.

source_string: We are so excited you're here and about to build with Minecraft's Bedrock Editor, where we want to empower Creators of all skillsets to easily create high-quality experiences.
translation: Weer zeen zoe blie detste hei bis en gank bouwe mit Minecraft's Bedrock Editor, woe weer makers van alle vaardigheidsniveaus wille versjterke um makkelik hoegwaardige ervaringe te creëere.

source_string: - There are two modes within the Editor: Tool or Crosshair. Tool is focused on using the multi-block editing tools as available via the UI and free-moving cursor, and Crosshair is for more precise, single-block edits using a crosshair in 1st person.
translation: - Der zeen twie modi binne de Editor: Werktoeg of Draodkruis. Werktoeg is gerich op 't gebroeke van de multi-blokbewerkingswerktoeg zoewie beschikbaar via de UI en vrij bewegende cursor, en Draodkruis is veur mier precise, éinbloksbewerkinge mit ein draodkruis in 1e persoen.

source_string: - UI orientation: The left array of tools is referred to as the "toolrail", the top array is the "action bar" (eg. undo/redo), and the very top is the "menu" (eg. File).
translation: - UI-oriëntatie: De linkse riej werktoeg wordt de "toolrail" genoemp, de boavenste riej is de "actiebalk" (bv. ongedaon make/opnuuj), en 't hielste boave is 't "menu" (bv. Bestand).

source_string: - For most UI actions and tools, there is a corresponding hotkey and sometimes a slash cmd.
translation: - Veur de mieste UI-acties en werktoeg is der ein bijhorende sneltoets en soms ein slash-cmd.

source_string: - Rotate camera / unlock movement: In Tool, hold down right mouse button. In Crosshair, you do not need to hold down the right mouse button.
translation: - Camera draoje / beweging ontgrendele: In Werktoeg, hald de rechte moesknop ingedruk. In Draodkruis moots se de rechte moesknop neet ingedruk hilde.

source_string: - Move on the XZ axis: WASD
- Move on the Y axis: E (up), Q (down)
translation: - Beweeg op de Y-as: E (omhoeg), Q (omleeg)

source_string: - Toggle between Tool and Crosshair Modes: (CTRL+TAB) or the UI button at the bottom of the viewport. When in Crosshair, you will need to use the hotkeys, though -- (CTRL+TAB) or ESC.
translation: - Sjakel tösje Werktoeg- en Draodkruismodus: (CTRL+TAB) of de UI-knop ónjeraan de viewport. In Draodkruis moots se echter de sneltoetse gebroeke -- (CTRL+TAB) of ESC.

source_string: View the detailed directory of controls:
translation: Bekiek de detailleerde directory van besjtiering:

source_string: Actions are shortcuts that live at the top of your screen. Hit the “+” button in the Action Bar to customize which are displayed.
translation: Acties zeen sneltoetse die boave op dien sjerm blieve. Druk op de "+"-knop in de Actiebalk um aan te passe wat wordt getuund.

source_string: At the top center of your screen is the Hotbar. Click once to change the active block, click twice to open the Block Picker to customize the Hotbar.
translation: Boaveaan in 't midde van dien sjerm steet de Hotbar. Klik einkeer um 't actieve blok te veranderen, klik twiekeer um de Blokkiezer te ope um de Hotbar aan te passe.

source_string: You can create a new Hotbar by clicking the Hotbar Menu button to the right.
translation: Se kèns ein nuuje Hotbar creëere door op de Hotbarmenu-knop rechts te klikke.

source_string: To navigate in the Editor, you’ll need a keyboard and mouse. Trackpads or controllers aren’t recommended.
translation: Um in de Editor te navigere, häs se ein toetsebord en moes neudig. Trackpads of controllers zeen neet aangeraoje.
Um róndj te beweege in de Editor:

source_string: Hold down the right mouse button to look around.
translation: Hald de rechte moesknop ingedruk um róndj te kieke.

source_string: Use WASD to move horizontally and Q & E to move vertically.
translation: Gebroek WASD um horizontaal te beweege en Q en E um verticaal te beweege.

source_string: You can find tools on the left rail. Each tool allows you to edit your world in different ways.
translation: Se vinjs werktoeg op de linkse riej. Elke werktoeg lat dich dien welt op verschillende maniere bewerke.

source_string: Click on the Information button ("i") at the top right corner of each tool to learn more about how it works.
translation: Klik op de Info-knop ("i") rechtsboave van edere werktoeg um mier te wisse óaver hoe 't werk.

source_string: Welcome to the Minecraft Editor, a tool designed to help you create stunning worlds in Bedrock with ease.
translation: Welkom bij de Minecraft Editor, ein werktoeg gemaak um dich te helpe verstommende wèlte in Bedrock te creëere mit gemak.

source_string: You may find these links helpful on your journey:

source_string: Anyone with the link can join your Realm. Go to Game > Download World to download a backup of your world.

source_string: Want added security for your coins and packs? Sign in to Xbox Live to save your Minecoins, Skins, Texture Packs, Worlds, and Mash-ups. They will be there for you on any device where you play Minecraft.
translation: Wils se extra beveiliging veur dien coins en packs? Meld dich aan bij Xbox Live um dien Minecoins, skins, texturepacks, wèlte en mash-ups op te sjlaan. Ze zeen dan altied bij dich, op eder apparaat woe se Minecraft sjpels.

source_string: Purchases left on your device may be lost if you lose your device or uninstall Minecraft.
translation: Aankeupe die allein op dien apparaat blieve kónne verlore gaon wenn se diene apparaat verlees of Minecraft deïnstalleers.

source_string: Transferring purchases to Xbox Live account...

source_string: In addition, you will be able to access them on any device you use to play Minecraft!

source_string: Content purchased through a partner store will be available as long as your device is signed in to your partner store account.

source_string: This Xbox Live account will not be the primary account for this device if you do not transfer this device's purchases to this account. You will not automatically sign in when you start Minecraft.

source_string: You can also wear a Pumpkin on your head. This won't give you any :armor: but will make it so Endermen won't get mad when you look at them.

source_string: Minecraft is a game about placing blocks to build anything you can imagine. At night monsters come out, so make sure to build a shelter before that happens.
translation: Minecraft is e spel woe se blökke plaats um alles te bouwe wat se dich kèns verbeelde. In de naach kómme monsters, dus zörg detste ein sjoelter bouts veurdet dit gebeurt.

source_string: Use the mouse to look around.
translation: Gebroek de moes um róndj te kieke.

source_string: Touch and drag along the screen to look around.
translation: Raak 't sjerm aan en sjuuf um róndj te kieke.

source_string: Press :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession or press :_input_key.sprint: to sprint. While you hold :_input_key.forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Druk twiekeer sjnel op :_input_key.forward: of druk op :_input_key.sprint: um te sjprinte. Zolang se :_input_key.forward: ingedruk hats, blijfste sjprinte totdet se minder häs es :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :_gamepad_stick_left: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Doew :_gamepad_stick_left: twiekeer sjnel veuruit um te sjprinte. Zolang se :_gamepad_stick_left: veuruit hilds, blijfste sjprinte totdet se minder häs es :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Press :touch_forward: twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :touch_forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Druk twiekeer sjnel op :touch_forward: um te sjprinte. Zolang se :touch_forward: ingedruk hats, blijfste sjprinte totdet se minder häs es :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Push :rift_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :rift_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Doew :rift_left_stick: twiekeer sjnel veuruit um te sjprinte. Zolang se :rift_left_stick: veuruit hilds, blijfste sjprinte totdet se minder häs es :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Push :windowsmr_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :windowsmr_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Doew :windowsmr_left_stick: twiekeer sjnel veuruit um te sjprinte. Zolang se :windowsmr_left_stick: veuruit hilds, blijfste sjprinte totdet se minder häs es :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Hold :_input_key.attack: to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Hald :_input_key.attack: ingedruk um te delve en te houwe mit dien hand of wat se ouk vasthäs. Se moots mäögelik ein werktoeg vervaardige um bepaolde blökke te delve.

source_string: Touch and hold the screen on a block to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Raak en hald 't sjerm aan op ein blok um te delve en te houwe mit dien hand of wat se ouk vasthäs. Se moots mäögelik ein werktoeg vervaardige um bepaolde blökke te delve.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.
translation: Wenn se e veurwerp in dien hand hilds, gebroek :_input_key.use: um 't te gebroeke of druk op :_input_key.drop: um 't te laote valle.

source_string: If you are holding an item in your hand, use :_input_key.use: to use that item or press :_input_key.drop: to drop it.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To sneak, hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Bukke is ongelöovelik nuttig in Minecraft, bukke hilt dich vanaaf te valle van e blok en verbörg dien naamkaartje. Um te bukke, drök en hald :_input_key.sneak:.
