translation: Sjprinte terwiel se in 't water bis maak detste zwems. Raak en sjuuf óaver 't sjerm um de richting te bepaole woe se zwems.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :rift_right_stick: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sjprinte terwiel se in 't water bis maak detste zwems. Gebroek :rift_right_stick: um de richting te bepaole woe se zwems.

source_string: Sprinting while in water will make you swim. Use the :windowsmr_right_stick: to control the direction that you are swimming.
translation: Sjprinte terwiel se in 't water bis maak detste zwems. Gebroek :windowsmr_right_stick: um de richting te bepaole woe se zwems.

source_string: Press :_input_key.inventory: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk op :_input_key.inventory: um toegank te krieje tot 't Recepteboek en de vervaardigingsroester.

source_string: Press :_input_container.crafting: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk op :_input_container.crafting: um toegank te krieje tot 't Recepteboek en de vervaardigingsroester.

source_string: Tap the Inventory Button to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Tik op de inventarisknop um toegank te krieje tot 't Recepteboek en de vervaardigingsroester.

source_string: Press :rift_B: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk op :rift_B: um toegank te krieje tot 't Recepteboek en de vervaardigingsroester.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_grab: to access the Recipe Book and Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk op :windowsmr_left_grab: um toegank te krieje tot 't Recepteboek en de vervaardigingsroester.

source_string: Arrange items from your Inventory or Hotbar in the crafting grid in the shape of an item recipe.
translation: Rangaer veurwerpe oet dien inventaris of hotbar in de vervaardigingsroester in de vorm van e veurwerprecept.

source_string: If the recipe is correct the item you are attempting to craft will appear in the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid. Take it from the Output Slot and put it in your Inventory. You can now use the item.
translation: Wenn 't recept kórrek is, veurschient 't veurwerp dets probeers te vervaardige in 't oetvoervak rechts van de vervaardigingsroester. Neem 't oet 't oetvoervak en zèt 't in diene inventaris. Se kèns 't veurwerp now gebroeke.

source_string: There are many recipes and for some you will need a larger Crafting Grid than the 2x2 grid that you start with.
translation: Der zeen väöl recepte en veur get moots se ein groetere vervaardigingsroester häbbe es de 2x2-roester woe se mit begins.

source_string: Craft 4 Wooden Planks into a Crafting Table and place it in the world.
translation: Vervaardig 4 hoote planke tot ein werkbank en plaats deze in de welt.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk op :_input_key.use: op ein werkbank in de welt um toegank te krieje tot ein 3x3-vervaardigingsroester.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk op :_input_key.use: op ein werkbank in de welt um toegank te krieje tot ein 3x3-vervaardigingsroester.

source_string: Press :rift_right_grab: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk op :rift_right_grab: op ein werkbank in de welt um toegank te krieje tot ein 3x3-vervaardigingsroester.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_trigger: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Druk op :windowsmr_left_trigger: op ein werkbank in de welt um toegank te krieje tot ein 3x3-vervaardigingsroester.

source_string: Tap on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Tik op ein werkbank in de welt um toegank te krieje tot ein 3x3-vervaardigingsroester.

source_string: On the left side of the screen you will see the Recipe Book, which is good if you don't know a recipe or want to quickly craft a recipe that you already know. You will also see the Crafting grid on the right side of the screen above your Inventory.
translation: Aan de linkse kant van 't sjerm zuus se 't Recepteboek, wat handig is wenn se ein recept neet kins of e recept dets al kins sjnel wils vervaardige. Se zuus ouk de vervaardigingsroester aan de rechte kant van 't sjerm, boaven diene inventaris.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, :_input_key.attack: the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then take it from the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid and put it in your Inventory. :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: Wenn se 't recept gevónje häs dets wils vervaardige, druk :_input_key.attack: op 't recept um 't in de vervaardigingsroester te laje, en neem 't dan oet 't oetvoervak rechts van de vervaardigingsroester en zèt 't in diene inventaris. :_input_key.use: 't recept um automatisch te vervaardige, wat automatisch ein set vervaardigt en in diene inventaris zèt. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: 't recept um ein hiel stapel automatisch te vervaardige.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, press :_gamepad_face_button_down: on the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. Press :_gamepad_face_button_up: on the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: Wenn se 't recept gevónje häs dets wils vervaardige, druk :_gamepad_face_button_down: op 't recept um automatisch te vervaardige, wat automatisch ein set vervaardigt en in diene inventaris zèt. Druk :_gamepad_face_button_up: op 't recept um ein hiel stapel automatisch te vervaardige.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, tap the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then tap the item in the output slot to craft it. Press and hold the item in the output slot to craft continuously.
translation: Wenn se 't recept gevónje häs dets wils vervaardige, tik op 't recept um 't in de vervaardigingsroester te laje, en tik dan op 't veurwerp in 't oetvoervak um 't te vervaardige. Hald 't veurwerp in 't oetvoervak ingedruk um continu te vervaardige.

source_string: When the :craftable_toggle_on: is on, the Recipe Book shows all of the recipes that you have ingredients for. When the :craftable_toggle_off: is off, the Recipe Book shows every recipe in the game, even if you can't craft it. Check the tabs or search if you are looking for something specific. In Creative Mode some recipes will be collapsed inside lists. Opening the list will expand it and show you all of the recipes inside.
translation: Wenn :craftable_toggle_on: aan is, toont 't Recepteboek alle recepte woe se de ingrediënte veur häs. Wenn :craftable_toggle_off: oet is, toont 't Recepteboek eder recept in 't spel, ouk wenn se 't neet kèns vervaardige. Kontroleer de tabblaggre of zeuk wenn se get specifieks zeuks. In Creative-modus zeen get recepte ingekloke binne lieste. 't Ope van de lies klap 't oet en toont alle recepte doabinne.

source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, Tap :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, tap :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession while flying. When in flying mode, you can press :touch_fly_up: to move up and :touch_fly_down: to move down.
translation: Um te vlege in Creative-modus, tik twiekeer sjnel op :_input_key.jump:. Um oet te vlege, herhaal de actie. Um sjnelder te vlege, tik twiekeer sjnel op :_input_key.forward: terwiel se vlegs. Wenn se in vliegmodus bis, kèns se drukke op :touch_fly_up: um omhoeg te gaon en :touch_fly_down: um omleeg te gaon.

source_string: How to Play : Eye Of Ender
translation: Wie te sjpele: Eye of Ender

source_string: - Old worlds limited in size and height.
translation: - Oude wèlte häbbe ein beperkte groette en hogte.

source_string: -Mob Loot: Controls whether mobs will drop loot when they die.
translation: -Wezesboete: Bepaolt of wezes boete laote valle wenn ze doadgaon.

source_string: -Mob Griefing: Prevents mobs from destroying the world.
translation: -Wezessjaad aan omgeving: Zörg detet wezes de welt neet mier kónne vernijele.

source_string: -Tile Drops: When this setting is turned on, blocks will drop themselves when they break.
translation: -Blokoetvalle: Wenn deze insjtelling aan steet, laote blökke zich zelf valle wenn ze breke.

source_string: -Entities Drop Loot: Controls whether things like minecarts and armor stands will drop themselves when they are broken.
translation: -Wezesoetvalle: Bepaolt of zake wie mijnkarre en waopenroestingstanders zich zelf laote valle wenn ze werde gebroke.

source_string: -Weather Cycle: The weather will not change when this setting is turned off.
translation: -Weercyclus: 't Weer verangert neet wenn deze insjtelling oetgeschakeld is.

source_string: How to Play : Host and Player Options
translation: Wie te sjpele: Hostersj- en sjpelersopties

source_string: The HUD shows information about your status, your health, your remaining oxygen (when you are underwater), your hunger level, and your armor (if you are wearing any).
translation: De HUD toont info óaver diene status, dien gezondheid, dien oaverblievende zuurstof (wenn se ónjer water bis), dien hongerniveau en dien waopenroesting (es se get draags).

source_string: If you lose some health but have at least nine :shank:, your health will replenish. Eating food will replenish your :shank:.
translation: Wenn se get gezondheid verlees mer nog wenigstens negen :shank: häs, groeit dien gezondheid trök aan. Eite van voedsel völd weer aan dien :shank:.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Hald :_input_key.use: ingedruk terwiel se e stökske voedsel vasthäs um 't te eite.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Hald :_input_key.use: ingedruk terwiel se e stökske voedsel vasthäs um 't te eite.

source_string: Press and hold :rift_right_grab: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Hald :rift_right_grab: ingedruk terwiel se e stökske voedsel vasthäs um 't te eite.

source_string: Press and hold :windowsmr_left_trigger: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Hald :windowsmr_left_trigger: ingedruk terwiel se e stökske voedsel vasthäs um 't te eite.

source_string: Press and hold a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Hald e stökske voedsel ingedruk um 't te eite.

source_string: You must watch your hunger level while adventuring, your hunger level is represented on your HUD with :shank:. The hunger level decreases as you explore. Certain activities will decrease hunger level at a faster rate, such as sprinting. You can replenish your hunger level by eating food. Some foods are more nourishing than others and will fill up more :shank:. When you get your hunger level up to maximum, the last food you ate applies a saturation value. Saturation is a hidden number that gives you an extra bonus to your hunger level.
translation: Se moots op dien hongerniveau lette terwiel se avontuurts, dien hongerniveau is aangegaeve op dien HUD mit :shank:. 't Hongerniveau daalt terwiel se verkens. Get activiteite verlaage 't hongerniveau sjnelder, wie sjprinte. Se kèns dien hongerniveau aanvölle door voedsel te eite. Get voedsel is voedzamer es angere en völt mier :shank: aan. Wenn dien hongerniveau maximaal is, past 't loatste voedsel wat se häs gegaete e saturatiewaarde toe. Saturatie is e verbórge cijfer wat dich e extra bonus geef op dien hongerniveau.

source_string: The Experience Bar is also shown on the HUD. The number shows your current Experience Level, and the bar indicates how many Experience Points are required to increase your Experience Level.
translation: De ervaringsbalk weurt ouk getuund op de HUD. 't Cijfer toont diene huijige ervaringsniveau, en de balk geef aan hoevöl ervaringspunte se neudig häs um diene ervaringsniveau te verhoge.

source_string: Experience Points are gained by collecting Experience Orbs. You can get Experience Orbs from activities such as killing mobs, mining certain blocks, and more! Don't leave any Experience Orbs behind, you're going to need them. Move near Experience Orbs to collect them.
translation: Ervaringspunte kriegste door ervaringsbolle te verzamele. Se kèns ervaringsbolle krieje vanaaf activiteite wie wezes dooddoen, bepaolde blökke delve, en mier! Laot geine ervaringsbolle liege blieve, se häs ze neudig. Beweeg nao ervaringsbolle um ze te verzamele.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Scroll the mouse wheel to change the item in your hand.
translation: De hotbar toont de veurwerpe die beschikbaar zeen um te gebroeke. Sjuuf 't moeswiel um 't veurwerp in dien hand te veranderen.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to change the item in your hand.
translation: De hotbar toont de veurwerpe die beschikbaar zeen um te gebroeke. Gebroek :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: en :_input_key.cycleItemRight: um 't veurwerp in dien hand te veranderen.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Tap items in your hotbar to change the item in your hand.
translation: De hotbar toont de veurwerpe die beschikbaar zeen um te gebroeke. Tik op veurwerpe in dien hotbar um 't veurwerp in dien hand te veranderen.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to change the item in your hand.
translation: De hotbar toont de veurwerpe die beschikbaar zeen um te gebroeke. Druk op :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: um 't veurwerp in dien hand te veranderen.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :rift_left_trigger: or :rift_left_grab: to change the item in your hand.
translation: De hotbar toont de veurwerpe die beschikbaar zeen um te gebroeke. Druk op :rift_left_trigger: of :rift_left_grab: um 't veurwerp in dien hand te veranderen.
Druk op :_input_key.inventory: um diene inventaris te bekieke.
Druk op :_input_key.inventory: um diene inventaris te bekieke.
Druk op :rift_B: um diene inventaris te bekieke.
Druk op :windowsmr_left_grab: um diene inventaris te bekieke.

source_string: This screen shows the items that are available for use in your hand, and all of the other items that you are carrying. Your armor is also shown here.
translation: Dit sjerm toont de veurwerpe die beschikbaar zeen um in dien hand te gebroeke, en alle angere veurwerpe die se bij dich draags. Diene waopenroesting weurt ouk hei getuund.

source_string: Use :mouse_left_button: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :mouse_right_button: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Gebroek :mouse_left_button: um 't veurwerp ónjer de cursor op te pakke. Wenn der mier es ein veurwerp is, pak se ze allemaol op, of se kèns :mouse_right_button: gebroeke um allein de helf op te pakke.

source_string: Use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :_gamepad_face_button_left: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Gebroek :_gamepad_face_button_down: um 't veurwerp ónjer de cursor op te pakke. Wenn der mier es ein veurwerp is, pak se ze allemaol op, of se kèns :_gamepad_face_button_left: gebroeke um allein de helf op te pakke.

source_string: Tap to select an item. If there is more than one item here this will select them all.
translation: Tik um e veurwerp te selectere. Wenn der mier es ein veurwerp is, selecteert dit ze allemaol.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :mouse_left_button:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :mouse_left_button: to place them all or :mouse_right_button: to place just one.
translation: Se kèns veurwerpe trök neerzette door :mouse_left_button: te gebroeke. Mit mierdere veurwerpe op de cursor, gebroek :mouse_left_button: um ze allemaol te plaatse of :mouse_right_button: um allein ein te plaatse.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :_gamepad_face_button_down:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to place them all or :_gamepad_face_button_left: to place just one.
translation: Se kèns veurwerpe trök neerzette door :_gamepad_face_button_down: te gebroeke. Mit mierdere veurwerpe op de cursor, gebroek :_gamepad_face_button_down: um ze allemaol te plaatse of :_gamepad_face_button_left: um allein ein te plaatse.

source_string: Tap another place in the inventory to move the item.
translation: Tik e angere plaats in de inventaris um 't veurwerp te verplaatse.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing SHIFT+:mouse_left_button:.
translation: Wenn 't veurwerp ónjer de cursor waopenroesting is, kèns se 't sjnel nao 't kórrekte waopenroestingvak verplaatse door te drukke op SHIFT+:mouse_left_button:.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: Wenn 't veurwerp ónjer de cursor waopenroesting is, kèns se 't sjnel nao 't kórrekte waopenroestingvak verplaatse door te drukke op :_gamepad_face_button_up:.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and put it down outside of the inventory window.
translation: Um e veurwerp te laote valle, pak 't veurwerp op en zèt 't neer boete 't inventarisvinster.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and press :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: Um e veurwerp te laote valle, pak 't veurwerp op en druk op :_gamepad_face_button_up:.

source_string: To drop an item, tap the item and then tap outside of the inventory window.
translation: Um e veurwerp te laote valle, tik 't veurwerp aan en tik dan boete 't inventarisvinster.
Tik op :_input_key.sneak: um aaf te stappe.

source_string: Minecraft is a multiplayer game by default.
You can have local players join your game by connecting controllers and pressing any button on their controller at any point during the game.
translation: Se kèns lokale sjpelers laote deilnaeme aan dien spel door controllers aan te sloete en op eder momint tiedens 't spel eder knop op hun controller te drukke.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: Standerd sjtarte alle wèlte mit multiplayer ingesjakeld. Wils se de welt privaat make, gank nao de weldinsjtellinge en selecteer de multiplayeroptie, en sjakel multiplayer dan oet.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: Standerd sjtarte alle wèlte mit multiplayer ingesjakeld. Wils se de welt privaat make, gank nao de weldinsjtellinge en selecteer de multiplayeroptie, en sjakel multiplayer dan oet.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: Um e multiplayerspel te betraeje, gank nao 't vrengtabblad. Alle bereikbare Realms, vreng en LAN-spele werde hei getuund. Kees e spel en selecteer 't um te betraeje.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: Um e multiplayerspel te betraeje, gank nao 't vrengtabblad. Alle bereikbare Realms, vreng en LAN-spele werde hei getuund. Kees e spel en selecteer 't um te betraeje.

source_string: When you start or join an online game, it will be visible to people in your friends tab. Once your friends join, the game will now be visible to friends of these friends.
translation: Wenn se e online spel sjtarts of betraeds, is 't zichtbaar veur mensen in dien vrengtabblad. Zoegauw dien vreng betraeje, weurt 't spel ouk zichtbaar veur vreng van deze vreng.

source_string: Note: You must have an internet connection and be signed into Xbox Live to play multiplayer.
translation: Opmerking: se moots ein internetverbinding häbbe en aangemeld zeen bij Xbox Live um multiplayer te sjpele.

source_string: If you would like to manage the permissions of individual players, player permissions makes it easy. Open the pause menu and on the right, you will see a list of players currently in the world. Select their permission icon to adjust that player's permissions.
translation: Wils se de permissies van individuele sjpelers behere, maake sjpelerspermissies dit makkelik. Ope 't pauzemenu en aan de rechte kant zuus se ein lies van sjpelers die momenteel in de welt zeen. Selecteer hun permissie-icoon um de permissies van deze sjpeler aan te passe.

source_string: Realms is an awesome place to host a multiplayer game that is always running. Even when you aren't playing, your Realm will be up and running for your friends to explore!
translation: Realms is e geweldige plaats um e multiplayerspel te hoste dat altied loupt. Ouk wenn se neet sjpels, blijf diene Realm loupende veur dien vreng um te verkenne!

source_string: To set up a Realm, select Create New from the Worlds tab. Then select the New Realm button, then the Create New World button. Here you can name your Realm, and set the number of players. Then you will be able to add friends to your Realm.
translation: Um e Realm op te zette, selecteer Nuuj creëere vanaaf 't Wèlte-tabblad. Selecteer dan de Nuuj Realm-knop, en dan de Creëer nuuje welt-knop. Hei kèns se diene Realm ein naam geve en 't aantal sjpelers instèlle. Dan kèns se vreng toevoege aan diene Realm.

source_string: Once you have a Realm created, select the Pencil button to change the Realm settings.
translation: Zoegauw se ein Realm creëerd häs, selecteer de potloodknop um de Realm-insjtellinge te veranderen.

source_string: Under the Game button, you can rename the Realm, set the difficulty and gamemode, turn on cheats, and download/upload the world.
translation: Ónjer de Spel-knop kèns se de Realm hernoeme, de moeilikheidsgraad en spelmodus instèlle, cheats aansjtelle en de welt downloade/oplaje.

source_string: Under the Members button you can manage all of the friends you've invited to your Realm, add/remove members, and set their permissions.
translation: Ónjer de Ledje-knop kèns se alle vreng behere die se genoedig häs veur diene Realm, ledje toevoege/verwiedere en hun permissies instèlle.

source_string: Under the Subscription button you can see when the Realm will expire, extend the time until expiration, and open/close the Realm.
translation: Ónjer de Abonnement-knop kèns se zeen wenn de Realm verlöoft, de tied verlenge tot 't verloupt, en de Realm ope/sloete.

source_string: How to Play : Resource And Behavior Packs
translation: Wie te sjpele: Resource- en behaviorpacks

source_string: You can change the way that Minecraft looks and behaves using Resource and Behavior Packs.
translation: Se kèns de wies veranderen woe Minecraft oetzuut en zich gedreig mit resource- en behaviorpacks.

source_string: In the Settings Menu, choose a pack from the available packs list and select the plus sign next to it. Now your pack will apply its changes to the default Minecraft pack.
translation: In 't insjtellingsmenu, kees e pack oet de lies van beschikbare packs en selecteer 't plusteike ernoevens. Now past diene pack zien veranderinge toe op 't standerdpack van Minecraft.

source_string: The Server Tab will show popular Minecraft servers.
The Minecraft Marketplace is a place to find new skins, worlds, textures, and mash-up packs by various talented creators.
translation: De Minecraft Marketplace is ein plaats um nuuj skins, wèlte, texture en mash-uppacks te vinje van verschillende talentvolle makers.

source_string: Try a new skin for a fresh new look!
translation: Probeer e nuuj skin veur e fris nuuj oetzeen!

source_string: Check out worlds to unlock new maps and challenges that you will want to play again and again!
translation: Bekiek wèlte um nuuj kaarte en oetdaginge te ontgrendele die se telkens weer wils sjpele!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Geef diene ouwe spel e nuuj oetzeen mit texturepacks die se kèns laage boaven dien huijige wèlte en Realms!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Geef diene ouwe spel e nuuj oetzeen mit texturepacks die se kèns laage boaven dien huijige wèlte en Realms!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: Of probeer ze allemaol mit mash-uppacks, dat zeen samegestèlde collecties van skins, wèlte en texture die, wenn se ze combineerts, dien wèlte en Realms transformere!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: Of probeer ze allemaol mit mash-uppacks, dat zeen samegestèlde collecties van skins, wèlte en texture die, wenn se ze combineerts, dien wèlte en Realms transformere!
Wie te sjpele: Handele mit dörpers

source_string: Tap the Ride button while near a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Tap :_input_key.jump: to get out.
translation: Tik de Rie-knop terwiel se bij ein mijnkar bis um in te sjtappe en te rieje. Druk :_input_key.forward: um veuruit te rolle. Tik :_input_key.jump: um oet te sjtappe.

source_string: Tap the board button while near a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press them both to move forward. Tap the leave boat button to get out.
translation: Tik de instap-knop terwiel se bij ein boot bis um in te sjtappe. Druk :_input_key.left: of :_input_key.right: um links of rechts te draoje. Druk ze bejde um veuruit te gaon. Tik de oetsjtap-knop um oet te sjtappe.

source_string: The Sword, Bow, and Trident have specific enchantments that you can get from the Enchanting Table or Anvil that will improve damage, durability and even light mobs on fire!
translation: 't Sjwaad, de Boege en de Trident häbbe specifieke betoveringe die se kèns krieje van de Betovertaofel of Aambeeld, wat sjaad, dureraamheid verbaeter en zelfs wezes in brand steke!

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: De Trident is e waope veur nabij en op aafstand. Druk :_input_key.attack: um aan te valle. Hald :_input_key.use: ingedruk um de trident nao achter te trekke. Laot :_input_key.use: loes um de trident te sjmiete. De Trident is 't beste waope ónjer water.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Tap mobs to attack them. Press and hold the Screen to draw the trident back. Release the press to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: De Trident is e waope veur nabij en op aafstand. Tik wezes um ze aan te valle. Hald 't sjerm ingedruk um de trident nao achter te trekke. Laot loes um de trident te sjmiete. De Trident is 't beste waope ónjer water.

source_string: %s has changed from %s skin to %s skin.
translation: %s huf gewisseld van %s skin nao %s skin.

source_string: Want to broadcast your game? You need to have a compatible broadcasting app installed. We recommend Mixer Create as it allows you to broadcast with sub-second latency, co-stream with friends and lets your viewers interact in fun ways. Certain features like Chat and Viewer Count only work with Mixer Create.
translation: Wils se dien spel broadcaste? Se moots ein compatibele broadcast-app geïnstalleerd häbbe. Weer roere Mixer Create aan, want dat lat dich broadcaste mit ein latentie ónjer ein secónd, samegaom mit vreng en lat dien kiekers plezeerig interactere. Sekere functies wie Chat en Kiekercijfer werke allein mit Mixer Create.
Bereid um dien spel te broadcaste?

source_string: You do not have permission to use this feature. Please go to xbox.com and sign in to your account to fix this
translation: Se häs geine tesjtemming um deze functie te gebroeke. Gank nao xbox.com en meld dich aan bij diene account um dit op te lösse
Meld dich aan um te broadcaste

source_string: We need you to sign in before you can start broadcasting your game.
translation: Weer moots se dich aanmelde veurdet se dien spel kèns begós broadcaste.
Sjlaag huijige datum op bij aafsjloete

source_string: Xforge Requests Wait for Sign In
This world has Behavior Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Deze welt huf behaviorpacks toegepas die se moots downloade um te betraeje. Wils se ze downloade en betraeje?

source_string: This world has Behavior Packs applied to it that you must download to join and Resource Packs that you may optionally download before joining. What would you like to download before joining?
translation: Deze welt huf behaviorpacks toegepas die se moots downloade um te betraeje en resourcepacks die se optioneel kèns downloade veurdet se betraeds. Wat wils se downloade veurdet se betraeds?

source_string: This world has Behavior and Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Deze welt huf behavior- en resourcepacks toegepas die se moots downloade um te betraeje. Wils se ze downloade en betraeje?

source_string: This world has Resource Packs applied to it. Would you like to download them before you join?
translation: Deze welt huf resourcepacks toegepas. Wils se ze downloade veurdet se betraeds?

source_string: This world has Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Deze welt huf resourcepacks toegepas die se moots downloade um te betraeje. Wils se ze downloade en betraeje?

source_string: Adding or removing Behavior Packs after playing a world might break the world and cause you to lose what you created.
translation: Behaviorpacks toevoege of verwiedere nao 't sjpele van ein welt kèn de welt breke en zörge detste verlees wat se creëerd häs.

source_string: Removing Behavior Packs with a plugin might break the world and cause you to lose what you created.
translation: Behaviorpacks verwiedere mit e plugin kèn de welt breke en zörge detste verlees wat se creëerd häs.

source_string: This resolution is incompatible with your device because your device doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Deze resolutie is neet compatibel mit diene apparaat, want diene apparaat huf neet genog geheuge.

source_string: This pack is incompatible with your device because it doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Dit pack is neet compatibel mit diene apparaat, want 't huf neet genog geheuge.

source_string: Unlock all %s Skins, Texture Pack, and World for %s:minecoin:
translation: Ontgrendel alle %s skins, texturepack en welt veur %s:minecoin:

source_string: Tell the creator and the community about your experience with this item!
translation: Deel diene ervaring mit dit item mit de maker en de gemeinsjap!

source_string: Before we can let you rate an item, you will need to sign in with Xbox Live.
translation: Veurdet weer dich e item late bewaardaere, moots se dich aanmelde bij Xbox Live.

source_string: Write a description of your structure.
translation: Sjrief ein besjrieving van dien structuur.

source_string: Your awesome creation has been uploaded to Remix3D.com using your Remix 3D profile. You can update your profile name and image on Remix3D.com anytime.
translation: Dien geweldige creatie is oetgelaaje nao Remix3D.com mit diene Remix 3D-profiel. Se kèns diene profielnaam en aafbeelding op Remix3D.com edert momint updaate.

source_string: New! Your Remix 3D profile is no longer linked to your Xbox Live gamertag. If you’ve already got a Remix 3D profile, we reserved your current gamertag as your name. If you’re new, we will autogenerate a Remix 3D profile for you. (You can edit it later on Remix3D.com.) Hit Agree to acknowledge this change and upload your creation to Remix3D.com. Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statements apply.
translation: Nuuj! Diene Remix 3D-profiel is neet mier gekoppeld aan diene Xbox Live-gamertag. Wenn se al ein Remix 3D-profiel häs, häbbe weer diene huijige gamertag reserveerd es dien naam. Wenn se nuuj bis, generere weer automatisch ein Remix 3D-profiel veur dich. (Se kèns 't later bewerke op Remix3D.com.) Druk op Akkoord um deze verangering te bevestige en dien creatie oet te laje nao Remix3D.com. Microsoft's diensvoerwaarde en privacyverklaring zeen van toepassing.

source_string: You must be signed in to Xbox Live to upload to Remix3D.com.
translation: Se moots aangemeld zeen bij Xbox Live um oet te laje nao Remix3D.com.

source_string: Oh no! You don't have permission to join Remix3D.com.
translation: Oj, ojoj! Se häs geine tesjtemming um Remix3D.com te betraeje.

source_string: Uh oh! Your model is too large. Please try uploading a smaller file.
translation: Oeps! Diene model is te groet. Probeer e klender bestand oet te laje.

source_string: Oops! Your model failed to upload to Remix3D.com.
translation: Oeps! Diene model is neet gelök oet te laje nao Remix3D.com.

source_string: Something went wrong. We weren't able to convert your world. You can send us your world later by going to your old world and pressing Y. Or send us your world now so we can investigate further.
translation: Der is get mis gegange. Weer kónje diene welt neet converteere. Se kèns os later diene welt zende door nao dien oude welt te gaon en op Y te drukke. Of zend os diene welt now, zoedet weer verder kènne onderzuike.
Wezes gedroege zich sjlech of ware nörgens te vinje
Terrein was gebroke of nörgens te vinje

source_string: Lost my items, creations, and/or player stats
translation: Ich verlues mien items, creaties en/of sjpelersstatistieke

source_string: By hitting Agree, you are uploading your world to the Minecraft Team. The Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statement apply.
translation: Door op Akkoord te drukke, laads se diene welt op nao 't Minecraft-team. Microsoft's diensvoerwaarde en privacyverklaring zeen van toepassing.

source_string: By uploading your World you hereby authorize Microsoft to test, reproduce, modify, distribute and publicly display your World in support of transferring your World to Minecraft.
translation: Door dien welt op te laje, geef se Microsoft hierbij tesjtemming um dien welt te teste, reproducere, wiezige, verspreide en publiek te tuine, ter oaversteuning van 't oaverzette van dien welt nao Minecraft.
Oude welt weurt gezónje nao Minecraft...

source_string: Thank you! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it:
translation: Danke! Weer zeen drök doenende um zake op te lösse en kènne neet trökkómme óaver deze specifieke welt. Hei is diene ontvangstbewies detet bevesjtig detet weer 't ontvange häbbe:

source_string: It appears you don't have a license for Minecraft. Make sure you have downloaded and installed Minecraft from the store
translation: 't Liek det se geine licentie häs veur Minecraft. Zörg detste Minecraft huf gedownload en geïnstalleerd oet de winkel

source_string: When you see this icon, we are saving your game. Do not turn off your Nintendo Switch while this icon is on screen.
translation: Wenn se dit icoon zuus, sjlage weer dien spel op. Zjat diene Nintendo Switch neet oet terwiel dit icoon op 't sjerm steet.

source_string: Xbox Live has arrived in Minecraft! It's a gaming community for phones, PCs, and Xbox. And the best part?
translation: Xbox Live is aangekómme in Minecraft! 't Is ein gaminggemeinsjap veur telefoons, PC's en Xbox. En 't besjte deil?

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: Häs se nog geine Gamertag? Maak ein aan um prestjaties te behaole, online mit vreng te sjpele en Realms te betraeje!

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: Häs se nog geine Gamertag? Maak ein aan um prestjaties te behaole, online mit vreng te sjpele en Realms te betraeje!

source_string: We tried to sign you in to your Xbox Live account, but something went wrong.
translation: Weer häbbe probeerd dich aan te melde bij diene Xbox Live-account, mer der is get mis gegange.

source_string: If you play without signing in you won't be able to see your friends list, earn achievements, join Realms, or play online on Xbox Live.
translation: Wenn se sjpels zonder dich aan te melde, kèns se diene vrengliesj neet zeen, geine prestjaties behaole, geine Realms betraeje of online sjpele op Xbox Live.

source_string: Achievements and Gamerscore mark your progress through Minecraft.
translation: Prestjaties en Gamerscore markere dien voortgank door Minecraft.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start earning them!
translation: Meld dich aan bij Xbox Live um ze te begós behaole!

source_string: Add a friend to see when they are online and to play online multiplayer without the hassle of IP addresses and ports.
translation: Voeg ein vrind toe um te zeen wenn ze online zeen en um online multiplayer te sjpele zonder de moeite van IP-adresse en poorte.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start adding friends!
translation: Meld dich aan bij Xbox Live um vreng te begós toevoege!

source_string: Invite your friends to play online multiplayer with you without the hassle of IP address and ports.
translation: Noej dien vreng um mit dich online multiplayer te sjpele zonder de moeite van IP-adresse en poorte.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start inviting friends!
translation: Meld dich aan bij Xbox Live um vreng te begós noejge!

source_string: Servers offer some of the most creative ways to play Minecraft! We just need you to sign in so that we can make sure you have permission to play online with new people.
translation: Servers biede sómmige van de mieste creative maniere um Minecraft te sjpele! Weer moots dich allein aanmelde zoedet weer kènne zörge detste tesjtemming häs um online te sjpele mit nuuj mensen.

source_string: Thank you for sending us a copy of your world and helping us find bugs! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it: %s
translation: Danke veur 't zende van ein kopie van dien welt en 't helpe vinje van fouts! Weer zeen drök doenende um zake op te lösse en kènne neet trökkómme óaver deze specifieke welt. Hei is diene ontvangstbewies detet bevesjtig detet weer 't ontvange häbbe: %s

source_string: Oops! We weren't able to receive your world. Try checking your internet connection or sending it again later.
translation: Oeps! Weer kónje diene welt neet ontvange. Kontroleer diene internetverbinding of probeer 't later nog ins.

source_string: Did your old world not look or work the way it should have? Send us your world and help us find the bugs!
translation: Zaog dien oude welt neet oet of werk neet zoewie 't moot? Zend os dien welt en help os fouts vinje!

source_string: You can change the look of your character with a Skin Pack from the Store. Select 'Store' on the Main Menu to see what's available.
translation: Se kèns 't oetzeen van diene personaasj veranderen mit e Skin Pack oet de winkel. Selecteer 'Winkel' op 't hoofdmenu um te zeen wat der beschikbaar is.

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
Alter the brightness setting to make the game brighter or darker.
translation: Verangere de heldergheidsinsjtelling um 't spel liechter of duusterder te make.

source_string: If you set the game difficulty to Peaceful, your health will automatically regenerate, and no monsters will come out at night!
translation: Wenn se de moeilikheidsgraad op Vredig zets, groeit dien gezondheid automatisch trök aan en kómme der geine monsters in de naach!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Geef ein wolf ein bein um 'm tam te make. Se kèns 'm dan laote zitte of dich laote volge.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: Ein pompoen drage op diene kop hilt Endermen aaf van dich aan te valle.

source_string: Sleeping in a bed at night will fast forward the game to dawn, but all players in a multiplayer game need to sleep in beds at the same time.
translation: Sjlaope in ein bed in de naach sjpróngt 't spel nao daagraod, mer alle sjpelers in e multiplayerspel moots gelieketied in ein bed sjlaope.

source_string: Harvest food from pigs, cows, sheep, rabbit, and chickens. Cook and eat it to regain health!
translation: Óogst voedsel van varkes, keu, sjaop, kónienje en hoender. Kook en eet 't um gezondheid trök te krieje!

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Óogst leer van keu, en gebroek 't um waopenroesting en böks te make.

source_string: If you have an empty bucket, you can fill it with water, lava, or milk from a cow!
translation: Wenn se ein laeg emmer häs, kèns se 'm vulle mit water, lava of melk van ein koe!

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Gebroek ein sjop um gróndj veur te bereide veur te plante.

source_string: Spiders won't attack you during the day - unless you attack them.
translation: Sjpinne valle dich neet aan óaverdaags - behalve wenn se ze aanvals.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: Vöre van e diere hilt 't vanaaf te verdwiene. Bouw ein hok um dien diere veilig te hilde.

source_string: Eating cooked food reduces hunger better than eating raw food.
translation: Gekoch voedsel eite verminderd honger baeter es raauw voedsel eite.

source_string: Craft torches to light up dark areas. Monsters lurk in the darkness!
translation: Vervaardig fakkele um duustere plaatse te verliechte. Monsters loere in de duusternis!

source_string: Get to destinations faster with a minecart and rail!
translation: Kóm sjnelder aan op bestemminge mit ein mijnkar en rails!

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Plant get zaailinge en ze groeie oet tot beum.

source_string: Pigmen won't attack you - unless you attack them.
translation: Zombievarkeman valle dich neet aan - behalve wenn se ze aanvals.

source_string: You can change your game spawn point, and skip to dawn by sleeping in a bed.
translation: Se kèns diene spawnpunt veranderen, en nao daagraod sjpróngen door in ein bed te sjlaope.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Sjlaog die vuurballe trök nao de Ghast!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension - The Nether.
translation: E portaal bouwe lat dich reise nao ein angere dimensie - The Nether.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Digging dirt with a shovel is much faster than using a pickaxe!
translation: Gebroek de richtige werktoeg veur de klus! Gróndj afgrave mit ein sjop is väöl sjnelder es mit e piekhouw!

source_string: If you can't find any coal for your torches, you can always make charcoal from trees in a furnace.
translation: Wenn se geine kool kèns vinje veur dien fakkele, kèns se altied houtskool make van beum in ein smeltoave.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up is not a great idea.
translation: Rechtdoor omleeg of omhoeg grave is gein good idee.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a Skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Beinmael (vervaardig van e sjeletbein) kèn gebroek werde es mescompost en kèn zake sjnel laote groeie!

source_string: Creepers explode when they get close to you!
translation: Creepers ontploffe wenn ze dich naderbij kómme!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidiaan werd gemaak wenn water e lavabronblok raak.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Wenn 't bronblok veur water of lava weurt verwiederd, hilt de sjtroom volledig op.

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Kesjelsteen is besjtendig tege vuurballe van Ghasts, wat 't nuttig maak veur 't beschermen van portaole.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice. This includes torches, glowstones, and Jack-O-Lanterns.
translation: Blökke die es lichtbroen gebroek kènne werde smelte sjnie en ies. Dit ómvat fakkele, glimsteen en Jack-O-Lanterns.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Wies veurzichtig bij 't bouwe van structure van wol in de ope loeht, want bliksem van onwaers kèn wol in brand steke.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Ein einkele emmer lava kèn in ein smeltoave gebroek werde um 100 blökke te smelte.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: 't Instrument gesjpeeld door e nootblok hangt aaf van 't materiaal ónjeraan 't.

source_string: Zombies and Skeletons can survive daylight if they are in water or wearing a helmet.
translation: Zombies en sjeletten kènne daaglich overlaeve wenn ze in water zeen of e helm drage.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves in the immediate vicinity to turn hostile and attack you. This trait is also shared by Zombie Pigmen.
translation: Ein wolf aanvalle zörg detet alle wolve in de directe umgaeving vijandig werde en dich aanvalle. Dees eigenschap deelt zich ouk mit zombievarkeman.

source_string: Wolves and Iron Golems won't attack Creepers.
translation: Wolve en IJzergolems valle Creepers neet aan.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Hoender leëge jeder 5 tot 10 minute e ei.

source_string: Obsidian can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidiaan kèn allein gedolven werde mit e diamentpiekhouw.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creepers zeen de makelikste toegankelike bron van sjeitpoeier.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Twie kiste naeve eder plaatse maak ein groete kis.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Tam wolve toune hun gezondheid mit de positie van hun sjtert. Geef ze vleis um ze te genaeze.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Verschillende kleurstoffe kènne gemaak werde van velerlei materiaole, kook cactus in ein smeltoave um greune kleurstof te krieje!

source_string: On mobile devices, you can download the "Music by Minecraft" pack from the Music Category in the Minecraft Store.
translation: Op mobiele apparate kèns se 't "Music by Minecraft"-pack downloade oet de Muziekcategorie in de Minecraft-winkel.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: Sómmige diere volge dich wenn se koorn in dien hand häs.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Der kómp uiteindelik ein update veur dit spel!

source_string: Mojang has more awards than staff!
translation: Mojang haet mie awards es persuneel!

source_string: Do not look directly at the bugs.
translation: Kiek neet direk nao de bugs.

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
translation: Creepers zint gebore oet 'n coding bug.

source_string: Is it a chicken or is it a duck?
No-one at Mojang has ever seen Junkboy's face.
translation: Neemand bie Mojang haet ooit 't gezich van Junkboy gezien.

source_string: Did you know there's a Minecraft Wiki?
translation: Wiste dat d'r 'n Minecraft Wiki is?

source_string: MINECON 2011 was in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!
translation: MINECON 2011 waor in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!

source_string: MINECON 2013 was in Orlando, Florida, USA!
translation: MINECON 2013 waor in Orlando, Florida, USA!

source_string: No-one can remember where MINECON 2014 was held.
translation: Neemand kèn zich mie herinnere waor MINECON 2014 waor.

source_string: MINECON 2016 was in Anaheim, California, USA!
translation: MINECON 2016 waor in Anaheim, California, USA!

source_string: Always assume rumors are false, rather than assuming they're true!
translation: Gank altied ervan oet dat gerochte valsj zint, in plaots van dat ze woor zint!

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: De eerste versie van Minecraft woor gemak in slechs 6 daag!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: De taal van de Enderman is eigelik Engels achteroets.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: De orzjinele naam veur Minecraft waor Cave Game.

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become Zombie Pigmen!
translation: Verkes die geraak weure door blieksem weure Zombie Verkesmenne!

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Sómtieds gaeve iezere golems blome aan de kinger vaan dörper!

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: 'n Spider Jockey is 't zeldzaam versjienen van 'n spin die berede weurt door 'n skelet!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the overworld.
translation: Ein blok reize in de Nether staot geliek aan aat blök reize in de overwereld.

source_string: You need an Agent to code! Get an Agent egg from your creative inventory.
translation: Se höbbe 'n Agent nudig um te code! Pak 'n Agent-eij oet oew creative inventaris.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to sync your Skins, Texture Packs, Worlds, and Mash-ups. They will be there for you on any device where you play Minecraft.
translation: Log in bie Xbox Live um oewe Skins, Textuurpakkette, Waerelde en Mash-ups te synchroniseere. Ze zint dan beschikbaar op eder apparaot woa se Minecraft speult.

source_string: Syncing purchases to Xbox Live account...
translation: Aankäöp weure gesynchroniseerd mit Xbox Live-account...

source_string: This Xbox Live account will not be the primary account for this device if you do not sync this device's purchases to this account. You will not automatically sign in when you start Minecraft.
translation: Dit Xbox Live-account weurt neet 't primaire account veur dit apparaot es se de aankäöp van dit apparaot neet mit dit account synchroniseert. Se weurt neet automatisch aongemeld wienie se Minecraft opstart.

source_string: Your app store purchases will be available wherever you log in with %s. You can only sync these packs to one account, but they will continue to be available to anyone who uses this device.
translation: Oewe app store-aankäöp zint beschikbaar euveral woa se inlogt mit %s. Se kènt deze pakkette mer aon ein account synchroniseere, mer ze bliefe beschikbaar veur eederein die dit apparaot gebroek.

source_string: Is this the account that you would like to use to access your previous purchases?
translation: Is dit 't account dat se wilt gebroeke um toegang te kriege tot oewe veurige aankäöp?

source_string: You can't extend your Realm right now. We have now introduced subscriptions for Realms on Xbox and you can buy a new subscription as soon as your Realm has expired in %d days. But don't worry! We will give you 14 extra days for free and your Realm will be kept online, so you will have plenty of time to extend it by then.
translation: Se kènt oew Realm noe neet verlenge. We höbbe noe abonnemente veur Realms op Xbox ingeveuerd en se kènt 'n nuuj abonnement kaufe zoegauw oew Realm verlöp binne %d daag. Mer maak dich gein zörg! We gaeve dich 14 extra daag gratis en oew Realm bliet online, zoedat se genóg tied höbt um 't dan te verlenge.

source_string: How to Play : Education Edition Blocks
translation: Wie te Speule : Education Edition Blök

source_string: Minecraft: Education Edition features several special blocks that make it easier for teachers to create and employ lessons. World Builder ability negates the restrictions of these blocks.
translation: Minecraft: Education Edition haet verscheie speciaal blök die 't makelijker maake veur leraars um lesse te make en te gebroeke. World Builder-vermoge maak de restricties van deze blök ongedaon.

source_string: Allow and Deny blocks focus where players can build in a world.
translation: Toestaon- en Weigere-blök bepale woa spelers in 'n wereld kènne bouwe.

source_string: Allow blocks let players place or destroy blocks in the area above them.
translation: Toestaon-blök laote spelers blök plaatse of vernille in 't gebeed erbaove.

source_string: Deny blocks prohibit users from placing or destroying blocks in the area above them.
translation: Weigere-blök verhindere gebroekers blök te plaatse of te vernille in 't gebeed erbaove.

source_string: Neither block affects the area below them.
translation: Genein van beid blök haet invloed op 't gebeed eronder.

source_string: If an Allow block is placed somewhere with a Deny block below it, the space between the two blocks will be protected while the space above the Allow block will permit users to place and destroy blocks.
translation: Wenn ein Toestaon-blok geplaats weurt mit 'n Weigere-blok erónger, dan weurt de ruimde tösse de tswei blök beschermp, terwiel de ruimde baove 't Toestaon-blok gebroekers toestaot um blök te plaatse en te vernille.

source_string: Border Blocks are bright, red walls that act like a force field, extending upwards and downwards forever!
translation: Grensblök zint helder, rooj wanne die zich gedrage es 'n forcefield, en zich eindig oetsjtrek nao baove en ónger!

source_string: Border blocks prevent players from passing through, over, or under them by any means other than being a World Builder.
translation: Grensblök verhindere spelers um erdoor, erover of eronger te gaon, oetgezónderd es se ein World Builder bis.

source_string: Border blocks cannot be destroyed by non-World Builders.
translation: Grensblök kènne neet vernild weure door neet-World Builders.

source_string: Structure blocks save existing structures so they can be loaded in a different spot or even exported for later use.
translation: Structuurblök slaon bestaonde structure op zoedat ze op 'n aander plek geloade kènne weure of zelfs geëxporteerd veur later gebroek.

source_string: NPCs display their dialog text when interacted with by non-World Builders.
translation: NPC's toone hun dialoogtekst wenn ze door neet-World Builders geraokt weure.

source_string: NPCs can also launch external URLs or execute commands automatically on closing their dialog box, or by assigning actions to buttons for players to interact with. All automatic commands (and URLs) are executed in the order they are added to the NPC.
translation: NPC's kènne ouch externe URL's start of commando's automatisch oetvoere bie 't sjluete van hun dialoogvenster, of door acties toe te wieze aon knöp veur spelers um mit te interactere. Alle automatische commando's (en URL's) weure oetgeveurd in de volgorde woa ze aon de NPC toegeveugd zint.

source_string: Once placed, face the Camera and press the on-screen button labeled "Take Picture".
translation: Namat geplaats, kiek nao de Camera en druk op de knop op 't sjeerm mit de label "Foto Make".

source_string: The Camera will track you during this time, doing its best to keep you in the shot, even if you move around.
translation: De Camera zal dich volge tiedens deze tied, en zoveul mäögelijk zörge dat se in beeld bliet, ouch al beweegs se.

source_string: After the five second timer counts down, your picture is taken.
translation: Namat de vief secóndetimer aftik, weurt oewe foto gemak.

source_string: Pictures can be viewed in the Portfolio or inserted into a book using the Book & Quill.
translation: Foto's kènne bekeke weure in 't Portfolio of ingevoegd weure in 'n book mit de Book & Quill.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the caption label.
translation: Se kènt oewe foto's 'n bijschrif gaeve door op :mouse_left_button: te drökke op de bijschrif-label.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by selecting the caption label and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Se kènt oewe foto's 'n bijschrif gaeve door de bijschrif-label te selectere en :_gamepad_face_button_down: te drökke.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by tapping the caption label.
translation: Se kènt oewe foto's 'n bijschrif gaeve door op de bijschrif-label te tikke.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the trash icon below the picture.
translation: Se kènt oewe foto's verwiedere door :mouse_left_button: te drökke op 't afvalbakicoon ónger de foto.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by selecting the trash icon below the picture and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Se kènt oewe foto's verwiedere door 't afvalbakicoon ónger de foto te selectere en :_gamepad_face_button_down: te drökke.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by tapping the trash icon below the picture.
translation: Se kènt oewe foto's verwiedere door op 't afvalbakicoon ónger de foto te tikke.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the Export Portfolio button.
translation: Se kènt oew Portfolio exportere es 'n reeks aafbeeldinge door :mouse_left_button: te drökke op de knop Exporteer Portfolio.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by selecting the Export Portfolio button and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Se kènt oew Portfolio exportere es 'n reeks aafbeeldinge door de knop Exporteer Portfolio te selectere en :_gamepad_face_button_down: te drökke.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by tapping the Export Portfolio button.
translation: Se kènt oew Portfolio exportere es 'n reeks aafbeeldinge door op de knop Exporteer Portfolio te tikke.

source_string: Code Connection is an extension that allows educators and students to explore, create, and play in an immersive Minecraft world... all by writing code!
translation: Code Connection is 'n extensie die docente en studente in staot stel um 'n immersieve Minecraft-wereld te verkenne, te make en erin te speule... allemaol door code te sjrieve!

source_string: You can launch Code Connection using the command "/code" to get started.
translation: Se kènt Code Connection starte mit 't commando "/code" um te begine.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing the :touch_jump: button. If you want to travel downward you can press the :touch_fly_down: button.
translation: Steiger kèn dich helpe um veilig groate structure te make! Se kènt in de steiger loupe en erop staon. Wenn se 'n kolóm steiger höbt, kènt se nao baove gaon door in de steiger te staon en op de :touch_jump:-knop te drökke. Wenn se nao ónger wilt gaon, kènt se op de :touch_fly_down:-knop drökke.

source_string: We're unable to connect to the library. Maybe check your internet connection?
translation: We kènne neet verbinde mit de bibliotheek. Kiek eves oew internetverbinding?

source_string: This will save and quit your current game and any multiplayer connections, are you sure you want to quit?
translation: Dit zal oew huidig sjpel en ederein mieroetsjpel verbindinge opsjlaon en aafsjlete, bis se zeker dat se wilt aafsjlete?

source_string: Sorry, we weren't able to find that item in the Library.
translation: Sorry, we konte dat item neet vinge in de Bibliotheek.

source_string: Welcome to the Minecraft: Education Edition Library!
translation: Welkom bie de Minecraft: Education Edition Bibliotheek!

source_string: The Library is a new feature we've created to make it easy for teachers and students to find and import educational content directly in the game. In this release, you'll find a list of some of our most popular worlds to import and use, along with a link to the full world library on our website.
translation: De Bibliotheek is 'n nuuj functie die we gemak höbbe um 't makelijk te make veur leraars en studente um educatieve inhaud direk in 't sjpel te vinge en te importere. In deze versie vinges se 'n liest van sommige van os populairste waerelde um te importere en te gebroeke, saame mit 'n link nao de volledige waereldbibliotheek op os website.

source_string: We're working on adding support for more types of content and functionality in the coming months. Please let us know what you think by clicking the feedback button.
translation: We werke eraon um in de kómmende maonde meer soorte inhaud en functionaliteit te ondersteune. Laot os wete wat se derva denkt door op de feedbackknop te klikke.

source_string: Preparing to import new world. This could take a few minutes.
translation: Nuuj wereld voorbereide um te importere. Dit kèn 'n paar minute doure.

source_string: with field in rawtext must contain a array. Example: "rawtext":[{"translate": "chat.type.announcement", "with": [ "value1", "value2" ]}]
translation: 'with' veld in rawtext moot 'n array bevatte. Veurbeeld: "rawtext":[{"translate": "chat.type.announcement", "with": [ "value1", "value2" ]}]

translation: De wereld die se wilt bezeuke, verich dat oew apparaot scripts kèn oetvoere. Oew apparaot ondersteunt momenteel gein scripting, doorum kènt se neet vanoet dit apparaot meidoen.

translation: Druk op W, A, S of D um te beweeg

translation: Wenn se recht nao baove aan 't graoven bis, plaats 'n toorts bie oew vöt um zand of gravel te breke die op dich könne valle.

source_string: Attempts to connect to the websocket server to send a video stream.

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Tap :touch_sneak: to toggle block with the Shield.
translation: 't Sjild zal binnekómmende schaod blokkere. 't Sjild kèn geëquipeerd weure in de aander hand-sleuf en de hotbar. Tik :touch_sneak: um te blokkere mit 't Sjild.

source_string: What happens to my Realms and worlds when my subscription to Realms Plus ends?
translation: Wat gebeurt mit mien Realms en waerelde wenn mien abonnement op Realms Plus endig?

source_string: If your subscription ends, you and your friends will no longer be able to play online together on Realms, and you will no longer have access to the packs or cloud storage. You will be able to purchase and download any world templates saved to your Realm and cloud storage within 18 months of ending your subscription unless they are no longer offered by Minecraft. If you used Realms Plus worlds, texture packs, or mash-ups, you will need to purchase those packs in the store or, if those packs are still in Realms Plus, re-subscribe, to play those world templates.
translation: Es oew abonnement endig, kènt se en oew vrunde neet mie saame online speule op Realms, en se höbt gein toegang mie tot de pakkette of cloudoplsjlaog. translation: De Allay leef 't um items te verzamele! Es se 'm 'n bepaold item gaef, zal 't probeere mie derva te verzamele.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with Noteblocks!

source_string: Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.

source_string: When wandering in Deep Dark, silence is key.
translation: Wenn se rónddwaal in Deep Dark, is stilde de sjlussel.

source_string: Aim the :tip_crosshair: at the crafting table and tap screen to use it.

translation: Tik en hald 'n blok vas um 't te winne mit oew hand of 't item die se in oew hand höbt. Se könt bepaolde tools nudig höbbe veurdat se bepaolde blök kèn winne.

source_string: Tap and drag your finger anywhere to aim with :tip_crosshair: and highlight a block. Tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy: to mine it with your hand or the item you're holding. You might need to craft specific tools before you can mine certain blocks.
translation: Tik en sjleep oewe vinger euveral um te riechte mit :tip_crosshair: en 'n blok te markere. Tik en hald :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy: um 't te winne mit oew hand of 't item die se in oew hand höbt. Se könt bepaolde tools nudig höbbe veurdat se bepaolde blök kèn winne.

source_string: If you're holding an item, tap the screen to use it or tap and hold the item in your hotbar to drop it. Tap and hold the screen to eat any food you're holding.
translation: Es se 'n item in oew hand höbt, tik 't sjeerm um 't te gebroeke of tik en hald 't item in oew hotbar um 't te valle laote. Tik en hald 't sjeerm um eder aete te aete die se in oew hand höbt.

source_string: Sneaking keeps you from falling off blocks, hides you from mobs, and hides your nametag from other players. To sneak, tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak:.

source_string: If you lose health but have at least nine :shank:, your health will automatically replenish. Eating food will also replenish your :shank:.
translation: Es se gezóndheid verlees mer tenminste negen :shank: höbs, herstelt oew gezóndheid automatisch. Aete vult ouch oew :shank:.

source_string: Your health will automatically replenish if you have at least nine :shank:. Your :shank: will slowly decrease as you explore and get hungry, but eating food will replenish your :shank:.
translation: Oew gezóndheid herstelt automatisch es se tenminste negen :shank: höbs. Oew :shank: neemp langsaam aaf wiel se ontdek en hónger krieg, mer aete vult oew :shank:.

source_string: To eat something, tap the food item on your hotbar, then tap and hold the screen to eat.
translation: Um get te aete, tik 't aete-item op oewe hotbar, dan tik en hald 't sjeerm um te aete.

source_string: If you use Action Buttons, first tap the food item on your hotbar, then tap and hold :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to eat it.
translation: Es se Actieknöp gebroek, tik ierst 't aete-item op oewe hotbar, dan tik en hald :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: um 't te aete.

source_string: Certain activities will make you more hungry faster, like sprinting. Fortunately, some foods are more nourishing and will fill up more :shank:.
translation: Bepaolde activiteite make dich sneller hongerig, zoas sprinte. Gelökkig zint sommige aetsel voedzamer en vulle mie :shank:.

source_string: If you have full :shank:, the last food you ate will apply a saturation value - a hidden value that gives an extra boost to your hunger level.
translation: Es se vol :shank: höbt, geeft 't leaste aete die se gaate 'n verzaodigingswaarde - 'n verbörge waarde die 'n extra boost gaef aan oew hongerniveau.

source_string: If you tap on a stack of items, you'll automatically select all items in the stack. You can move the stack the same way you would a single item.
translation: Es se tikt op 'n stapel items, selecteert se automatisch alle items in de stapel. Se kènt de stapel verplaatse op de zelfde manier es 'n enkel item.

source_string: To split a stack of items, tap and hold on the item stack until the selection slider appears. Without releasing the screen, slide your finger left and right to select the number of items you want to remove from the stack.
translation: Um 'n stapel items te sjplete, tik en hald op de itemstapel tot de selectieschuif verschient. Zónder 't sjeerm los te laote, sjleep oewe vinger links en rechts um 't aantal items te selectere die se van de stapel wilt verwiedere.

source_string: For more information, please visit https://aka.ms/MinecraftGeoSunsetting in any web browser.
translation: Veur mie informatie, bezeuk https://aka.ms/MinecraftGeoSunsetting in eder webbrowser.

source_string: Our ability to support this device is coming to an end in your area. After you receive the final update, you will still be able to play on your worlds, and access your Marketplace purchases, but you will no longer be able to make purchases in the Marketplace. Realms managed from this device will continue to work for 6 months. On Sept. 30th, 2023 you will no longer have access to the realm. It is recommended you download your world prior to this and cancel your subscription by viewing your Subscriptions settings on your device. %sIf you have signed in with a Microsoft/Xbox Live account, your Marketplace purchases & Minecoins and your Realms subscription will be available on other platforms. If you would like to move your worlds from this device to another device, you can do so by uploading the world to a Realm, and downloading a backup onto your new device. %sClick on the button for more information, including ways to move your world to a new device.

Realms beheerd vanoet dit apparaot bliewe werke veur 6 maonde. Op 30 sept. 2023 höbt se gein toegang mie tot de realm. 't Weurt aangeraoje um oew wereld te downloade veurdat dit gebeurt en oew abonnement te annulere via oew Abonnemente-insjtellinge op oew apparaot. %sEs se aongemeld bis mit 'n Microsoft/Xbox Live-account, bliewe oew Marketplace-aankäöp & Minecoins en oew Realms-abonnement beschikbaar op aander platforms. source_string: Custom Dimensions - Add custom void dimensions to your world. New dimensions will appear in both the Custom Dimensions panel and the World/Dimensions menu.

source_string: Biome Data Assignment - Assign biome metadata to a selection, including within Custom Dimensions. This affects systems like weather, spawning rules, and Vibrant Visuals but does not place or alter blocks.
translation: Biome-Gegevestoewijzing - Wijs biome-metagegeves toe aan ein selectie, ouch binne Aangepaste Dimensies. Dit beïnvlood systeme wie weer, spawnregele, en Vibrant Visuals, mer plaats of verangert gein blokke.

source_string: Vibrant Visuals: Biome Config Mapping - Easily mix and match Vibrant Visual settings across multiple biomes using the new config mapping window. Find it in the Vibrant Visuals panel: [~*icon|$val=pack://textures/editor/Vibrant-Visuals.png~]

source_string: Cursor improvements - We've added contextual cursors to improve feedback. You should now see a "loading" icon when you're blocked from taking action by something that requires processing time, such as chunk regeneration or placing a very large primitive shape.
translation: Cursorverbeteringe - We höbbe contextuele cursors toegevoegd óm feedback te verbetere. Se zuls nou ei "laje"-icoon zeen wenneer se geblokkeerd bis óm ein actie te ónjerneme door get wat verwerkingstied vereis, wie chunk-regeneratie of 't plaatse van ein zeer greute primitieve vorm.

source_string: %s Use "Import Custom Mesh" to choose a 3D mesh on your hard drive that you've downloaded or exported from a modeling program.%s You can move, rotate and scale the mesh preview in your world using the viewport widget and the sliders in the tool panel.%s "Place Blocks" will turn your mesh into a shell of blocks using your active hotbar selection.%s "Cancel" will clear the loaded mesh
translation: %s Gebruik "Aangepaste Mesh Importere" óm ei 3D-mesh op diene harde sjief te keeze die se downgeloaje of geëxporteerd hebs van ei modelleerprogram.%s Se kans de meshveurbesjouwing verplaatse, draeje en sjkale in diene waereld mit de viewport-widget en de sjuivers in 't gereedsjappaneel.%s "Blokke Plaatse" verangert diene mesh in ein schaol van blokke mit diene actieve hotbarselectie.%s "Annulere" wisj de geloaje mesh

source_string: %s Add your own Custom Dimensions with the "Add Custom Dimension" button.%s Dimension names must include a namespace, such as "namespace:mydimension".%s Click on any dimension in the list to visit it and start placing blocks. You can also find them in the World/Dimensions menu.%s Custom dimensions cannot currently be renamed or deleted.
translation: %s Voeg diene eige Aangepaste Dimensies toe mit de "Aangepaste Dimensie Toevoege"-knóp.%s Dimensienamen moote ein namespace höbbe, wie "namespace:mydimension".%s Klik op elke dimensie in de lies óm ze te bezeuke en te beginne mit blokke plaatse. Se kans ze ouch vinje in 't Waereld/Dimensies-menu.%s Aangepaste dimensies kanne momenteel neet umbenoemd of verwijerd worde.

source_string: %s Biome Data Assignment lets you assign a selection to the biome of your choice.%s This does not add or change any blocks, but will affect game systems like vegetation tint, mob spawning, Vibrant Visuals, and weather.%s Choose a biome in the "Biome to Assign" box, and use the "Assign Biome to Selection" to reassign data.
translation: %s Biome-Gegevestoewijzing laet dich ein selectie toewijze aan de biome van diene keus.%s Dit voeg gein blokke toe of verangert ze neet, mer beïnvlood sjpelsysteme wie plantekleuring, mob-spawning, Vibrant Visuals, en weer.%s Keus ein biome in 't "Biome Toewijze"-vak, en gebruik "Biome Aan Selectie Toewijze" óm gegeves opnuuts toe te wijze.

source_string: %s You'll be reassigning a selection in the world. Within the Biome Data Assignment panel, you can use additional settings to determine how the data reassignment will interact with that selection.%s "Extend up to world ceiling" and "Extend down to world floor" will extend the effect on the Y axis, including all blocks above or below your selection respectively.%s Masking your selection by Biomes or Biome Tags will use existing Biome boundaries to restrict the effect further. These settings will not extend data assignment beyond your selection, but can provide further control.%s By default, the list of available biomes and tags will be filtered to show only valid options within your existing selection. Uncheck "Only show biomes/tags within the active selection" to see the full list.
translation: %s Se gaet ein selectie in de waereld opnuuts toewijze. In 't Biome-Gegevestoewijzing-paneel kans se extra insjtellinge gebruike óm te bepale wie de gegevestoewijzing mit die selectie interactereet.%s "Oetbreie tot waereldpalefón" en "Oetbreie tot waereldbóddem" breie 't effekt oet op de Y-as, inclusief alle blokke boave of óngen dien selectie respectievelijk.%s Dien selectie maskere door Biomes of Biome-Tags gebruikt besjtaonde Biome-grenze óm 't effekt verder te beperke. Deze insjtellinge breie de gegevestoewijzing neet oet buiten dien selectie, mer geve mie kontrole.%s Standerd wördt de lies mit besjikbare biomes en tags gefilterd óm allein geldige opties binne diene besjtaonde selectie te tone. Vinjk "Toon allein biomes/tags binne de actieve selectie" oet óm de volledige lies te zeen.

source_string: %s Any areas you've already reassigned will be listed here. Each item shows you the region's current biome assignment, its rough center (in X and Z), and the full height in Y, so you can determine whether the affected area extends to the world ceiling or floor.%s Use %s to move your camera to that location.%s Use %s to change the assignment of that area to another biome.%s It is not currently possible to revert a reassigned area to the world's original state.
translation: %s Eder gebied dat se al opnuuts toegewiezen hebs, wördt hie opgelijst. Eder item toont de huidige biome-toewijzing van de regio, ziene róndje centrum (in X en Z), en de volledige heugde in Y, zoedat se kans bepale of 't beïnvloede gebied tot 't waereldpalefón of -bóddem reik.%s Gebruik %s óm diene camera nao die locatie te verplaatse.%s Gebruik %s óm de toewijzing van dat gebied nao ein anger biome te verangere.%s 't Is momenteel neet meugelijk óm ein opnuuts toegewiezen gebied te herstelle nao de oersjprónkelijke sjtaot van de waereld.

source_string: When filling biomes, if any of the selected positions are in regions that have an assigned biome that is eligible for replacement but the position itself is not (due to the above filters), reassign those regions to a biome in this list instead of filling them with the selected biome. This can help preserve visual consistency when only part of a region is being filled. If this list is empty, no reassignment will occur and those positions will be left unchanged.
translation: Wen doe biomes völs, en einige van de geselekteerde posities liage in regio's die ein toegewaeze biome haben die in aanmerking kump veur vervanging, mer de positie zelf neet (door de bovesjtaonde filters), wor die regio's dan herrtoegewaeze aan ein biome oet dees lies in plaats van ze te völle mit de geselekteerde biome. Dit kan helpe de visuele consistentie te behoeë wen allein ein deil van ein regio gevöld weurt. Es dees lies laeg is, gebeurt der gein herrtoewijzing en blieve die posities ongeverangerd.
